recipes.name: Fluffy pancakes
ingredients: 3 tablespoons (45 g) butter, melted, plus more for the pan
steps: Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder and salt in a big bowl.
In another bowl, whisk the milk, egg and melted butter.
Pour the wet mix into the dry mix and stir until just combined. A few lumps are fine.
Let the batter rest for 5 minutes.
Heat a frying pan over medium heat and melt a little butter in it.
Pour 1/4 cup of batter into the pan for each pancake.
Cook for 2 to 3 minutes, until bubbles pop on top.
Flip and cook for 1 to 2 minutes more, until golden.

recipes.name: Crispy waffles
steps: Turn on the waffle iron to heat up.
Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder and salt in a big bowl.
In another bowl, whisk the eggs, milk, melted butter and vanilla.
Pour the wet mix into the dry mix and stir until just combined.
Spray the waffle iron with cooking spray.
Pour batter into the middle of the iron, about 1/2 cup, and close the lid.
Cook for 4 to 5 minutes, until golden and the steam stops.
Lift the waffle out with a fork and repeat with the rest of the batter.

recipes.name: French toast
ingredients: 8 thick slices bread (a day old works best)
2 tablespoons (30 g) butter for the pan
Maple syrup or fruit to serve
steps: Whisk the eggs, milk, sugar, cinnamon, vanilla and salt in a shallow dish.
Melt a little butter in a frying pan over medium heat.
Dip a slice of bread in the egg mix and turn it to soak both sides.
Lay the bread in the pan.
Cook for 2 to 3 minutes, until the bottom is golden.
Flip and cook for 2 to 3 minutes more.
Repeat with the rest of the bread, adding butter as needed.
Serve with maple syrup or fruit.

recipes.name: Soft scrambled eggs
steps: Crack the eggs into a bowl.
Add the milk, salt and pepper and whisk until smooth.
Melt the butter in a nonstick pan over medium-low heat.
Pour in the eggs.
Cook for 2 to 3 minutes, slowly pushing the eggs from the edges to the middle with a spatula.
Take the pan off the heat while the eggs still look a little wet.
Serve right away.

recipes.name: Cheese omelette
ingredients: Optional: chopped ham, spinach or cooked mushrooms
steps: Whisk the eggs, milk, salt and pepper in a bowl.
Melt the butter in a small nonstick pan over medium heat.
Pour in the eggs.
Cook for 2 minutes, until the edges start to set.
Push the edges in with a spatula so the runny egg flows underneath.
Sprinkle the cheese and any fillings over one half.
Cook for 1 minute more, until the top is almost set.
Fold the omelette in half and slide it onto a plate.

recipes.name: Overnight oats
ingredients: 1/4 cup (60 g) plain or vanilla yogurt
1 to 2 teaspoons honey or maple syrup
Fruit to top, like berries or banana
steps: Put the oats in a jar or small container.
Add the milk, yogurt, chia seeds, honey and cinnamon.
Stir well so there are no dry oats.
Put the lid on.
Refrigerate overnight.
Stir, add your fruit on top and eat it cold.

recipes.name: Berry banana smoothie
ingredients: 1/2 cup (120 g) plain or vanilla yogurt
steps: Peel the banana and break it into pieces.
Put the banana, berries, yogurt, milk and honey in a blender.
Put the lid on tight.
Blend for 30 to 60 seconds, until smooth.
Pour into two glasses and serve.

recipes.name: Banana bread
ingredients: 3/4 cup (150 g) sugar or brown sugar
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Grease a 9 by 5 inch loaf pan with butter.
Mash the bananas in a big bowl with a fork.
Stir in the melted butter.
Stir in the sugar, egg and vanilla.
Sprinkle the baking soda and salt over the mix and stir.
Stir in the flour until just combined.
Pour the batter into the pan.
Bake for 55 to 65 minutes, until a toothpick in the middle comes out clean.
Let cool for 10 minutes in the pan, then lift it out onto a rack.

recipes.name: Grilled cheese sandwich
steps: Spread butter on one side of each slice of bread.
Put one slice butter side down in a cold frying pan.
Lay the cheese on top, then the other slice with the butter side up.
Turn the heat to medium-low.
Cook for 3 to 4 minutes, until the bottom is golden.
Flip the sandwich with a spatula.
Cook for 2 to 3 minutes more, until the cheese melts.
Cut in half and serve.

recipes.name: Cheese quesadilla
ingredients: Optional: 1/2 cup cooked shredded chicken or black beans
Salsa and sour cream to serve
steps: Lay one tortilla in a cold frying pan.
Sprinkle the cheese and any fillings over it.
Put the other tortilla on top.
Turn the heat to medium.
Cook for 2 to 3 minutes, until golden underneath.
Flip it carefully with a big spatula.
Cook for 2 minutes more, until the cheese is melted.
Slide it onto a board and cut into 4 wedges.
Serve with salsa and sour cream.

recipes.name: Stovetop mac and cheese
steps: Fill a big pot with water, add a big pinch of salt and bring it to a boil.
Add the macaroni and boil for 7 to 8 minutes, until tender.
Drain the macaroni in a colander.
Melt the butter in the empty pot over medium heat.
Whisk in the flour and cook for 1 minute, whisking.
Slowly whisk in the milk.
Simmer for 3 to 5 minutes, stirring, until it thickens.
Take the pot off the heat and stir in the cheese, salt and pepper.
Stir in the macaroni and serve.

recipes.name: Tuna sandwich
ingredients: 1 tablespoon finely chopped pickle or celery (optional)
steps: Open the can of tuna and drain off the liquid.
Put the tuna in a bowl and break it up with a fork.
Add the mayonnaise, lemon juice, pickle, salt and pepper and stir.
Spread the tuna on 2 slices of bread.
Add a lettuce leaf to each.
Top with the other bread and cut in half.

recipes.name: Guacamole
steps: Cut the avocados in half and take out the pits. Ask an adult to help.
Scoop the avocado into a bowl with a spoon.
Mash it with a fork until a bit chunky.
Stir in the lime juice and salt.
Chop the onion, tomato, cilantro and jalapeno into small pieces.
Stir them into the avocado.
Taste and add more salt or lime if you like.
Serve with tortilla chips.

recipes.name: Hummus
ingredients: 1 can (15 oz / 425 g) chickpeas, liquid saved
2 tablespoons olive oil, plus more to serve
2 to 4 tablespoons chickpea liquid or cold water
steps: Drain the chickpeas over a bowl to save the liquid.
Put the tahini and lemon juice in a food processor.
Blend for 1 minute, until creamy.
Add the chickpeas, garlic, olive oil, salt and cumin.
Blend for 1 to 2 minutes, scraping down the sides once.
Add the chickpea liquid a spoonful at a time while blending, until smooth.
Spoon into a bowl and drizzle with a little olive oil.

recipes.name: Stovetop popcorn
steps: Put the oil and 3 kernels in a big pot and cover it with the lid. Ask an adult to help.
Heat over medium-high heat for 2 to 3 minutes, until the 3 kernels pop.
Add the rest of the kernels in one layer and put the lid back on.
Take the pot off the heat and let it sit for 30 seconds.
Put the pot back on the heat.
Cook for 2 to 3 minutes, gently shaking the pot, until the popping slows down.
Pour the popcorn into a big bowl right away.
Toss with the melted butter and salt.

recipes.name: Cheesy nachos
ingredients: 2 cups (200 g) shredded cheddar or Mexican-style cheese
1 can (15 oz / 425 g) black beans, drained and rinsed
Optional: sour cream, guacamole, sliced jalapenos
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Line a baking sheet with foil or parchment paper.
Spread half the chips on the sheet.
Sprinkle half the cheese and half the beans over the chips.
Add the rest of the chips, beans and cheese on top.
Bake for 7 to 10 minutes, until the cheese melts.
Let cool for 2 minutes.
Top with salsa, sour cream and guacamole.

recipes.name: Fruit salad
steps: Wash the strawberries, blueberries and grapes.
Cut the tops off the strawberries and cut them into quarters. Ask an adult to help.
Cut the grapes in half.
Peel the kiwis and bananas and slice them.
Put all the fruit in a big bowl.
Stir the honey and lime juice together in a cup.
Pour it over the fruit and toss gently.
Chill for 30 minutes before serving.

recipes.name: Fresh tomato salsa
steps: Dice the tomatoes into small pieces. Ask an adult to help.
Finely chop the onion and cilantro.
Cut the jalapeno open, scrape out the seeds and chop it very small.
Put everything in a bowl.
Add the lime juice and salt and stir.
Chill for 15 minutes so the flavors mix.
Taste, add more salt if needed, and serve with chips.

recipes.name: Spaghetti bolognese
steps: Finely chop the onion, carrot, celery and garlic. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pot over medium heat.
Add the vegetables and cook for 5 to 7 minutes, until soft.
Add the beef and cook for 5 to 7 minutes, breaking it up, until no pink is left.
Stir in the tomato paste, crushed tomatoes, oregano, salt and pepper.
Simmer for 30 minutes, stirring now and then.
Bring a big pot of salted water to a boil.
Add the spaghetti and boil for 9 to 11 minutes, until tender.
Drain the spaghetti in a colander.
Serve the sauce over the spaghetti with parmesan on top.

recipes.name: Beef tacos
ingredients: Sour cream and salsa to serve
steps: Shred the lettuce and dice the tomato. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big frying pan over medium-high heat.
Add the beef and cook for 6 to 8 minutes, breaking it up, until browned.
Spoon off any extra fat into a heatproof cup.
Stir in all the spices, the salt and the water.
Simmer for 5 minutes, until most of the liquid is gone.
Wrap the tortillas in a damp paper towel and microwave for 30 seconds.
Fill the shells with beef, lettuce, tomato and cheese.
Add sour cream and salsa on top.

recipes.name: Homemade pizza
ingredients: 3 cups (375 g) all-purpose or bread flour
2 tablespoons olive oil, plus more for the pans
Toppings you like, such as pepperoni or peppers
steps: Mix the flour, yeast, sugar and salt in a big bowl.
Add the warm water and olive oil and stir into a shaggy dough.
Knead on a floured counter for 5 to 8 minutes, until smooth and stretchy.
Put the dough in an oiled bowl and cover it.
Let rise for 1 hour, until doubled.
Heat the oven to 475°F (245°C). Ask an adult to help.
Split the dough in two and stretch each half into a 12 inch circle on an oiled pan.
Spread on the sauce, then the cheese and toppings.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, until the crust is golden and the cheese bubbles.
Let cool for 5 minutes before slicing.

recipes.name: Baked chicken nuggets
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) boneless skinless chicken breasts
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Ask an adult to help.
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and spray it with oil.
Cut the chicken into 1 1/2 inch pieces.
Put the flour in one bowl, the eggs in another bowl, and mix the panko, parmesan, spices and salt in a third.
Dip each piece in flour, then egg, then the crumb mix, and lay it on the sheet.
Spray the tops with oil and wash your hands well.
Bake for 8 minutes.
Flip the nuggets and bake for 7 to 10 minutes more, until golden and 165°F (74°C) inside.
Let cool for 5 minutes before eating.

recipes.name: Egg fried rice
ingredients: 3 cups (500 g) cold cooked rice, best from the day before
1 cup (140 g) frozen peas and carrots
steps: Slice the green onions and finely chop the garlic. Ask an adult to help.
Heat 1 tablespoon of the oil in a big pan or wok over medium-high heat.
Pour in the eggs and cook for 1 to 2 minutes, stirring, until just set.
Move the eggs to a plate.
Add the rest of the oil, the peas and carrots, the garlic and half the green onions.
Cook for 2 minutes, stirring.
Add the rice and cook for 3 to 4 minutes, breaking up clumps, until hot.
Stir in the soy sauce, sesame oil, eggs and the rest of the green onions.

recipes.name: Chicken stir fry
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) boneless skinless chicken breast
1/4 cup (60 ml) water or chicken broth
steps: Cut the chicken into thin strips and the pepper and carrot into thin slices. Ask an adult to help.
Toss the chicken with 1 tablespoon of the cornstarch.
Whisk the soy sauce, water, honey, sesame oil and the rest of the cornstarch in a small bowl.
Heat 1 tablespoon of the oil in a big pan over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook for 5 to 6 minutes, until no pink is left inside.
Move the chicken to a plate.
Add the rest of the oil and the vegetables and cook for 3 to 4 minutes, until crisp-tender.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook for 30 seconds.
Add the chicken and sauce and cook for 1 to 2 minutes, stirring, until the sauce thickens.
Serve over rice.

recipes.name: Classic cheeseburgers
steps: Slice the tomato and onion. Ask an adult to help.
Divide the beef into 4 balls and flatten each into a patty about 3/4 inch thick.
Press a small dent in the middle of each patty with your thumb.
Sprinkle both sides with salt and pepper, then wash your hands.
Heat a heavy frying pan over medium-high heat.
Cook the patties for 4 minutes.
Flip and cook for 3 minutes.
Put a slice of cheese on each, cover the pan, and cook for 1 minute more, until 160°F (71°C) inside.
Put each patty on a bun with lettuce, tomato, onion, ketchup and mustard.

recipes.name: Baked meatballs in tomato sauce
ingredients: Cooked spaghetti or rolls to serve
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Mix the breadcrumbs and milk in a big bowl and let soak for 5 minutes.
Add the beef, egg, parmesan, garlic, seasoning, salt and pepper and mix gently with your hands.
Roll into 1 1/2 inch balls and set them on the sheet, then wash your hands.
Bake for 18 to 20 minutes, until browned and 160°F (71°C) inside.
Warm the sauce in a big pot over medium heat.
Add the meatballs and simmer for 10 minutes.
Serve over spaghetti or in rolls.

recipes.name: Beef and bean chili
ingredients: 1 can (15 oz / 425 g) kidney beans, drained
1 can (15 oz / 425 g) black beans, drained
1 cup (240 ml) beef broth or water
Shredded cheese and sour cream to serve
steps: Chop the onion, bell pepper and garlic. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pot over medium heat.
Add the onion and pepper and cook for 5 minutes, until soft.
Add the beef and garlic and cook for 6 to 8 minutes, breaking it up, until browned.
Stir in the chili powder, cumin, oregano, salt and tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, beans and broth and stir.
Bring to a boil, then turn the heat down to low.
Simmer for 45 minutes, stirring now and then.
Taste, add more salt if needed, and serve with cheese and sour cream.

recipes.name: Chicken noodle soup
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) boneless skinless chicken breasts
steps: Chop the onion, carrots, celery and garlic. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pot over medium heat.
Add the vegetables and cook for 5 to 7 minutes, until soft.
Add the broth, thyme, bay leaf and whole chicken breasts.
Bring to a boil, then turn the heat down to low.
Simmer for 15 to 20 minutes, until the chicken is 165°F (74°C) inside.
Lift the chicken onto a plate and shred it with two forks.
Add the noodles to the pot and simmer for 6 to 8 minutes, until tender.
Stir the chicken back in, take out the bay leaf, and add salt, pepper and parsley.

recipes.name: Creamy tomato soup
ingredients: 1 can (28 oz / 800 g) whole peeled tomatoes
2 cups (480 ml) chicken or vegetable broth
steps: Chop the onion and garlic. Ask an adult to help.
Melt the butter in a big pot over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook for 5 to 7 minutes, until soft.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes with their juice, the broth, sugar and salt.
Simmer for 20 minutes, stirring now and then.
Blend the soup in the pot with a stick blender until smooth.
Stir in the cream, taste, and add more salt if needed.

recipes.name: Lemon garlic baked salmon
ingredients: 2 tablespoons olive oil or melted butter
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Line a baking dish with foil or parchment paper.
Pat the salmon dry and lay it skin side down in the dish.
Mix the oil, garlic, juice of half the lemon, salt, pepper and dill in a small bowl.
Brush the mix over the salmon and lay thin lemon slices on top.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, until it flakes with a fork and is 145°F (63°C) inside.
Let rest for 3 minutes before serving.

recipes.name: Roast chicken
ingredients: 1 whole chicken (4 to 5 lb / 1.8 to 2.3 kg)
2 tablespoons olive oil or soft butter
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Ask an adult to help.
Take out any bag from inside the chicken and pat it dry with paper towels.
Put the chicken breast side up in a roasting pan.
Rub the oil all over and sprinkle with salt, pepper and thyme.
Put the lemon, garlic and onion inside the chicken.
Wash your hands and anything that touched the raw chicken.
Roast for 1 hour 15 minutes, until the thickest part of the thigh is 165°F (74°C).
Let rest for 15 minutes before carving.

recipes.name: Garlic bread
ingredients: 1 loaf French or Italian bread (about 1 lb / 450 g)
4 garlic cloves, grated (or 1 teaspoon garlic powder)
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Mix the butter, garlic, parsley and salt in a bowl.
Cut the loaf in half the long way.
Spread the garlic butter over the cut sides and sprinkle with parmesan.
Lay the bread cut side up on a baking sheet.
Bake for 10 to 12 minutes, until the edges are golden.
Let cool for 2 minutes before slicing.

recipes.name: Creamy mashed potatoes
ingredients: 3 lb (1.4 kg) Yukon Gold or russet potatoes
steps: Peel the potatoes and cut them into 2 inch chunks. Ask an adult to help.
Put them in a big pot, cover with cold water and add the salt.
Bring to a boil over high heat, then turn it down to medium.
Simmer for 15 to 20 minutes, until a fork slides in easily.
Drain the potatoes and put them back in the pot.
Microwave the milk and butter in a jug for 1 minute, until the butter melts.
Mash the potatoes with a masher.
Stir in the milk and butter, then add salt and pepper to taste.

recipes.name: Roast vegetables
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dried thyme or Italian seasoning
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Ask an adult to help.
Cut the potatoes and carrots into 1 inch pieces.
Cut the pepper, onion and zucchini into bigger 1 1/2 inch pieces.
Toss the potatoes and carrots with 2 tablespoons of oil, the salt, pepper, herbs and garlic powder on a big baking sheet.
Roast for 15 minutes.
Toss the pepper, onion and zucchini with the rest of the oil.
Add them to the pan and stir everything together.
Roast for 20 to 25 minutes, until browned and tender.

recipes.name: Caesar salad
ingredients: 1/3 cup (30 g) grated parmesan, plus more to serve
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Ask an adult to help.
Toss the bread cubes with the olive oil and salt on a baking sheet.
Bake for 10 to 12 minutes, until golden and crisp.
Whisk the mayonnaise, lemon juice, parmesan, garlic, mustard, Worcestershire sauce and pepper in a bowl.
Wash and dry the lettuce and tear it into bite-size pieces.
Toss the lettuce with the dressing in a big bowl.
Top with the croutons and more parmesan.

recipes.name: Chocolate chip cookies
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Ask an adult to help.
Whisk the flour, baking soda and salt in a bowl.
Beat the butter, sugar and brown sugar in a big bowl until creamy.
Beat in the eggs one at a time, then the vanilla.
Slowly stir in the flour mix.
Stir in the chocolate chips.
Scoop balls of dough about 2 tablespoons big onto a baking sheet, 2 inches apart.
Bake for 9 to 11 minutes, until the edges are golden.
Let cool for 2 minutes on the sheet.
Move the cookies to a wire rack.

recipes.name: Fudgy brownies
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Grease an 8 by 8 inch pan and line it with parchment paper.
Put the butter in a big microwave-safe bowl and microwave for 45 to 60 seconds, until melted.
Stir in the sugar, eggs and vanilla.
Add the cocoa, flour, salt and baking powder and stir until just combined.
Stir in the chocolate chips.
Spread the batter evenly in the pan.
Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, until a toothpick in the middle comes out with a few moist crumbs.
Let cool for 30 minutes before cutting into squares.

recipes.name: Vanilla cupcakes
ingredients: Frosting: 1/2 cup (115 g) soft butter, 2 cups (240 g) powdered sugar, 2 tablespoons milk, 1 teaspoon vanilla
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Line a 12-cup muffin pan with paper liners.
Whisk the flour, baking powder and salt in a bowl.
Beat the butter and sugar in a big bowl until light and fluffy.
Beat in the eggs and vanilla.
Mix in half the flour mix, then the milk, then the rest of the flour mix.
Fill each liner about 2/3 full.
Bake for 18 to 20 minutes, until a toothpick in the middle comes out clean.
Let cool for 1 hour.
Beat the frosting ingredients until smooth and spread it on the cupcakes.

recipes.name: Banana muffins
ingredients: 3/4 cup (150 g) sugar or brown sugar
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Line a 12-cup muffin pan with paper liners.
Mash the bananas in a big bowl with a fork.
Stir in the melted butter, sugar, egg and vanilla.
Sprinkle the baking soda, cinnamon and salt over the mix and stir.
Stir in the flour until just combined.
Spoon the batter into the liners, about 3/4 full.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until a toothpick in the middle comes out clean.
Let cool for 10 minutes in the pan.

recipes.name: Sugar cookies
ingredients: 1/4 cup (50 g) extra sugar for rolling
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Ask an adult to help.
Whisk the flour, baking soda, baking powder and salt in a bowl.
Beat the butter and sugar in a big bowl until smooth.
Beat in the egg and vanilla.
Slowly stir in the flour mix.
Roll the dough into 1 tablespoon balls and roll each ball in the extra sugar.
Set them 2 inches apart on an ungreased baking sheet.
Bake for 8 to 10 minutes, until the edges are just light golden.
Let cool for 2 minutes on the sheet.
Move the cookies to a wire rack.

recipes.name: Crispy rice treats
ingredients: 3 tablespoons (45 g) butter, plus more for the pan
1 bag (10 oz / 283 g) mini marshmallows, about 6 cups
steps: Grease a 9 by 13 inch pan with butter.
Melt the butter in a big pot over low heat.
Add the marshmallows and cook for 3 to 4 minutes, stirring, until melted.
Take the pot off the heat.
Stir in the cereal until it is all coated.
Press the mix evenly into the pan with a buttered spatula.
Let cool for 30 minutes.
Cut into 24 squares. Ask an adult to help.

recipes.name: No-bake cheesecake
steps: Mix the cracker crumbs, melted butter and sugar in a bowl.
Press the crumbs firmly into the bottom and sides of a 9 inch pie plate.
Chill for 15 minutes.
Whip the cold cream in a bowl until it holds stiff peaks.
In another bowl, beat the cream cheese, powdered sugar, vanilla and lemon juice until smooth.
Gently fold the whipped cream into the cream cheese mix.
Spread the filling over the crust.
Chill for 6 hours, until firm.
Slice and top with berries. Ask an adult to help.

recipes.name: Apple crumble
ingredients: 1/2 cup (115 g) cold butter, cut in cubes
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Ask an adult to help.
Peel the apples, cut out the cores and slice them thin.
Toss the apples with the sugar, lemon juice, cinnamon and flour in an 8 by 8 inch baking dish.
Mix the topping flour, oats, brown sugar, cinnamon and salt in a bowl.
Rub the butter into the topping with your fingertips until it looks like crumbs.
Sprinkle the topping over the apples.
Bake for 40 to 45 minutes, until golden and bubbling.
Let cool for 10 minutes before serving.

recipes.name: Chocolate cake
ingredients: Frosting: 2/3 cup (55 g) unsweetened cocoa powder
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Grease two 9 inch round cake pans (or one 9 by 13 inch pan), dust them with flour and line the bottoms with parchment paper.
In a big bowl, whisk the sugar, flour, cocoa, baking powder, baking soda and salt.
Add the eggs, milk, oil and vanilla, and beat with a mixer on medium speed for 2 minutes.
Have an adult pour in the boiling water, and stir it in. The batter will be very thin, and that's normal.
Pour the batter evenly into the pans.
Bake for 30 to 35 minutes, until a toothpick in the middle comes out clean. A 9 by 13 inch pan needs 35 to 40 minutes.
Let the cakes cool in the pans for 10 minutes, then turn them out onto a wire rack.
Let them cool completely for about 1 hour before frosting, or the frosting will melt.
For the frosting, beat the soft butter until smooth, then beat in the cocoa.
Add the powdered sugar a little at a time, with a splash of the milk between each, until it's thick and spreadable. Stir in the vanilla.
Put one cake on a plate, spread frosting on top, add the second cake, then frost the top and sides.

recipes.name: Chocolate mug cake
steps: Get out a big microwave-safe mug, at least 12 oz (350 ml).
Stir the flour, cocoa, sugar, baking powder and salt in the mug with a fork.
Add the milk, oil and vanilla and stir until there are no dry spots.
Drop the chocolate chips on top.
Microwave for 70 to 90 seconds, until the top looks set.
Let cool for 2 minutes. The mug will be hot.

recipes.name: Homemade lemonade
ingredients: 1 cup (240 ml) water for the syrup
1 cup (240 ml) fresh lemon juice, from 5 to 6 lemons
Ice and lemon slices to serve
steps: Put the sugar and 1 cup of water in a small pot.
Heat over medium heat for 3 to 5 minutes, stirring, until the sugar dissolves.
Let cool for 20 minutes.
Cut the lemons in half. Ask an adult to help.
Squeeze the juice and pour it through a strainer to catch the seeds.
Pour the syrup, lemon juice and cold water into a pitcher and stir.
Chill for 1 hour.
Serve over ice with lemon slices.

recipes.name: Hot chocolate
ingredients: Marshmallows or whipped cream to serve
steps: Whisk the cocoa, sugar, salt and a splash of the milk in a small pot into a smooth paste.
Whisk in the rest of the milk.
Heat over medium heat for 4 to 5 minutes, whisking, until steaming. Do not let it boil.
Stir in the chocolate chips and vanilla until melted.
Pour into mugs and top with marshmallows or whipped cream.

recipes.name: Soft dinner rolls
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups (440 g) all-purpose or bread flour, plus more if sticky
steps: Mix the flour, yeast, sugar and salt in a big bowl.
Add the warm milk, egg and soft butter and stir into a shaggy dough.
Knead on a floured counter for 8 to 10 minutes, until smooth and springy.
Put the dough in a greased bowl and cover it.
Let rise for 1 hour, until doubled.
Grease a 9 by 13 inch pan, divide the dough into 12 pieces and roll each into a ball in the pan.
Cover and let rise for 30 to 45 minutes, until puffy.
Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until golden brown.
Brush the hot rolls with melted butter.

recipes.name: Blueberry pancakes
ingredients: 3 tablespoons (45 g) butter, melted, plus more for the pan
1 cup (150 g) fresh or frozen blueberries
steps: Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder and salt in a big bowl.
In another bowl, whisk the milk, egg and melted butter.
Pour the wet mix into the dry mix and stir until just combined. A few lumps are fine.
Heat a frying pan over medium heat and melt a little butter in it.
Pour 1/4 cup of batter into the pan for each pancake.
Drop 6 to 8 blueberries onto each pancake right away.
Cook for 2 to 3 minutes, until bubbles pop on top.
Flip and cook for 1 to 2 minutes more, until golden.
Serve with maple syrup.

recipes.name: Banana oat pancakes
ingredients: Butter or oil for the pan
steps: Put the bananas, eggs, oats, baking powder, cinnamon and salt in a blender.
Blend for 30 seconds, until smooth.
Let the batter rest for 5 minutes so the oats soften.
Heat a frying pan over medium-low heat and add a little butter.
Pour 3 tablespoons of batter into the pan for each pancake.
Cook for 2 to 3 minutes, until the edges look set.
Flip gently and cook for 1 to 2 minutes more.
Serve with sliced banana or yogurt.

recipes.name: Pumpkin spice pancakes
ingredients: 2 tablespoons (30 g) butter, melted, plus more for the pan
steps: Whisk the flour, brown sugar, baking powder, spice and salt in a big bowl.
In another bowl, whisk the milk, pumpkin, egg and melted butter.
Stir the wet mix into the dry mix until just combined. The batter is thick.
Heat a frying pan over medium-low heat and melt a little butter in it.
Scoop 1/4 cup of batter into the pan for each pancake and spread it a little.
Cook for 3 minutes, until the edges look dry.
Flip and cook for 2 minutes more, until cooked through.
Serve with maple syrup and a little whipped cream.

recipes.name: Dutch baby pancake
ingredients: Powdered sugar and lemon wedges to serve
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C) with a 10 inch cast iron pan inside. Ask an adult to help.
Blend the eggs, milk, flour, sugar, salt and vanilla for 30 seconds, until smooth.
Have an adult take the hot pan out with oven mitts.
Add the butter and swirl until it melts and coats the pan.
Pour in the batter right away.
Bake for 18 to 20 minutes, until puffed and golden brown. Don't open the oven early.
Dust with powdered sugar and squeeze lemon on top. It will sink as it cools, that's normal.

recipes.name: French crepes
ingredients: 2 tablespoons (30 g) butter, melted, plus more for the pan
Fillings like strawberries, banana, chocolate hazelnut spread or lemon and sugar
steps: Blend or whisk the flour, eggs, milk, water, melted butter, sugar and salt until smooth.
Let the batter rest for 15 minutes.
Heat an 8 inch nonstick pan over medium heat and brush it with butter.
Pour in 1/4 cup of batter and quickly tilt the pan so it covers the bottom in a thin layer.
Cook for 1 to 2 minutes, until the edges lift and the bottom has light brown spots.
Loosen with a spatula, flip and cook for 30 seconds more.
Stack the crepes on a plate and repeat with the rest of the batter.
Fill, fold into triangles or roll up, and serve.

recipes.name: Baked French toast casserole
ingredients: 1 loaf (1 lb / 450 g) brioche or French bread, cut in 1 inch cubes
steps: Butter a 9 by 13 inch baking dish and spread the bread cubes in it.
Whisk the eggs, milk, 1/4 cup of the brown sugar, vanilla, 1 teaspoon cinnamon and salt.
Pour the egg mix over the bread and press down so it all soaks.
Cover and chill for at least 30 minutes, or overnight.
Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Mix the melted butter, the rest of the brown sugar and the rest of the cinnamon and drizzle it over the top.
Bake for 40 to 45 minutes, until puffed, golden and set in the middle.
Let it stand for 5 minutes, then serve with maple syrup.

recipes.name: Air fryer French toast sticks
steps: Cut each slice of bread into 3 sticks. Ask an adult to help.
Whisk the eggs, milk, sugar, cinnamon and vanilla in a shallow dish.
Heat the air fryer to 370°F (190°C) for 3 minutes.
Dip each stick in the egg mix for a second on each side. Don't let it get soggy.
Spray the basket and lay the sticks in one layer.
Air fry for 5 minutes.
Flip, spray the tops and air fry for 3 to 4 minutes more, until golden.
Serve with maple syrup for dipping.

recipes.name: Fried eggs
steps: Heat a nonstick pan over medium-low heat and melt the butter.
Crack each egg into a small cup first, then slide it into the pan.
Cook for 2 to 3 minutes, until the whites are set and the yolk is still runny. That's sunny side up.
For over easy, flip gently with a spatula and cook for 30 seconds more.
For over hard, flip and cook for 1 to 2 minutes, until the yolk is firm.
Sprinkle with salt and pepper and serve.

recipes.name: Hard boiled eggs
steps: Put the eggs in a pot in one layer and cover them with cold water by 1 inch.
Bring to a boil over high heat.
Turn off the heat, put the lid on, and let them sit for 11 minutes.
While they sit, fill a bowl with ice and cold water.
Move the eggs into the ice water with a spoon. Ask an adult to help with the hot water.
Cool for 5 minutes.
Tap each egg on the counter, roll it to crack the shell, and peel under running water.
Keep peeled or unpeeled eggs in the fridge for up to 1 week.

recipes.name: Soft boiled eggs with toast soldiers
ingredients: 4 large eggs, straight from the fridge
steps: Bring a small pot of water to a gentle boil.
Lower the eggs in gently with a spoon. Ask an adult to help.
Boil for 6 minutes for runny yolks, or 7 minutes for jammy yolks.
Meanwhile, toast the bread, butter it and cut it into strips.
Move the eggs to a bowl of cold water for 1 minute.
Set each egg in an egg cup and tap off the top with a spoon.
Sprinkle with salt and dip in the toast strips.

recipes.name: Poached eggs
steps: Fill a wide pot with about 3 inches of water and bring it to a gentle simmer, with small bubbles only.
Add the vinegar.
Crack each egg into its own small cup.
Stir the water to make a gentle swirl and slide one egg into the middle.
Add the other eggs around the edge of the pot.
Cook for 3 to 4 minutes, until the whites are set and the yolks are soft.
Lift out each egg with a slotted spoon and let it drain on a paper towel. Ask an adult to help.
Serve on toast with salt and pepper.

recipes.name: Eggs Benedict
ingredients: 8 very fresh large eggs, plus 3 egg yolks for the sauce
steps: Melt the butter in the microwave for 45 seconds, until hot and bubbly.
Blend the egg yolks, lemon juice and salt for 5 seconds.
With the blender running, slowly pour in the hot butter until the sauce is thick. Ask an adult to help.
Brown the Canadian bacon in a frying pan over medium heat for 1 to 2 minutes per side.
Toast the English muffins.
Poach the eggs in simmering water with the vinegar for 3 to 4 minutes, until the whites are set.
Put bacon on each muffin half, then a poached egg.
Spoon the sauce over the top and sprinkle with cayenne.

recipes.name: Denver omelette
steps: Dice the ham, pepper and onion. Ask an adult to help.
Whisk the eggs, milk and salt.
Melt half the butter in a nonstick pan over medium heat.
Cook the ham, pepper and onion for 3 to 4 minutes, until soft. Move them to a plate.
Melt the rest of the butter and pour in half the eggs.
Cook for 1 to 2 minutes, lifting the edges so runny egg flows under, until almost set.
Scatter half the filling and half the cheese over one side.
Fold the omelette in half and cook for 30 seconds more. Repeat for the second omelette.

recipes.name: Veggie frittata
ingredients: 1 cup (100 g) shredded cheddar or crumbled feta
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Chop the onion and pepper.
Whisk the eggs, milk, salt and pepper in a bowl.
Heat the oil in a 10 inch oven-safe pan over medium heat.
Cook the onion and pepper for 5 minutes, until soft.
Add the spinach and stir for 1 minute, until wilted.
Pour in the eggs and sprinkle the cheese on top.
Cook without stirring for 2 to 3 minutes, until the edges start to set.
Move the pan to the oven and bake for 12 to 15 minutes, until the middle is set.
Let it cool for 5 minutes, then slice into wedges. Use oven mitts, the handle is hot.

recipes.name: Shakshuka
ingredients: Crumbled feta, chopped parsley and bread to serve
steps: Chop the onion, pepper and garlic. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pan over medium heat.
Cook the onion and pepper for 6 to 8 minutes, until soft.
Add the garlic and spices and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and salt and simmer for 10 minutes, until a little thick.
Make 6 small wells in the sauce with a spoon and crack an egg into each.
Cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 minutes, until the whites are set.
Top with feta and parsley and serve with bread for dipping.

recipes.name: Huevos rancheros
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable oil, plus more for the eggs
Crumbled queso fresco, avocado and cilantro to serve
steps: Chop the onion, garlic and jalapeno. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a saucepan over medium heat and cook the onion for 4 minutes.
Add the garlic, jalapeno, tomatoes, cumin and salt and simmer for 10 minutes. This is the ranchero sauce.
Warm the refried beans in a small pot or the microwave.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan for 30 seconds per side.
Fry the eggs in a little oil for 2 to 3 minutes, until the whites are set.
Put 2 tortillas on each plate, spread with beans and top with 2 eggs.
Spoon the sauce over and add queso fresco, avocado and cilantro.

recipes.name: Breakfast burritos
ingredients: 2 cups (300 g) frozen diced hash brown potatoes
steps: Cook the sausage in a big pan over medium heat for 6 to 8 minutes, breaking it up, until browned.
Add the potatoes and cook for 8 to 10 minutes, stirring, until crispy.
Whisk the eggs, milk and salt.
Push the sausage mix to one side and pour the eggs in the empty side.
Stir the eggs gently for 2 to 3 minutes, until just set, then mix everything together.
Warm the tortillas in the microwave for 20 seconds.
Fill each tortilla with the egg mix and cheese.
Fold in the sides and roll up tightly. Serve with salsa.

recipes.name: Potato and egg breakfast tacos
ingredients: 2 medium potatoes, cut in 1/2 inch cubes
steps: Cut the potatoes into small cubes. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big nonstick pan over medium heat.
Add the potatoes, half the salt and the garlic powder.
Cover and cook for 10 to 12 minutes, stirring now and then, until soft and browned.
Whisk the eggs with the rest of the salt and pour them over the potatoes.
Stir gently for 2 to 3 minutes, until the eggs are just set.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan for 20 seconds per side.
Fill each tortilla with the potato and egg, then add cheese and salsa.

recipes.name: Chilaquiles rojos
aliases: tortilla chips with salsa and eggs
ingredients: 2 cups (480 ml) red enchilada sauce or salsa roja
1/2 cup (120 ml) chicken or vegetable broth
1/2 cup (60 g) crumbled queso fresco or cotija
1/4 cup (60 ml) sour cream or Mexican crema
steps: Slice the onion. Ask an adult to help.
Warm the sauce and broth in a big pan over medium heat for 3 to 4 minutes, until simmering.
Add the chips and toss gently to coat.
Cook for 1 to 2 minutes, until the chips soften a little but still have some crunch.
In another pan, fry the eggs in the oil for 2 to 3 minutes, until the whites are set.
Spoon the chips onto plates and top each with a fried egg.
Add the cheese, crema, onion and cilantro. Eat right away.

recipes.name: Tex-Mex migas
ingredients: 4 small corn tortillas, cut in strips
3/4 cup (75 g) shredded Monterey Jack cheese
Salsa and warm tortillas to serve
steps: Cut the tortillas into strips and chop the vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big nonstick pan over medium-high heat.
Fry the tortilla strips for 3 to 4 minutes, stirring, until crisp.
Add the onion and jalapeno and cook for 3 minutes.
Add the tomato and cook for 1 minute.
Whisk the eggs with the salt and pour them in.
Turn the heat to medium and stir gently for 2 to 3 minutes, until just set.
Sprinkle the cheese on top and serve with salsa or in warm tortillas.

recipes.name: Baked egg muffin cups
ingredients: 1 cup (150 g) diced ham or cooked crumbled bacon
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Spray a 12 cup muffin pan well.
Divide the ham, spinach, pepper and cheese between the cups.
Whisk the eggs, milk, salt and pepper and pour into the cups until each is 3/4 full.
Bake for 20 to 22 minutes, until puffed and set in the middle.
Cool for 5 minutes, then run a butter knife around each one and lift out.
Keep extras in the fridge for up to 4 days and microwave for 30 seconds to warm.

recipes.name: Egg in a hole
steps: Cut a 2 1/2 inch hole in the middle of each slice with a cup or cookie cutter.
Melt half the butter in a nonstick pan over medium heat.
Put the bread slices and the cut-out circles in the pan.
Crack an egg into each hole.
Cook for 2 to 3 minutes, until the bottom is golden and the egg white is mostly set.
Add the rest of the butter, flip carefully, and cook for 1 to 2 minutes more.
Sprinkle with salt and pepper and use the toasted circles for dipping.

recipes.name: Tamagoyaki Japanese rolled omelette
steps: Whisk the eggs, sugar, soy sauce, water and salt until smooth but not foamy.
Heat a nonstick pan (square if you have one) over medium-low heat and wipe it with oil on a paper towel.
Pour in a thin layer of egg and tilt the pan to cover the bottom.
Cook for 30 seconds to 1 minute, until just set on top.
Roll the egg from the far side toward you with chopsticks or a spatula.
Push the roll back to the far side, oil the pan again, and pour in another thin layer, lifting the roll so egg flows under it.
Roll it up again when set. Repeat until all the egg is used.
Let it rest for 2 minutes on a cutting board, then slice into thick pieces.

recipes.name: Korean steamed egg
ingredients: 3/4 cup (180 ml) water or chicken broth
steps: Slice the green onion. Ask an adult to help.
Whisk the eggs, water and salt until smooth.
Pour into a small pot or earthenware bowl and set it over medium heat.
Stir gently for 2 to 3 minutes, until it starts to thicken like soft curds.
Stir in most of the green onion.
Turn the heat to low, cover with a lid and cook for 3 to 4 minutes, until puffed and set.
Drizzle with sesame oil, sprinkle with sesame seeds and the rest of the green onion. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Masala omelette
ingredients: 1 green chili, seeded and finely chopped (optional)
steps: Finely chop the onion, tomato, chili and cilantro. Ask an adult to help.
Whisk the eggs with the vegetables, turmeric, salt and chili powder.
Heat half the oil in a nonstick pan over medium heat.
Pour in half the egg mix and spread it out.
Cook for 2 minutes, until the bottom is golden and the top is nearly set.
Flip and cook for 1 minute more.
Repeat with the rest. Serve with toast or roti.

recipes.name: Egg bhurji Indian scrambled eggs
steps: Chop the onion, tomato and chili. Ask an adult to help.
Melt the butter in a pan over medium heat.
Cook the onion for 3 to 4 minutes, until soft.
Add the ginger, chili, tomato, turmeric, garam masala and salt and cook for 3 minutes, until the tomato is soft.
Whisk the eggs and pour them in.
Stir slowly for 2 to 3 minutes, until the eggs are just set.
Top with cilantro and serve with toast, roti or pav buns.

recipes.name: Turkish menemen
ingredients: 1 green bell pepper or 2 mild long peppers, chopped
3 ripe tomatoes, chopped, or 1 can (14.5 oz / 410 g) diced tomatoes
steps: Chop the peppers and tomatoes. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat.
Cook the peppers for 4 to 5 minutes, until soft.
Add the tomatoes, salt and paprika and cook for 8 to 10 minutes, until thick and saucy.
Crack the eggs into the pan and gently stir them through.
Cook for 2 to 3 minutes, stirring now and then, until the eggs are softly set.
Serve hot in the pan with bread for scooping.

recipes.name: Cilbir Turkish poached eggs with yogurt
ingredients: 1 cup (240 g) plain Greek yogurt, at room temperature
Fresh dill and bread to serve
steps: Stir the yogurt, garlic and salt together and spread it on 2 plates.
Poach the eggs in gently simmering water with the vinegar for 3 to 4 minutes. Ask an adult to help.
Lift out the eggs with a slotted spoon and set them on the yogurt.
Melt the butter in a small pan over medium heat for 1 to 2 minutes, until it sizzles and smells nutty.
Stir the Aleppo pepper into the butter and spoon it over the eggs.
Top with dill and serve with warm bread.

recipes.name: Bacon, egg and cheese sandwich
ingredients: 2 kaiser rolls or English muffins, split
steps: Cook the bacon in a cold pan set over medium heat for 8 to 10 minutes, flipping, until crisp. Ask an adult to help with the hot fat.
Drain the bacon on paper towels and pour off most of the fat.
Toast the rolls.
Melt the butter in the pan and fry the eggs for 2 to 3 minutes, breaking the yolks if you like them firm.
Flip each egg, top with a slice of cheese, and cook for 1 minute, until the cheese melts.
Put each egg on a roll with 2 slices of bacon. Add salt, pepper and ketchup if you like.

recipes.name: Sausage and egg English muffin
steps: Shape the sausage into 4 thin patties a little wider than the muffins, then wash your hands.
Cook the patties in a pan over medium heat for 3 to 4 minutes per side, until 160°F (71°C) inside.
Toast the English muffins.
Wipe the pan, add the oil, and set 4 greased canning lids or egg rings in it, if you have them.
Crack an egg into each ring, break the yolk, and add 1 tablespoon of water to the pan.
Cover and cook for 3 minutes, until the eggs are set.
Stack a patty, cheese and egg in each muffin.

recipes.name: Breakfast quesadilla
ingredients: 1 cup (100 g) shredded cheddar or Monterey Jack
2 slices cooked bacon or ham, chopped (optional)
steps: Whisk the eggs and salt.
Melt the butter in a nonstick pan over medium-low heat and scramble the eggs for 2 minutes, until just set. Move them to a plate.
Lay a tortilla in the pan and sprinkle cheese over half of it.
Add half the eggs and bacon, then a little more cheese.
Fold the tortilla over.
Cook for 2 minutes per side, until golden and the cheese melts.
Repeat with the other tortilla. Cut into wedges and serve with salsa.

recipes.name: Creamy stovetop oatmeal
ingredients: 1 tablespoon maple syrup or brown sugar
Toppings like banana, berries, peanut butter or nuts
steps: Put the oats, milk, water and salt in a small pot.
Bring to a simmer over medium heat, stirring.
Turn the heat to low and cook for 5 minutes, stirring often, until thick and creamy.
Take off the heat and stir in the maple syrup and cinnamon.
Let it stand for 1 minute to thicken.
Spoon into bowls and add your toppings.

recipes.name: Blueberry baked oatmeal
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Ask an adult to help.
Butter an 8 inch square baking dish.
Mix the oats, baking powder, cinnamon and salt in a big bowl.
In another bowl, whisk the milk, egg, maple syrup, melted butter and vanilla.
Spread the oat mix in the dish and scatter the blueberries on top.
Pour the milk mix evenly over everything.
Bake for 35 to 40 minutes, until the top is golden and the middle is set.
Cool for 10 minutes before cutting into squares.

recipes.name: Slow cooker steel cut oats
ingredients: 2 tablespoons maple syrup, plus more to serve
Butter or coconut oil for the slow cooker
steps: Grease the inside of the slow cooker with butter so the oats don't stick.
Peel and dice the apple. Ask an adult to help.
Add the oats, water, milk, apple, cinnamon, salt and maple syrup and stir.
Cover and cook on low for 7 to 8 hours, or overnight.
Stir well in the morning. Add a splash of milk if it's too thick.
Serve with more maple syrup and nuts or berries.

recipes.name: Homemade honey granola
ingredients: 1 cup (120 g) chopped nuts or seeds
1/3 cup (80 ml) honey or maple syrup
1/3 cup (80 ml) vegetable or melted coconut oil
1/2 cup (75 g) raisins or dried cranberries
steps: Heat the oven to 325°F (165°C). Ask an adult to help.
Line a big baking sheet with parchment paper.
Mix the oats, nuts, cinnamon and salt in a big bowl.
Warm the honey and oil in the microwave for 20 seconds, then stir in the vanilla.
Pour it over the oats and stir until everything is coated.
Spread it on the sheet and press it down flat with a spatula.
Bake for 20 minutes, turn the pan, and bake for 5 to 10 minutes more, until golden.
Let it cool completely on the pan without stirring, so it forms clusters.
Break into pieces, mix in the raisins and keep in a sealed jar for up to 2 weeks.

recipes.name: Chia seed pudding
ingredients: 1 cup (240 ml) milk or almond milk
Berries, mango or banana to serve
steps: Stir the chia seeds, milk, maple syrup and vanilla in a jar or bowl.
Let it sit for 5 minutes, then stir again to break up clumps.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours, or overnight, until thick like pudding.
Stir, spoon into bowls and top with fruit.

recipes.name: Bircher muesli
steps: Grate the apple on the big holes of a box grater, skin and all. Ask an adult to help.
Mix the oats, apple juice, milk and grated apple in a bowl.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours, or overnight.
Stir in the yogurt and honey.
Top with nuts or raisins and serve cold.

recipes.name: Yogurt parfait
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups (360 g) vanilla or plain Greek yogurt
steps: Wash the berries and slice any strawberries. Ask an adult to help.
Spoon a layer of yogurt into the bottom of 2 glasses or jars.
Add a layer of berries, then a layer of granola.
Repeat the layers until the glass is full.
Drizzle with honey and eat right away so the granola stays crunchy.

recipes.name: Acai smoothie bowl
ingredients: 2 packets (7 oz / 200 g) frozen unsweetened acai puree
1/3 cup (80 ml) milk or apple juice
Toppings: granola, sliced banana, berries, coconut flakes and honey
steps: Run the acai packets under warm water for 10 seconds and break them into pieces.
Put the acai, banana, berries and milk in a blender.
Blend on low, stopping to push it down, until thick and smooth like soft ice cream. Add a splash more milk only if needed.
Spoon into 2 bowls.
Arrange the toppings in rows on top and eat right away.

recipes.name: Avocado toast
ingredients: 1 fried or poached egg per toast (optional)
steps: Toast the bread until golden.
Cut the avocado in half, take out the pit, and scoop the flesh into a bowl. Ask an adult to help with the knife.
Mash with a fork with the lemon juice and salt.
Spread the avocado thickly on the toast.
Top with chili flakes and an egg if you like.

recipes.name: Cinnamon sugar toast
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Mix the sugar and cinnamon in a small bowl.
Spread the butter all the way to the edges of each slice.
Sprinkle the cinnamon sugar evenly over the butter.
Lay the slices on a baking sheet and bake for 8 to 10 minutes, until bubbly and crisp.
Let it cool for 1 minute, the sugar is very hot.

recipes.name: Crispy hash browns
steps: Peel the potatoes and grate them on the big holes of a box grater. Ask an adult to help.
Put the grated potato in a clean kitchen towel and squeeze out as much water as you can.
Toss with the salt and pepper.
Heat the oil and butter in a big nonstick pan over medium-high heat.
Spread the potato in a thin, even layer and press it down.
Cook without stirring for 5 to 6 minutes, until deep golden on the bottom.
Cut into 4 pieces with the spatula, flip, and cook for 4 to 5 minutes more, until crispy.

recipes.name: Home fries breakfast potatoes
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) Yukon gold potatoes, cut in 3/4 inch cubes
steps: Cut the potatoes, onion and pepper. Ask an adult to help.
Put the potatoes in a pot of salted water, bring to a boil and boil for 5 minutes, until just tender at the edges.
Drain well and let them steam dry for 2 minutes.
Heat the oil in a big pan over medium-high heat.
Add the potatoes and cook for 8 minutes, turning only now and then, until browned.
Add the onion, pepper and seasonings and cook for 6 to 8 minutes more, stirring, until the vegetables are soft.

recipes.name: Corned beef hash
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) potatoes, cut in 1/2 inch cubes
12 oz (340 g) cooked corned beef, chopped, or 1 can (12 oz / 340 g)
steps: Cut the potatoes and chop the onion. Ask an adult to help.
Boil the potatoes in salted water for 6 to 8 minutes, until just tender. Drain well.
Heat the oil and butter in a big pan over medium-high heat.
Add the onion and cook for 4 minutes.
Add the potatoes and corned beef and press it down.
Cook for 5 minutes without stirring, flip in sections, and cook for 5 minutes more, until crisp.
Make 4 wells in the hash and crack an egg into each.
Cover and cook on low for 4 to 5 minutes, until the whites are set.

recipes.name: Biscuits and sausage gravy
ingredients: 8 biscuits, homemade or from a can
steps: Bake the biscuits the way the package or recipe says.
Cook the sausage in a big pan over medium heat for 6 to 8 minutes, breaking it up, until browned with no pink.
Don't drain it. Sprinkle the flour over the sausage and stir for 1 minute.
Slowly pour in the milk, stirring all the time.
Simmer for 5 to 7 minutes, stirring, until thick.
Stir in the pepper and salt. Add a splash more milk if it gets too thick.
Split the biscuits and spoon the gravy over them.

recipes.name: Oven baked bacon
steps: Line a rimmed baking sheet with foil.
Lay the bacon on the sheet in one layer. It's fine if the slices touch.
Sprinkle with brown sugar and pepper if you want sweet and peppery bacon.
Put the pan in a cold oven and set it to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Bake for 17 to 22 minutes, until as crispy as you like.
Have an adult take the pan out, it's full of very hot fat.
Move the bacon to paper towels to drain.
Let the fat cool and harden on the foil, then fold it up and throw it away. Never pour it down the sink.

recipes.name: Air fryer bacon
ingredients: 1 slice of bread (optional, to catch grease)
steps: Put a slice of bread in the bottom drawer under the basket to soak up grease, if you like.
Lay the bacon in the basket in one layer. Cut the slices in half if they don't fit.
Air fry at 350°F (175°C) for 8 to 10 minutes, until as crispy as you like.
Check after 7 minutes because thin bacon cooks fast.
Lift out with tongs onto a paper towel. Ask an adult to help, the drawer has hot fat in it.

recipes.name: Homemade breakfast sausage patties
steps: Mix the pork, salt, herbs, spices and maple syrup in a bowl with your hands.
Shape into 12 thin patties about 2 1/2 inches wide, then wash your hands well.
Heat the oil in a big pan over medium heat.
Cook the patties for 3 to 4 minutes per side, until browned and 160°F (71°C) inside.
Drain on paper towels and serve.

recipes.name: Sausage and egg breakfast casserole
ingredients: 6 slices bread, cut in 1 inch cubes
1 teaspoon dry mustard or 2 teaspoons Dijon
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Cook the sausage in a pan over medium heat for 6 to 8 minutes, breaking it up, until browned. Drain the fat.
Butter a 9 by 13 inch baking dish.
Spread the bread cubes in the dish, then the sausage, then the cheese.
Whisk the eggs, milk, mustard, salt and pepper and pour it over the top.
Bake for 45 to 50 minutes, until puffed, golden and set in the middle.
Let it stand for 10 minutes before cutting.

recipes.name: Cheesy grits
ingredients: 1 cup (160 g) quick or old-fashioned grits (not instant)
steps: Bring the water, milk and salt to a boil in a pot over medium-high heat. Watch it so it doesn't boil over.
Slowly whisk in the grits.
Turn the heat to low, cover, and cook for 5 to 7 minutes for quick grits or 20 to 25 minutes for old-fashioned, stirring now and then.
Take off the heat and stir in the butter, cheese and pepper.
Add a splash of milk if they get too thick and serve hot. Careful, grits can spit when they bubble.

recipes.name: Chicken congee rice porridge
ingredients: 8 cups (2 liters) chicken broth or water
Toppings: sliced green onion, soy sauce, sesame oil, fried shallots or a soft boiled egg
steps: Rinse the rice in a strainer until the water runs clearer.
Put the rice, broth and ginger in a big pot and bring to a boil.
Add the whole chicken thighs.
Turn the heat to low, partly cover, and simmer for 20 minutes, until the chicken is 165°F (74°C) inside.
Lift the chicken out, shred it with two forks and set it aside.
Keep simmering the rice for 40 to 45 minutes more, stirring now and then, until thick and creamy.
Take out the ginger, stir in the chicken and salt, and add water if it's too thick.
Serve with green onion, a few drops of soy sauce and sesame oil.

recipes.name: Kanda poha
steps: Chop the onion and chili. Ask an adult to help.
Put the poha in a strainer and rinse under running water for 20 seconds, just until soft. Let it drain.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat and add the mustard seeds. Cover, they pop.
When they pop, add the curry leaves and peanuts and cook for 1 minute.
Add the onion and chili and cook for 3 to 4 minutes, until soft.
Stir in the turmeric, then the poha, salt and sugar.
Cover and cook on low for 2 to 3 minutes, until hot.
Stir in the lemon juice and top with cilantro.

recipes.name: Rava upma
ingredients: 1 cup (170 g) fine semolina (rava or sooji)
steps: Chop the onion. Ask an adult to help.
Toast the semolina in a dry pan over medium-low heat for 5 minutes, stirring, until it smells nutty. Pour it into a bowl.
Heat the ghee in the same pan and add the mustard seeds. When they pop, add the curry leaves.
Add the onion and ginger and cook for 3 minutes.
Add the vegetables, water and salt and bring to a boil.
Turn the heat to low and slowly pour in the semolina, stirring fast so no lumps form. Ask an adult to help, it can splatter.
Cover and cook for 2 to 3 minutes, until thick and fluffy.
Stir in the lemon juice and top with cilantro.

recipes.name: Besan chilla chickpea flour pancakes
ingredients: 3/4 cup (180 ml) water, plus a little more if needed
steps: Finely chop the onion, tomato, cilantro and chili. Ask an adult to help.
Whisk the besan, water, salt, turmeric and cumin into a smooth batter like thin pancake batter.
Stir in the vegetables and let it rest for 5 minutes.
Heat a nonstick pan over medium heat and brush it with oil.
Pour in 1/3 cup of batter and spread it into a thin circle with the back of the ladle.
Drizzle a few drops of oil around the edge and cook for 2 to 3 minutes, until the bottom is golden.
Flip and cook for 1 to 2 minutes more.
Serve hot with green chutney, ketchup or yogurt.

recipes.name: Aloo paratha potato stuffed flatbread
ingredients: 2 cups (250 g) whole wheat flour (atta), plus more for rolling
1/2 teaspoon salt, plus 3/4 teaspoon for the filling
1/2 teaspoon amchur (dry mango powder) or 1 teaspoon lemon juice
steps: Mix the flour and salt, then add water little by little and knead for 5 minutes into a soft dough.
Cover and rest for 20 minutes.
Boil the whole potatoes for 20 to 25 minutes, until a knife slides in. Ask an adult to help.
Peel the potatoes and mash them until smooth with no lumps.
Mix in the filling salt, spices, chili and cilantro.
Split the dough and filling into 4 balls each.
Roll a dough ball into a 4 inch circle, put a filling ball in the middle, and pinch the edges closed.
Flatten it, dust with flour and gently roll into a 7 inch circle.
Cook in a hot dry pan over medium heat for 1 minute, until spots appear, then flip.
Brush with ghee and cook for 1 to 2 minutes per side, pressing down, until golden. Serve with yogurt.

recipes.name: Ful medames
ingredients: 2 cans (15 oz / 425 g each) fava beans, with their liquid
3 tablespoons olive oil, plus more to serve
Chopped parsley, hard boiled eggs and warm pita to serve
steps: Put the beans and their liquid in a pot over medium heat.
Bring to a simmer and cook for 8 to 10 minutes.
Mash about half of the beans with a potato masher.
Stir in the olive oil, garlic, cumin, salt and lemon juice.
Spoon into bowls and top with tomato, parsley and a drizzle of olive oil.
Serve with eggs and warm pita for scooping.

recipes.name: Ackee and saltfish
ingredients: 1/4 scotch bonnet pepper, seeded and chopped (optional, very hot)
steps: Soak the salt cod in cold water for 30 minutes, then drain.
Boil it in fresh water for 15 minutes to take out more salt. Drain and flake into small pieces.
Slice and chop the vegetables. Ask an adult to help, and wear gloves for the scotch bonnet.
Heat the oil in a big pan over medium heat.
Cook the onion, peppers, garlic and scotch bonnet for 4 to 5 minutes, until soft.
Add the tomato, thyme and salt cod and cook for 3 minutes.
Gently fold in the ackee. It breaks easily.
Cook for 3 to 4 minutes, until hot, and season with black pepper. Serve with fried dumplings or boiled green bananas.

recipes.name: Jamaican fried dumplings
ingredients: 2 tablespoons (30 g) cold butter, in pieces
Vegetable oil for frying, about 1 inch deep
steps: Mix the flour, baking powder, sugar and salt.
Rub in the butter with your fingers until it looks like crumbs.
Add water little by little and knead into a soft, smooth dough.
Shape into 10 balls and flatten each slightly.
Have an adult heat 1 inch of oil in a heavy pan to 350°F (175°C).
Fry a few dumplings at a time for 3 to 4 minutes per side, until golden brown and cooked through. An adult should do the frying.
Drain on paper towels and serve warm with ackee and saltfish or butter.

recipes.name: Jamaican cornmeal porridge
ingredients: 1 cinnamon stick or 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon
1/4 cup (60 ml) sweetened condensed milk, or sugar to taste
steps: Stir the cornmeal into 1 cup of the water in a bowl until smooth.
Bring the rest of the water, coconut milk, salt and cinnamon to a boil in a pot.
Slowly pour in the cornmeal mix, whisking all the time so no lumps form.
Turn the heat to low and cook for 15 minutes, stirring often, until thick and smooth.
Stir in the nutmeg, vanilla and condensed milk.
Take out the cinnamon stick and serve hot.

recipes.name: Cheese arepas
ingredients: 2 cups (240 g) pre-cooked white cornmeal (masarepa, like P.A.N.)
Butter and extra cheese to serve
steps: Mix the masarepa and salt in a bowl.
Pour in the warm water and mix with your hands until there are no lumps.
Let it rest for 5 minutes, then knead in the mozzarella. It should feel like soft play dough.
Shape into 6 balls and flatten each into a disk about 1/2 inch thick.
Heat the oil in a big pan over medium heat.
Cook the arepas for 6 to 8 minutes per side, until a golden crust forms.
Split them open with a knife while warm and fill with butter and cheese. Ask an adult to help.

recipes.name: Gallo pinto
ingredients: 1 can (15 oz / 425 g) black beans, with 1/4 cup of their liquid
3 cups (500 g) cold cooked white rice
2 tablespoons Worcestershire sauce or Salsa Lizano
Fried eggs and sour cream to serve
steps: Chop the onion, pepper, garlic and cilantro. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pan over medium heat.
Cook the onion and pepper for 5 minutes, until soft.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the beans and their liquid and simmer for 3 minutes.
Add the rice, Worcestershire sauce and salt and stir for 4 to 5 minutes, until hot and the rice turns light brown.
Stir in the cilantro and serve with fried eggs.

recipes.name: Korean street toast
steps: Shred the cabbage, grate the carrot and slice the green onion. Ask an adult to help.
Whisk the eggs, vegetables and salt in a bowl.
Melt half the butter in a pan over medium heat and toast the bread for 1 to 2 minutes per side. Set it aside.
Melt the rest of the butter and spoon the egg mix into 2 square patties the size of the bread.
Cook for 2 to 3 minutes per side, until set.
Put the ham in the pan for 30 seconds per side to warm it.
On a slice of toast, stack an egg patty, ham and cheese.
Sprinkle with 1 teaspoon sugar, squeeze on ketchup, and top with a second slice.

recipes.name: Full English breakfast
ingredients: 4 slices back bacon or regular bacon
steps: Heat the oven to 200°F (93°C) to keep things warm. Ask an adult to help.
Cook the sausages in a big pan with the oil over medium heat for 12 to 15 minutes, turning, until browned and 160°F (71°C) inside. Keep them warm in the oven.
Cook the bacon in the same pan for 3 to 4 minutes per side. Keep it warm.
Cook the tomatoes cut side down and the mushrooms for 4 to 5 minutes, until soft.
Warm the beans in a small pot over low heat for 5 minutes.
Fry the eggs for 2 to 3 minutes and toast and butter the bread.
Put everything on 2 warm plates and season with salt and pepper.

recipes.name: Beans on toast
steps: Warm the beans in a small pot over medium-low heat for 4 to 5 minutes, stirring, until bubbling.
Toast the bread and butter it.
Spoon the beans over the toast.
Sprinkle with cheese and pepper and eat right away.

recipes.name: Strapatsada Greek tomato eggs
ingredients: 3 ripe tomatoes, grated on a box grater, skins thrown away
steps: Cut the tomatoes in half and grate the cut side on the big holes of a box grater. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the grated tomato, salt and oregano and cook for 8 to 10 minutes, until most of the liquid is gone.
Pour in the eggs and stir gently for 2 to 3 minutes, until softly set.
Take off the heat and stir in the feta.
Serve with bread.

recipes.name: Slow cooker hash brown breakfast casserole
ingredients: 1 bag (30 oz / 850 g) frozen shredded hash browns
steps: Chop the onion and pepper. Ask an adult to help.
Cook the sausage in a pan over medium heat for 6 to 8 minutes, breaking it up, until browned. Drain the fat.
Grease the slow cooker well.
Layer half the hash browns, half the sausage, half the vegetables and half the cheese. Repeat.
Whisk the eggs, milk, salt and pepper and pour it over the top.
Cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours, until the eggs are set in the middle.
Scoop out and serve.

recipes.name: Molletes
ingredients: 2 bolillo rolls or 1 small French baguette
1 1/2 cups (150 g) shredded Monterey Jack or Oaxaca cheese
Pico de gallo or salsa to serve
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Cut the rolls in half lengthwise and spread the cut sides with butter.
Toast them on a baking sheet for 5 minutes.
Spread each half with beans and cover with cheese.
Bake for 8 to 10 minutes, until the cheese melts and bubbles.
Top with pico de gallo and serve warm.

recipes.name: Huevos a la mexicana
ingredients: 1 jalapeno or serrano chili, seeded and finely chopped
Warm corn tortillas and refried beans to serve
steps: Chop the onion, tomato and chili. Ask an adult to help, and wash your hands after the chili.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat.
Cook the onion and chili for 2 to 3 minutes.
Add the tomato and cook for 2 minutes.
Beat the eggs with the salt, pour them in, and stir gently for 2 to 3 minutes, until just set.
Serve with warm tortillas and beans.

recipes.name: Banh mi op la Vietnamese pan eggs
ingredients: 2 slices ham or Vietnamese pork roll (optional)
2 teaspoons Maggi seasoning or soy sauce
steps: Melt the butter in a small pan over medium heat.
Lay the ham in the pan for 30 seconds per side.
Crack the eggs on top.
Cover and cook for 2 to 3 minutes, until the whites are set and the yolks are runny.
Sprinkle with pepper and drizzle with Maggi.
Serve in the pan with chunks of baguette for dipping, plus cucumber and cilantro.

recipes.name: Sweet potato hash with eggs
ingredients: 2 medium sweet potatoes, cut in 1/2 inch cubes
steps: Cut the sweet potatoes, onion and pepper. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pan over medium heat.
Add the sweet potatoes, cover, and cook for 10 minutes, stirring now and then.
Add the onion, pepper and seasonings and cook uncovered for 8 to 10 minutes, until the sweet potatoes are soft and browned.
Make 4 wells and crack an egg into each.
Cover and cook on low for 4 to 6 minutes, until the whites are set.
Serve with avocado.

recipes.name: English muffin breakfast pizzas
ingredients: 1 cup (100 g) shredded mozzarella or cheddar
1/2 cup (120 ml) pizza sauce or salsa (optional)
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Lay the muffin halves on a baking sheet and toast them for 5 minutes.
Whisk the eggs and salt and scramble in the butter over medium-low heat for 2 minutes, until soft.
Spread a little sauce on each muffin half.
Top with scrambled egg, bacon and cheese.
Bake for 6 to 8 minutes, until the cheese melts.

recipes.name: Dodo and egg sauce
ingredients: 1/4 scotch bonnet pepper, finely chopped (optional, very hot)
steps: Peel the plantains and cut them into 1/2 inch slices on an angle. Ask an adult to help.
Heat 1/2 inch of oil in a pan over medium heat. An adult should do the frying.
Fry the plantains for 2 to 3 minutes per side, until golden brown. Drain on paper towels and sprinkle with salt.
In another pan, heat 2 tablespoons of oil and cook the onion for 3 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, peppers, salt and curry powder and cook for 6 to 8 minutes, until soft and thick.
Pour in the eggs and stir gently for 2 to 3 minutes, until set.
Serve the egg sauce with the fried plantains.

recipes.name: Chorizo con huevo
ingredients: 8 oz (225 g) raw Mexican chorizo, casings removed
Crumbled queso fresco and salsa to serve
steps: Cook the chorizo in a pan over medium heat for 6 to 8 minutes, breaking it up, until cooked through and a little crispy.
Spoon off extra grease into a heatproof cup, leaving about 1 tablespoon.
Whisk the eggs with the salt and pour them in.
Stir gently for 2 to 3 minutes, until the eggs are just set.
Spoon into warm tortillas and top with queso fresco and salsa.

recipes.name: Pan con tomate
steps: Toast or grill the bread until crisp and golden.
Cut the tomatoes in half and grate the cut side on a box grater into a bowl. Throw away the skins. Ask an adult to help.
Rub the cut garlic lightly over the warm toast.
Spoon the grated tomato over the toast.
Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with salt.

recipes.name: Taiwanese egg crepe dan bing
ingredients: Soy paste or sweet chili sauce to serve
steps: Slice the green onions. Ask an adult to help.
Whisk the flour, cornstarch, salt and water into a thin, smooth batter. Stir in half the green onion.
Heat a nonstick pan over medium heat and brush it with oil.
Pour in 1/3 of the batter and swirl to cover the pan. Cook for 1 to 2 minutes, until set.
Beat 1 egg with a little green onion and pour it over the crepe.
Cook for 1 minute, until the egg starts to set, then flip and cook for 1 minute more.
Roll it up, cut into pieces and repeat. Serve with soy paste or chili sauce.

recipes.name: Smoked salmon bagel
aliases: bagel with cream cheese and lox
steps: Thinly slice the onion, tomato and cucumber. Ask an adult to help.
Toast the bagels if you like.
Spread cream cheese on each half.
Lay the smoked salmon on top.
Add onion, capers, tomato, cucumber and dill.

recipes.name: Classic French omelette
steps: Beat the eggs and salt with a fork until no streaks of white remain.
Melt the butter in an 8 inch nonstick pan over medium-low heat until it foams.
Pour in the eggs and stir quickly with a rubber spatula while shaking the pan for 30 to 60 seconds, until they look like soft curds.
Stop stirring and smooth the eggs into an even layer. Cook for 20 seconds so the bottom sets but stays pale.
Tilt the pan and roll the omelette into thirds toward the edge.
Tip it seam side down onto a plate and sprinkle with chives. The inside should be soft and creamy.

recipes.name: Brazilian tapioca crepe
ingredients: 1 cup (120 g) hydrated tapioca flour (goma de tapioca), or see the first step
steps: If you only have dry tapioca starch, mix 1 cup with 1/4 cup water and rub with your fingers until it looks like damp sand, then push it through a sieve.
Mix in the salt.
Heat a nonstick pan over medium heat. Don't add oil.
Sieve half the tapioca into the pan and spread it into an even layer.
Cook for 1 to 2 minutes, until it sticks together into one flat crepe.
Flip, then add cheese and ham to one half.
Fold in half and cook for 1 minute more, until the cheese melts. Spread with butter if you like.

recipes.name: Syrniki cheese pancakes
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) farmer cheese (tvorog) or very well drained cottage cheese
1/2 cup (65 g) all-purpose flour, plus more for shaping
Sour cream and jam to serve
steps: Mash the cheese with a fork until smooth.
Mix in the egg, sugar, vanilla and salt, then the flour, into a soft dough.
Scoop 2 tablespoons of dough, roll it in flour, and pat it into a thick patty. Make about 12.
Heat the oil in a nonstick pan over medium-low heat.
Cook the patties for 3 to 4 minutes per side, until golden and puffed.
Serve warm with sour cream and jam.

recipes.name: Hong Kong ham macaroni soup
steps: Cut the ham into strips. Ask an adult to help.
Boil the macaroni in water for 7 to 8 minutes, until tender. Drain.
Bring the broth to a simmer in a pot and add the ham and peas for 2 minutes.
Fry the eggs in the butter for 2 to 3 minutes, until the whites are set.
Put the macaroni in 2 bowls and pour the hot broth, ham and peas over it.
Top each with a fried egg, white pepper and a few drops of sesame oil.

recipes.name: Gyeran bap Korean egg rice
steps: Melt the butter in a small pan over medium heat.
Fry the egg for 2 to 3 minutes, until the white is crispy at the edges and the yolk is runny.
Put the hot rice in a bowl and slide the egg on top.
Drizzle with soy sauce and sesame oil.
Top with crumbled seaweed and green onion, then mix it all together and eat.

recipes.name: Tapsilog beef tapa with garlic rice and egg
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) thinly sliced beef sirloin
steps: Mince the garlic. Ask an adult to help.
Mix the soy sauce, juice, brown sugar, half the garlic and pepper. Add the beef and marinate in the fridge for at least 30 minutes.
Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a big pan over medium-high heat and cook the beef in batches for 2 to 3 minutes per side, until browned. Keep warm.
Wipe the pan, add 1 tablespoon oil and cook the rest of the garlic over medium-low heat for 1 to 2 minutes, until light golden.
Add the rice and salt and stir-fry for 4 to 5 minutes, until hot.
Fry the eggs in the last of the oil for 2 to 3 minutes.
Serve each plate with garlic rice, beef tapa and a fried egg.

recipes.name: Mangu Dominican mashed plantains
ingredients: Fried eggs, fried salami and fried cheese to serve (optional)
steps: Cut the ends off the plantains, slit the skin, and peel. Ask an adult to help.
Cut the plantains into chunks and boil in salted water for 20 to 25 minutes, until very soft.
Meanwhile, cook the onion in the oil over medium heat for 3 to 4 minutes, add the vinegar and a pinch of salt and cook for 1 minute more.
Drain the plantains and mash them with the butter, adding the cold water a little at a time until smooth and creamy.
Spoon the onions over the mangu and serve with eggs, salami and cheese.

recipes.name: Chechebsa Ethiopian spiced flatbread
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups (190 g) all-purpose or whole wheat flour
4 tablespoons (60 g) butter or niter kibbeh (Ethiopian spiced butter)
Honey and plain yogurt to serve
steps: Mix the flour, salt and water into a thick, smooth batter like soft dough.
Heat a big nonstick pan over medium heat and spread the dough into one big thin round with wet fingers or a spatula.
Cook for 4 to 5 minutes per side, until dry and spotted brown.
Tear the flatbread into small bite-size pieces.
Melt the butter in the pan over medium-low heat and stir in the berbere for 30 seconds.
Add the bread pieces and toss for 2 to 3 minutes, until coated and hot.
Serve drizzled with honey, with yogurt on the side.

recipes.name: Baghrir Moroccan semolina pancakes
steps: Blend the semolina, flour, yeast, baking powder, sugar, salt and warm water for 1 minute, until very smooth and thin.
Pour into a bowl, cover, and let rest for 30 minutes, until bubbly.
Heat a nonstick pan over medium heat. Don't grease it.
Pour in 1/4 cup of batter. Holes will appear on top.
Cook on one side only for 2 to 3 minutes, until the top has no wet spots left.
Lay each pancake on a clean towel in one layer to cool. Don't stack them hot.
Melt the butter and honey together and spoon it over the pancakes to serve.

recipes.name: Spinach and feta omelette
steps: Whisk the eggs, milk, salt and pepper.
Heat the butter in a nonstick pan over medium heat.
Add the spinach and stir for 1 minute, until wilted.
Spread the spinach out and pour the eggs over it.
Cook for 2 minutes, lifting the edges so runny egg flows under, until nearly set.
Sprinkle feta over half, fold the omelette over and cook for 30 seconds more.

recipes.name: Eggs Florentine
steps: Melt the butter in a pan over medium heat and cook the spinach for 2 minutes, until wilted. Season with salt and nutmeg.
Toast the English muffins.
Poach the eggs in gently simmering water with the vinegar for 3 to 4 minutes. Ask an adult to help.
Put spinach on each muffin half, then a poached egg.
Sprinkle with parmesan and pepper and serve.

recipes.name: BLT sandwich
steps: Slice the tomato. Ask an adult to help.
Cook the bacon in a pan over medium heat for 8 to 10 minutes, flipping, until crisp. Drain on paper towels.
Toast the bread.
Spread mayonnaise on each slice.
Layer lettuce, tomato with a pinch of salt and pepper, and 3 slices of bacon on 2 slices of toast.
Top with the other slices and cut in half.

recipes.name: Turkey club sandwich
steps: Cook the bacon in a pan over medium heat for 8 to 10 minutes, until crisp. Drain on paper towels.
Toast the bread and spread mayonnaise on one side of each slice.
On 2 slices, layer turkey, cheese and a lettuce leaf.
Add a second slice of toast, then bacon, tomato and lettuce.
Top with the last slices, mayo side down.
Push 4 toothpicks into each sandwich and cut into 4 triangles with a sharp knife. Ask an adult to help.

recipes.name: Chicken salad sandwich
ingredients: 3 cups (420 g) cooked chicken, chopped (rotisserie works great)
steps: Chop the chicken and celery and slice the green onions. Ask an adult to help.
Mix the mayonnaise, lemon juice, mustard, salt and pepper in a bowl.
Fold in the chicken, celery, green onions and grapes.
Taste and add more salt if needed.
Pile onto bread with lettuce.
Keep leftovers in the fridge for up to 3 days.

recipes.name: Egg salad sandwich
ingredients: 1 tablespoon chopped chives or green onion
steps: Put the eggs in a pot, cover with cold water by 1 inch and bring to a boil.
Turn off the heat, cover, and let sit for 11 minutes.
Cool the eggs in ice water for 5 minutes, then peel. Ask an adult to help with the hot water.
Chop the eggs and put them in a bowl.
Mix in the mayonnaise, mustard, salt, pepper and chives.
Spread on bread with lettuce.

recipes.name: Peanut butter and jelly sandwich
steps: Spread peanut butter on one slice of bread all the way to the edges.
Spread jelly on the other slice.
Add banana slices if you like.
Press the slices together and cut in half.
For a grilled version, butter the outsides and cook in a pan over medium-low heat for 2 to 3 minutes per side.

recipes.name: Baked ham and cheese sliders
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Without pulling the rolls apart, slice the whole block in half sideways with a bread knife.
Put the bottom half in a 9 by 13 inch baking dish.
Layer the ham and cheese over it and put the top half back on.
Mix the melted butter, mustard, Worcestershire, poppy seeds and onion powder and brush it over the tops.
Cover with foil and bake for 15 minutes.
Uncover and bake for 5 minutes more, until golden and the cheese melts.
Cut along the rolls into 12 sliders.

recipes.name: Reuben sandwich
ingredients: 1/4 cup (60 ml) Russian or Thousand Island dressing
steps: Butter one side of each slice of bread.
Lay 2 slices butter side down and spread the dressing on top.
Layer cheese, corned beef, sauerkraut and more cheese.
Top with the other bread slices, butter side up.
Cook in a pan over medium-low heat for 4 to 5 minutes per side, pressing down, until golden and the cheese melts.
Cut in half and serve.

recipes.name: Patty melt
ingredients: 2 tablespoons (30 g) butter, divided, plus more for the bread
steps: Slice the onion. Ask an adult to help.
Melt 1 tablespoon of butter in a pan over medium-low heat and cook the onion with a pinch of salt for 15 minutes, stirring, until soft and golden.
Shape the beef into 2 thin oval patties the size of the bread and season with the rest of the salt and pepper.
Cook the patties in another pan over medium-high heat for 3 minutes per side, until 160°F (71°C) inside.
Butter the outside of each slice of bread.
Build each sandwich: bread, cheese, patty, onions, cheese, bread.
Cook in a pan over medium-low heat for 3 to 4 minutes per side, until golden and melty.

recipes.name: Tuna melt
ingredients: 1 tablespoon finely chopped celery or pickle
steps: Mix the tuna, mayonnaise, celery, lemon juice and pepper in a bowl.
Butter one side of each slice of bread.
Lay 2 slices butter side down and add a slice of cheese, the tuna, and another slice of cheese.
Top with the other bread, butter side up.
