Cook in a pan over medium-low heat for 3 to 4 minutes per side, until golden and the cheese melts.

recipes.name: Monte Cristo sandwich
ingredients: Powdered sugar and raspberry jam to serve
steps: Build 2 sandwiches with cheese, ham, turkey and more cheese.
Whisk the eggs and milk in a shallow dish.
Melt the butter in a pan over medium-low heat.
Dip each sandwich in the egg mix for a few seconds per side.
Cook for 3 to 4 minutes per side, until golden and the cheese melts.
Dust with powdered sugar and serve with jam for dipping.

recipes.name: Cuban sandwich
ingredients: 1 loaf Cuban bread or 2 soft French baguettes
12 oz (340 g) sliced roast pork (leftover or deli)
steps: Cut the bread into 4 pieces about 8 inches long, then split each one. Ask an adult to help.
Spread mustard on both cut sides.
Layer cheese, ham, pork, pickles and more cheese on each.
Butter the outsides of the bread.
Cook in a big pan over medium heat with a heavy pan pressed on top for 3 to 4 minutes per side, until crisp and the cheese melts.
Cut each sandwich in half on an angle.

recipes.name: Chicken Caesar wrap
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) boneless skinless chicken breasts
steps: Season the chicken with salt, garlic powder and pepper.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat and cook the chicken for 6 to 7 minutes per side, until 165°F (74°C) inside.
Let it rest for 5 minutes, then slice it. Ask an adult to help.
Toss the lettuce with the dressing, parmesan and croutons.
Warm the tortillas in the microwave for 20 seconds.
Fill each tortilla with salad and chicken, fold in the sides and roll up tightly.
Cut in half to serve.

recipes.name: Hummus veggie wrap
steps: Slice the cucumber and pepper and grate the carrot. Ask an adult to help.
Spread hummus over each tortilla, leaving a border.
Lay the spinach, vegetables and feta in a line across the middle.
Fold in the sides and roll up tightly.
Cut in half on an angle.

recipes.name: Falafel pita
ingredients: 1 cup (200 g) dried chickpeas, soaked in water overnight (not canned)
1 cup (30 g) parsley and cilantro leaves
Vegetable oil for frying, or spray for the oven
4 pita breads, tahini sauce, tomato, cucumber and lettuce to serve
steps: Drain the soaked chickpeas well and pat dry. Canned chickpeas are too wet and will fall apart.
Pulse the chickpeas, onion, garlic, herbs, spices and salt in a food processor until like coarse sand. Ask an adult to help.
Stir in the baking powder and flour and chill for 30 minutes.
Shape into 16 small patties.
To fry, an adult heats 2 inches of oil to 350°F (175°C) and fries them for 3 to 4 minutes, turning, until deep brown.
To bake, heat the oven to 400°F (200°C), spray the patties well with oil, and bake for 25 minutes, flipping halfway.
Stuff into warm pita with tahini sauce, tomato, cucumber and lettuce.

recipes.name: Chicken gyros
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) boneless skinless chicken thighs
Sliced tomato, red onion and lettuce
steps: Mix the yogurt, oil, lemon juice, garlic, oregano, paprika and salt in a bowl.
Add the chicken and coat it. Marinate in the fridge for at least 30 minutes.
Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C) and line a sheet pan with foil. Ask an adult to help.
Spread the chicken on the pan and roast for 20 to 25 minutes, until 165°F (74°C) inside and browned at the edges.
Rest for 5 minutes, then slice thinly.
Warm the pitas in a dry pan for 30 seconds per side.
Fill with chicken, tzatziki, tomato, onion and lettuce and fold up.

recipes.name: Pita pizzas
ingredients: Toppings like pepperoni, peppers, olives or mushrooms
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Ask an adult to help.
Lay the pitas on a baking sheet.
Spread 2 tablespoons of sauce on each, leaving a small border.
Add cheese and your toppings and sprinkle with oregano.
Bake for 8 to 10 minutes, until the cheese bubbles and the edges are crisp.
Cool for 2 minutes, then cut into wedges.

recipes.name: French bread pizza
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Ask an adult to help.
Cut the bread in half lengthwise, then in half across, to make 4 pieces.
Mix the butter and garlic and brush it over the cut sides.
Bake cut side up for 5 minutes, until lightly toasted.
Spread on the sauce, then the cheese and pepperoni.
Bake for 8 to 10 minutes, until the cheese melts and bubbles.

recipes.name: English muffin pizzas
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Lay the muffin halves on a baking sheet and toast for 5 minutes.
Spread 1 tablespoon of sauce on each half.
Top with cheese and pepperoni.
Bake for 6 to 8 minutes, until the cheese melts.

recipes.name: Bean and cheese burritos
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups (150 g) shredded cheddar or Monterey Jack
Salsa and sour cream to serve
steps: Warm the beans with the cumin and chili powder in a small pot over medium-low heat for 5 minutes, stirring.
Warm the tortillas in the microwave for 20 seconds so they bend without tearing.
Spread beans down the middle of each tortilla and add rice and cheese.
Fold in the sides and roll up tightly.
Toast seam side down in a dry pan over medium heat for 2 minutes per side, until golden.
Serve with salsa and sour cream.

recipes.name: Air fryer chicken taquitos
ingredients: 1 cup (100 g) shredded Mexican cheese blend
Guacamole and sour cream to serve
steps: Mix the chicken, cream cheese, salsa, cheese and cumin in a bowl.
Wrap the tortillas in a damp paper towel and microwave for 30 seconds so they roll without cracking.
Spread 2 tablespoons of filling along one edge of each tortilla and roll up tightly.
Lay them seam side down in the air fryer basket and spray with oil.
Air fry at 400°F (200°C) for 6 to 8 minutes, until crisp and golden.
Serve with guacamole and sour cream.

recipes.name: Bean tostadas
ingredients: 8 tostada shells, or corn tortillas baked until crisp
1 cup (120 g) crumbled queso fresco or shredded cheese
steps: To make your own shells, bake corn tortillas brushed with oil at 400°F (200°C) for 8 to 10 minutes, until crisp. Ask an adult to help.
Warm the beans in a pot or the microwave.
Shred the lettuce and dice the tomato.
Spread a layer of beans on each tostada shell.
Top with lettuce, tomato, cheese, avocado, sour cream and salsa.
Eat right away while crunchy.

recipes.name: Chicken torta
ingredients: 4 slices Oaxaca or Monterey Jack cheese
Shredded lettuce, sliced tomato and pickled jalapenos
steps: Warm the chicken with the salsa in a pan over medium heat for 3 to 4 minutes.
Split the rolls and toast them cut side down in a dry pan for 1 to 2 minutes.
Spread the bottoms with refried beans and the tops with mayonnaise.
Add cheese, chicken, avocado, lettuce, tomato and jalapenos.
Close the rolls and press down a little before eating.

recipes.name: Sopes
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups (210 g) shredded cooked chicken or beef
Shredded lettuce, crumbled queso fresco, Mexican crema and salsa
steps: Mix the masa harina, salt and water into a soft dough. Rest for 10 minutes.
Shape into 8 balls and press each into a 3 1/2 inch disk about 1/4 inch thick.
Cook in a dry pan over medium heat for 2 minutes per side, until spotty.
While still warm, pinch up the edges to make a little rim. Use a towel, they're hot.
Heat the oil in the pan and fry the sopes, flat side down, for 2 minutes, until crisp. Ask an adult to help.
Spread with beans and top with meat, lettuce, cheese, crema and salsa.

recipes.name: Cheese and bean pupusas
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups (170 g) shredded mozzarella or quesillo
Curtido (pickled cabbage slaw) and tomato salsa to serve
steps: Mix the masa harina, salt and water into a soft dough. Rest for 10 minutes.
Mix the cheese and beans in a bowl.
Wet your hands, make 8 balls of dough and press a deep well in each.
Put 2 tablespoons of filling in the well and pinch the dough closed around it.
Pat gently between your hands into a 4 inch disk. Patch any cracks.
Cook in an oiled pan over medium heat for 4 minutes per side, until golden spots appear.
Serve hot with curtido and salsa.

recipes.name: Baked beef empanadas
ingredients: 2 boxes (about 20) frozen empanada discs, thawed, or 2 sheets pie crust
steps: Chop the onion. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat and cook the onion for 5 minutes.
Add the beef and cook for 6 to 8 minutes, breaking it up, until browned. Drain the fat.
Stir in the spices, salt and tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes. Let the filling cool for 15 minutes, then mix in the olives and eggs.
Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
Put 2 tablespoons of filling on each disc, fold into a half moon and press the edges with a fork.
Brush with beaten egg and bake on a lined sheet for 20 to 25 minutes, until golden.

recipes.name: Jamaican beef patties
ingredients: 3/4 cup (170 g) cold butter, in cubes
1 teaspoon curry powder, for the filling
1/2 cup (120 ml) water or beef broth
steps: Mix the flour, curry powder, turmeric and salt. Rub in the butter until it looks like peas.
Stir in the ice water to make a dough, press into a disk, wrap and chill for 30 minutes.
Chop the onion and pepper. Ask an adult to help.
Cook the onion in the oil over medium heat for 4 minutes, add the beef and cook for 6 to 8 minutes until browned.
Add the thyme, curry powder, scotch bonnet, breadcrumbs and water and simmer for 5 minutes, until thick. Cool.
Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
Roll the dough 1/8 inch thick and cut 8 circles about 6 inches wide.
Put filling on half of each, fold over, and crimp with a fork.
Brush with egg and bake for 25 to 30 minutes, until golden.

recipes.name: Bunny chow
ingredients: 2 tablespoons curry powder or Durban masala
1 1/2 lb (680 g) boneless chicken thighs, in bite-size pieces
steps: Chop the onion, garlic, potatoes and chicken. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pot over medium heat and cook the onion for 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, ginger and curry powder and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken and stir for 3 minutes.
Add the potatoes, tomatoes, water and salt and bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer for 30 minutes, until the potatoes are soft and the chicken is 165°F (74°C) inside.
Cut each loaf in half across and hollow out each half, keeping the soft bread you take out.
Spoon the curry into the bread bowls, top with cilantro and use the soft bread for dipping.

recipes.name: Chicken banh mi
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) boneless skinless chicken thighs
1 carrot and 1 small daikon, cut in matchsticks
Mayonnaise, sliced cucumber, sliced jalapeno and cilantro
steps: Mix the vinegar, sugar and a pinch of salt and soak the carrot and daikon in it for at least 30 minutes. These are quick pickles.
Mix the soy sauce, brown sugar, fish sauce and garlic and coat the chicken in it.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat and cook the chicken for 5 to 6 minutes per side, until 165°F (74°C) inside and sticky.
Rest for 5 minutes and slice thinly. Ask an adult to help.
Split the baguettes and toast them for 2 to 3 minutes.
Spread with mayonnaise and fill with chicken, drained pickles, cucumber, jalapeno and cilantro.

recipes.name: Vietnamese summer rolls
ingredients: 4 oz (115 g) thin rice vermicelli noodles
12 cooked shrimp, cut in half lengthwise, or 8 oz (225 g) cooked pork or tofu
Fresh mint, cilantro and Thai basil
steps: Soak the noodles in boiling water for 3 to 5 minutes, until soft. Drain and rinse with cold water. Ask an adult to help.
Cut the cucumber and carrot into thin sticks.
Fill a wide shallow dish with warm water.
Dip one rice paper in the water for 5 seconds and lay it flat on a damp board.
Lay 2 shrimp halves in the middle, then lettuce, a few noodles, vegetables and herbs.
Fold the bottom over, fold in the sides and roll up tightly.
Whisk the hoisin, peanut butter and warm water to make a dipping sauce.

recipes.name: Bun thit nuong grilled pork noodle bowl
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) pork shoulder or boneless pork chops, thinly sliced
1 stalk lemongrass, finely chopped, or 1 tablespoon lemongrass paste
Shredded lettuce, cucumber, mint, cilantro and chopped peanuts
Nuoc cham: 3 tablespoons fish sauce, 3 tablespoons sugar, 3 tablespoons lime juice, 1/2 cup (120 ml) warm water, 1 garlic clove grated
steps: Slice the pork thinly. Ask an adult to help.
Mix the fish sauce, brown sugar, lemongrass, garlic and oil and coat the pork. Marinate for 20 minutes.
Stir the nuoc cham ingredients until the sugar dissolves.
Cook the noodles in boiling water for 3 to 5 minutes, then drain and rinse with cold water.
Cook the pork in a hot pan or grill pan over medium-high heat for 2 to 3 minutes per side, until browned and cooked through.
Fill bowls with lettuce, cucumber, herbs and noodles, then add the pork and peanuts.
Pour nuoc cham over the top and mix.

recipes.name: Tamago sando Japanese egg sandwich
ingredients: 3 tablespoons Japanese mayonnaise (like Kewpie) or regular mayonnaise
4 slices soft milk bread (shokupan) or soft white bread
steps: Put the eggs in a pot, cover with water and bring to a boil. Turn off the heat, cover, and let sit for 11 minutes.
Cool in ice water and peel. Ask an adult to help with the hot water.
Mash the eggs with a fork, leaving some small pieces of white.
Mix in the mayonnaise, milk, sugar, salt and pepper until creamy.
Spread a thin layer of butter on the bread.
Pile the egg salad thickly onto 2 slices and top with the others.
Cut off the crusts with a sharp knife and cut each sandwich in half.

recipes.name: Chicken katsu sando
ingredients: Vegetable oil for frying, about 1/2 inch
steps: Pound the chicken to an even 1/2 inch thick and season with salt and pepper.
Coat each piece in flour, then egg, then panko. Wash your hands.
Have an adult heat the oil in a pan over medium heat to 350°F (175°C).
Fry the cutlets for 3 to 4 minutes per side, until golden and 165°F (74°C) inside. An adult should do the frying.
Drain on a rack for 2 minutes.
Spread tonkatsu sauce on the bread, add cabbage and the cutlet, and close the sandwich.
Cut off the crusts and slice in half.

recipes.name: Onigiri rice balls
ingredients: 2 cups (400 g) uncooked Japanese short grain rice
steps: Rinse the rice until the water is mostly clear, then cook it with the water in a rice cooker or covered pot over low heat for 15 minutes.
Let it steam with the lid on for 10 minutes. Spread it in a bowl to cool until warm, not hot.
Mix the tuna, mayonnaise and soy sauce.
Wet your hands with water and rub a pinch of salt on your palms.
Take 1/2 cup of rice, press a dent in the middle and add 1 teaspoon of tuna filling.
Cover with a little more rice and press firmly into a triangle or ball.
Wrap a strip of nori around the bottom just before eating.

recipes.name: California roll
ingredients: Toasted sesame seeds, soy sauce and pickled ginger
steps: Rinse the rice until the water is mostly clear and cook it with the water in a covered pot over low heat for 15 minutes. Rest for 10 minutes.
Warm the vinegar, sugar and salt until dissolved and fold it into the rice. Cool to room temperature.
Slice the avocado and cucumber. Ask an adult to help.
Lay a nori sheet shiny side down on a bamboo mat covered in plastic wrap.
With wet hands, spread 3/4 cup of rice thinly over the nori, leaving 1 inch bare at the top.
Lay crab, avocado and cucumber in a line across the bottom.
Lift the mat and roll tightly away from you, pressing as you go. Wet the bare edge to seal.
Cut each roll into 8 pieces with a wet sharp knife. Serve with soy sauce and ginger.

recipes.name: Zaru soba cold soba noodles
ingredients: 1/2 cup (120 ml) store-bought soba dipping sauce (tsuyu), or the 3 items below
1/2 cup (120 ml) water with 1 teaspoon dashi powder
1 sheet nori, cut in thin strips
steps: If making your own sauce, simmer the soy sauce, mirin and dashi water for 2 minutes, then chill.
Boil the soba in a big pot of water for 4 to 5 minutes, or as the package says.
Drain and rinse under cold running water, rubbing gently to wash off the starch.
Put the noodles in a bowl of ice water for 1 minute, then drain well.
Pile the noodles on plates and top with nori.
Dip each bite into the cold sauce with green onion and a little wasabi.

recipes.name: Yaki udon
ingredients: 2 packs (7 oz / 200 g each) frozen udon noodles
4 oz (115 g) thinly sliced pork, chicken or shrimp
2 green onions, cut in 2 inch pieces
steps: Slice the meat and vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Put the frozen udon in boiling water for 1 minute to loosen. Drain.
Mix the soy sauce, oyster sauce, mirin and sugar.
Heat the oil in a big pan over medium-high heat and cook the meat for 2 to 3 minutes, until cooked through.
Add the carrot, cabbage and mushrooms and stir-fry for 3 minutes.
Add the udon, sauce and green onion and toss for 2 minutes, until coated and hot.

recipes.name: Yakisoba
ingredients: 3 packs (5 oz / 150 g each) fresh yakisoba or ramen noodles
8 oz (225 g) thinly sliced pork belly or chicken
Pickled ginger and seaweed flakes (aonori) to serve
steps: Slice the meat and vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Mix the Worcestershire, ketchup, soy sauce, oyster sauce and sugar. This is yakisoba sauce.
Loosen the noodles by rinsing them in hot water.
Heat the oil in a big pan over medium-high heat and cook the meat for 3 to 4 minutes, until cooked through.
Add the onion, carrot and cabbage and stir-fry for 3 minutes.
Add the noodles and sauce and toss for 2 to 3 minutes, until hot and coated.
Top with pickled ginger and aonori.

recipes.name: Okonomiyaki savory pancakes
ingredients: Okonomiyaki sauce or a mix of ketchup and Worcestershire, Japanese mayo and bonito flakes
steps: Chop the cabbage and green onions. Ask an adult to help.
Whisk the flour, baking powder, dashi powder, water and eggs.
Fold in the cabbage and green onion until coated.
Heat the oil in a nonstick pan over medium heat and spoon in half the batter, shaping a 1 inch thick round.
Lay 4 bacon halves on top.
Cook for 5 minutes, flip carefully with 2 spatulas, and cook for 5 minutes more.
Flip back and cook for 1 to 2 minutes, until cooked through. Repeat with the rest.
Top with sauce, mayo and bonito flakes.

recipes.name: Kimbap
ingredients: 3 cups (550 g) cooked short grain rice, warm
1 tablespoon sesame oil, plus more for brushing
steps: Mix the warm rice with the sesame oil and salt.
Cook the eggs as a thin omelette in an oiled pan over medium-low heat for 2 minutes per side, then cut into strips. Ask an adult to help.
Cook the carrot in a little oil for 2 minutes. Blanch the spinach in boiling water for 30 seconds, squeeze dry and season with a pinch of salt.
Lay a nori sheet shiny side down on a bamboo mat and spread 3/4 cup of rice thinly over it, leaving 1 inch bare at the top.
Lay a strip of each filling across the bottom third.
Roll up tightly with the mat and press to seal.
Brush the roll with sesame oil and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Slice into 1/2 inch pieces with a wet sharp knife.

recipes.name: Tteokbokki spicy rice cakes
ingredients: 3 cups (720 ml) water or anchovy broth
1 tablespoon gochugaru (Korean chili flakes), or less for mild
2 sheets fish cake, cut in triangles (optional)
2 green onions, cut in 2 inch pieces
steps: If the rice cakes are hard, soak them in warm water for 10 minutes.
Bring the water to a boil in a wide pan and stir in the gochujang, gochugaru, soy sauce and sugar.
Add the rice cakes and cook for 8 to 10 minutes, stirring often so they don't stick.
Add the fish cake, green onion and eggs and cook for 3 to 5 minutes more, until the sauce is thick and glossy.
Serve hot. Careful, rice cakes hold heat for a long time.

recipes.name: Kimchi fried rice
ingredients: 1 cup (150 g) chopped kimchi, plus 2 tablespoons kimchi juice
4 oz (115 g) diced ham, Spam or bacon (optional)
steps: Chop the kimchi and ham. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pan over medium-high heat and cook the ham for 2 minutes.
Add the kimchi and cook for 3 minutes.
Add the rice, kimchi juice, gochujang, soy sauce and sugar and stir-fry for 3 to 4 minutes, until hot.
Stir in the sesame oil and divide between 2 bowls.
Fry the eggs for 2 to 3 minutes, until the whites are set, and put one on each bowl.
Top with green onion.

recipes.name: Spam musubi
ingredients: 3 cups (550 g) cooked short grain rice, warm
steps: Slice the Spam into 8 slices. Ask an adult to help.
Fry the slices in the oil over medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes per side, until browned.
Mix the soy sauce, sugar and mirin and pour it into the pan. Simmer for 1 to 2 minutes, turning the Spam, until glazed.
Lay a half sheet of nori shiny side down. Use the empty Spam can (both ends cut off, edges checked by an adult) or a musubi mold as a press.
Press 1/3 cup of rice into the mold on the nori, add a slice of Spam, and press again.
Lift off the mold and wrap the nori around, wetting the end to seal.

recipes.name: Loco moco
steps: Shape the beef into 4 patties and season with salt and pepper. Wash your hands.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium-high heat and cook the patties for 4 minutes per side, until 160°F (71°C) inside. Keep them warm.
Chop the onion. Ask an adult to help.
Melt the butter in the same pan over medium heat and cook the onion for 3 minutes.
Stir in the flour for 1 minute, then slowly whisk in the broth, soy sauce and Worcestershire.
Simmer for 3 to 4 minutes, until thick.
Fry the eggs for 2 to 3 minutes, until the whites are set.
Put rice in each bowl, then a patty, gravy and a fried egg.

recipes.name: Pork potstickers
ingredients: 2 cups (140 g) finely chopped napa cabbage
Dipping sauce: 3 tablespoons soy sauce, 1 tablespoon rice vinegar, 1 teaspoon sesame oil
steps: Chop the cabbage and green onions. Ask an adult to help.
Toss the cabbage with the salt, wait 10 minutes, then squeeze out the water.
Mix the pork, cabbage, green onion, ginger, garlic, soy sauce and sesame oil. Wash your hands after.
Put 1 teaspoon of filling in the middle of a wrapper, wet the edge with water, fold in half and pinch or pleat it shut.
Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a nonstick pan with a lid over medium heat and set in half the dumplings, flat side down.
Cook for 2 minutes, until the bottoms are golden.
Pour in 1/4 cup of water, cover right away, and steam for 6 to 7 minutes, until the filling is cooked through. Ask an adult to help, it spits.
Uncover and cook for 1 minute more to crisp. Repeat with the rest and serve with dipping sauce.

recipes.name: Dan dan noodles
ingredients: 12 oz (340 g) fresh or dried wheat noodles
1 tablespoon soy sauce, for the pork
3 tablespoons Chinese sesame paste or tahini
1 tablespoon rice vinegar or Chinese black vinegar
1 to 3 tablespoons chili oil, to taste
2 baby bok choy, halved, and sliced green onion
steps: Cook the pork in the oil over medium-high heat for 5 to 6 minutes, breaking it up, until browned and crispy. Stir in 1 tablespoon soy sauce and the hoisin.
Whisk the sesame paste, soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, chili oil and Sichuan pepper in a big bowl.
Boil the noodles as the package says. Add the bok choy for the last 1 minute.
Scoop out 1/2 cup of the noodle water, then drain. Ask an adult to help.
Whisk the hot water into the sauce until smooth.
Divide the sauce between bowls, add the noodles and bok choy, and top with pork and green onion.
Mix everything together before eating.

recipes.name: Cold sesame noodles
ingredients: 12 oz (340 g) spaghetti or Chinese wheat noodles
1/4 cup (60 g) Chinese sesame paste, tahini or peanut butter
2 green onions and toasted sesame seeds
steps: Boil the noodles as the package says, then rinse under cold water and drain well.
Whisk the sesame paste, soy sauce, vinegar, honey, sesame oil, garlic, ginger and warm water until smooth.
Toss the noodles with the sauce.
Cut the cucumber and slice the green onions. Ask an adult to help.
Top the noodles with cucumber, green onion and sesame seeds. Serve cold or at room temperature.

recipes.name: Scallion oil noodles
ingredients: 6 green onions, cut in 2 inch pieces
1 tablespoon dark soy sauce (optional, for color)
steps: Cut the green onions, keeping the white and green parts apart. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a small pan over medium-low heat and add the white parts.
Cook for 3 minutes, then add the greens and cook for 6 to 8 minutes more, until dark brown and crispy but not burned.
Turn off the heat and carefully stir in the soy sauces and sugar. It will bubble up.
Boil the noodles as the package says and drain.
Toss the noodles with 2 to 3 tablespoons of the scallion oil and the crispy onions.

recipes.name: Zha jiang mian
ingredients: 1/4 cup (65 g) sweet bean sauce or hoisin
2 tablespoons yellow soybean paste or miso
steps: Chop the garlic and cut the cucumber. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat and cook the pork for 5 minutes, until browned.
Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds.
Stir in the bean sauce, soybean paste, soy sauce, sugar and water.
Simmer for 8 to 10 minutes, stirring, until thick and glossy.
Boil the noodles as the package says and drain.
Top the noodles with the meat sauce and cucumber, then mix well.

recipes.name: Upgraded instant ramen
ingredients: 1/2 cup (35 g) frozen corn or spinach
steps: Bring the water to a boil in a small pot.
Add the noodles and vegetables and cook for 2 minutes.
Stir in half or all of the seasoning packet, to taste.
Crack the egg into the pot, don't stir, and cook for 1 minute more, until the white is set.
Turn off the heat and add the butter and cheese.
Slide into a bowl and top with green onion and sesame seeds. Careful, it's very hot.

recipes.name: Paneer kathi roll
ingredients: 8 oz (225 g) paneer, cut in strips
Green chutney and sliced red onion with lemon
steps: Cut the paneer, onion and pepper. Ask an adult to help.
Mix the yogurt, spices and salt and coat the paneer. Rest for 10 minutes.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium-high heat and cook the onion and pepper for 4 minutes.
Add the paneer and cook for 4 to 5 minutes, turning gently, until browned.
Warm each paratha in a pan. For the egg version, pour a beaten egg in the pan and lay the paratha on top for 1 minute, then flip.
Spread chutney on each paratha, add the filling and red onion, and roll it up.

recipes.name: Pav bhaji
ingredients: 4 tablespoons (60 g) butter, plus more for the buns
Chopped onion, cilantro and lemon wedges to serve
steps: Chop the vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Boil the potatoes, cauliflower, carrot and peas in water for 15 minutes, until very soft. Drain and mash.
Melt the butter in a big pan over medium heat and cook the onion and pepper for 5 minutes.
Add the ginger garlic paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, masala, chili powder and salt and cook for 6 to 8 minutes, mashing, until soft.
Add the mashed vegetables and 1/2 cup of water and mash everything together. Simmer for 5 minutes.
Split the rolls, butter them and toast in a pan for 1 minute.
Serve the bhaji with buns, onion, cilantro and a squeeze of lemon.

recipes.name: Croque monsieur
ingredients: 1 cup (100 g) grated Gruyere or Swiss cheese, divided
2 fried eggs, for a croque madame (optional)
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Melt the butter in a small pot over medium heat, stir in the flour and cook for 1 minute.
Whisk in the milk and simmer for 2 to 3 minutes, until thick. Add salt, nutmeg and 1/4 cup of the cheese.
Toast the bread lightly and lay 2 slices on a baking sheet.
Spread with mustard, add ham and half the remaining cheese, and top with the other bread.
Spread the sauce over the tops and sprinkle with the rest of the cheese.
Bake for 8 to 10 minutes, then broil for 1 to 2 minutes, until golden and bubbly. Watch it closely.
Top each with a fried egg for a croque madame.

recipes.name: Quiche Lorraine
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups (300 ml) half and half or light cream
1 1/2 cups (150 g) shredded Swiss or Gruyere cheese
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Ask an adult to help.
Press the pie crust into a 9 inch pie pan and prick the bottom with a fork.
Line it with foil, fill with dried beans and bake for 15 minutes. Lift out the foil and beans and bake for 5 minutes more.
Cook the bacon in a pan over medium heat for 6 to 8 minutes, until crisp. Drain on paper towels.
Whisk the eggs, cream, salt, pepper and nutmeg.
Scatter the bacon and cheese in the crust and pour in the egg mix.
Bake for 35 to 40 minutes, until set with only a slight wobble in the middle.
Cool for 15 minutes before slicing.

recipes.name: Spanakopita spinach pie
ingredients: 2 bags (10 oz / 285 g each) frozen chopped spinach, thawed
steps: Squeeze all the water out of the spinach with your hands.
Chop the onion and green onions. Ask an adult to help.
Cook the onions in the oil over medium heat for 5 minutes. Cool.
Mix the spinach, onions, dill, feta, eggs and pepper.
Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C) and brush a 9 by 13 inch dish with butter.
Lay in 8 sheets of phyllo, brushing each with butter. Keep the rest under a damp towel.
Spread the filling, then top with 8 more buttered sheets. Tuck in the edges.
Cut through the top layers into squares with a sharp knife.
Bake for 45 to 50 minutes, until deep golden and crisp. Cool for 10 minutes.

recipes.name: Caprese panini
steps: Slice the mozzarella and tomato. Ask an adult to help.
Spread pesto on 2 slices of bread.
Layer mozzarella, tomato with salt and pepper, and basil, then top with the other bread.
Brush the outsides with olive oil.
Cook in a panini press or in a pan over medium heat with a heavy pan on top for 3 to 4 minutes per side, until golden and melty.

recipes.name: Italian sub
ingredients: 4 oz (115 g) sliced ham or capicola
steps: Slice the tomato and onion. Ask an adult to help.
Whisk the oil, vinegar, oregano, salt and pepper.
Split the rolls without cutting all the way through.
Layer provolone, salami, ham and pepperoni inside.
Add lettuce, tomato and onion.
Drizzle with the dressing, close and press down. Cut in half.

recipes.name: Meatball subs
ingredients: 8 slices provolone or 1 cup (115 g) shredded mozzarella
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Mix the beef, breadcrumbs, egg, parmesan, seasoning and salt, then roll into 16 balls. Wash your hands.
Bake on a lined sheet for 15 to 18 minutes, until 160°F (71°C) inside.
Warm the marinara in a pot and add the meatballs. Simmer for 5 minutes.
Split the rolls and lay them open on a baking sheet.
Fill each with 4 meatballs and sauce and top with cheese.
Bake for 5 minutes, until the cheese melts.

recipes.name: Basil pesto pasta
ingredients: 12 oz (340 g) pasta like fusilli or spaghetti
2 cups (50 g) packed fresh basil leaves
1/3 cup (45 g) pine nuts or walnuts
1/2 cup (50 g) grated parmesan, plus more to serve
steps: Boil the pasta in salted water as the package says.
Blend the basil, nuts and garlic in a food processor until finely chopped.
With it running, pour in the olive oil.
Pulse in the parmesan, salt and lemon juice.
Scoop out 1/2 cup of pasta water, then drain the pasta. Ask an adult to help.
Toss the pasta with the pesto, adding splashes of pasta water until silky.
Serve with more parmesan.

recipes.name: Buttered noodles
ingredients: 12 oz (340 g) egg noodles or pasta
steps: Boil the noodles in salted water as the package says.
Scoop out 1/2 cup of the cooking water, then drain. Ask an adult to help.
Put the noodles back in the pot over low heat.
Add the butter, parmesan, garlic powder and a splash of cooking water.
Stir for 1 minute, until glossy and coated.
Season with salt and pepper and top with parsley.

recipes.name: Loaded baked potatoes
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Ask an adult to help.
Scrub the potatoes, dry them and prick each 6 times with a fork.
Rub with oil and salt and put them right on the oven rack.
Bake for 50 to 60 minutes, until a knife slides in easily.
Cut a slit in the top of each and squeeze the ends to open it up. Use a towel, they're very hot.
Add butter, cheese, bacon, sour cream and green onions.

recipes.name: Hot dogs with toppings
steps: Chop the onion. Ask an adult to help.
To boil, put the hot dogs in a pot of simmering water for 5 minutes, until hot all the way through.
To pan-fry, cook them in a pan over medium heat for 5 to 6 minutes, turning, until browned.
Warm the buns in the oven or microwave for 20 seconds.
Put a hot dog in each bun and add toppings.
For little kids, slice hot dogs in quarters lengthwise so they aren't a choking risk.

recipes.name: Chili cheese dogs
steps: Chop the onion. Ask an adult to help.
Cook the beef and half the onion in a pan over medium heat for 6 to 8 minutes, breaking it into tiny bits, until browned.
Stir in the chili powder, cumin, salt, tomato sauce and water.
Simmer for 10 minutes, until thick.
Cook the hot dogs in simmering water for 5 minutes.
Put each hot dog in a bun, spoon chili over it and top with cheese and the rest of the onion.

recipes.name: Cheeseburger sliders
ingredients: 1 package (12 count) slider buns or Hawaiian rolls
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Press the beef evenly into a 9 by 13 inch baking dish and sprinkle with onion powder, salt and pepper.
Bake for 15 to 18 minutes, until 160°F (71°C) inside. Pour off the fat.
Slice the block of rolls in half sideways without pulling them apart and lay the bottoms on a sheet pan.
Lift the beef sheet onto the buns with two spatulas and top with cheese, pickles, ketchup and mustard.
Add the bun tops, brush with butter and sprinkle sesame seeds.
Bake for 5 minutes, until the cheese melts. Cut into 12 sliders.

recipes.name: Chicken burrito bowl
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) boneless skinless chicken thighs
1 can (15 oz / 425 g) black beans, drained and warmed
Salsa, shredded cheese, sour cream and guacamole
steps: Rub the chicken with oil, spices and salt.
Cook in a pan over medium-high heat for 5 to 7 minutes per side, until 165°F (74°C) inside.
Rest for 5 minutes and chop. Ask an adult to help.
Stir the juice of half the lime and the cilantro into the rice.
Fill bowls with rice, beans, corn and chicken.
Top with salsa, cheese, sour cream and guacamole.

recipes.name: Roasted veggie Buddha bowl
ingredients: 1 can (15 oz / 425 g) chickpeas, drained and patted dry
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Ask an adult to help.
Toss the sweet potato, broccoli and chickpeas with the oil, paprika and salt on a sheet pan.
Roast for 25 to 30 minutes, stirring once, until tender and the chickpeas are crisp.
Simmer the quinoa in the water, covered, for 15 minutes. Rest for 5 minutes and fluff.
Whisk the tahini, lemon juice, water, maple syrup and a pinch of salt.
Fill bowls with quinoa, roasted veggies and avocado and drizzle with the sauce.

recipes.name: Pizza quesadilla
ingredients: 1/2 cup (120 ml) pizza sauce, warm, for dipping
steps: Sprinkle half the cheese over half of each tortilla.
Add pepperoni and a pinch of seasoning, then the rest of the cheese.
Fold the tortillas over.
Cook in a dry pan over medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes per side, until golden and melty.
Cut into wedges and dip in warm pizza sauce.

recipes.name: Philly cheesesteak
ingredients: 8 slices provolone or white American cheese
steps: Freeze the steak for 30 minutes so it slices thinly, then shave it as thin as you can. Ask an adult to do the slicing.
Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a big pan over medium heat and cook the onion and pepper for 8 to 10 minutes, until soft. Move to one side.
Turn the heat to high, add the rest of the oil and the steak, and season with salt and pepper.
Cook for 2 to 3 minutes, chopping with a spatula, until no pink is left.
Mix in the onions and split into 4 piles in the pan.
Lay 2 slices of cheese on each pile and let it melt for 1 minute.
Hold an open roll over each pile and scoop it in with a spatula.

recipes.name: Mujadara lentils and rice with crispy onions
ingredients: 1 cup (200 g) brown or green lentils, rinsed
1 cup (190 g) long grain rice, rinsed
Plain yogurt and cucumber to serve
steps: Slice the onions thinly. Ask an adult to help.
Simmer the lentils in plenty of water for 15 minutes, until just tender. Drain.
Heat the oil in a big pot over medium-high heat and cook the onions with 1/2 teaspoon salt for 20 to 25 minutes, stirring often, until dark golden and crispy.
Lift out half the onions onto paper towels.
Add the rice, cumin and cinnamon to the pot and stir for 1 minute.
Add the lentils, water and the rest of the salt and bring to a boil.
Cover, turn the heat to low and cook for 18 to 20 minutes, until the water is gone.
Rest for 10 minutes, fluff, and top with the crispy onions. Serve with yogurt.

recipes.name: Lahmacun Turkish flatbread
ingredients: 8 oz (225 g) ground lamb or beef
4 large flour tortillas or thin flatbreads
Lemon wedges, parsley and sliced onion to serve
steps: Heat the oven to 450°F (230°C). Ask an adult to help.
Pulse the onion, pepper, tomato, garlic and parsley in a food processor until very fine.
Mix in the meat, tomato paste, spices and salt until it's a smooth paste.
Lay the tortillas on 2 baking sheets.
Spread the raw meat mix very thinly all the way to the edges. Wash your hands.
Bake for 8 to 10 minutes, until the meat is cooked through and the edges are crisp.
Squeeze lemon on top, add parsley and onion, and roll up to eat.

recipes.name: Sabich eggplant and egg pita
ingredients: 1 large eggplant, sliced into 1/2 inch rounds
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Ask an adult to help.
Slice the eggplant, brush both sides with oil and sprinkle with salt.
Roast on a lined sheet for 25 minutes, flipping halfway, until soft and browned.
Mix the tomato, cucumber and parsley with a pinch of salt.
Warm the pitas and open them up.
Spread hummus inside and fill with eggplant, egg slices and the salad.
Drizzle with tahini and amba.

recipes.name: Nasi goreng
ingredients: 8 oz (225 g) boneless chicken, cut small
1 teaspoon sambal oelek or chili paste (optional)
Cucumber and tomato slices and fried shallots to serve
steps: Chop the shallots, garlic and chicken. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a wok over medium-high heat and cook the shallots and garlic for 1 minute.
Add the chicken and sambal and stir-fry for 4 to 5 minutes, until cooked through.
Add the rice, kecap manis and soy sauce and toss for 3 to 4 minutes, until hot and evenly brown.
Fry the eggs sunny side up for 2 to 3 minutes.
Serve each plate topped with a fried egg, with cucumber, tomato and fried shallots.

recipes.name: Mie goreng
ingredients: 8 oz (225 g) chicken or shrimp, cut small
steps: Cut the garlic, shallots, chicken and vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Boil the noodles as the package says, drain and rinse.
Heat the oil in a wok over medium-high heat and cook the garlic and shallots for 1 minute.
Add the chicken and stir-fry for 4 minutes, until cooked through.
Add the cabbage and carrot and cook for 2 minutes.
Push everything aside, scramble the eggs in the gap for 1 minute, then mix in.
Add the noodles and sauces and toss for 2 minutes. Top with green onions.

recipes.name: Pancit bihon
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) boneless chicken, thinly sliced
steps: Soak the rice sticks in warm water for 10 minutes, then drain.
Slice the onion, chicken and vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big wok over medium heat and cook the onion and garlic for 2 minutes.
Add the chicken and cook for 5 to 6 minutes, until cooked through.
Add the carrot, cabbage and snow peas and cook for 2 minutes. Lift everything out.
Add the broth, soy sauce and oyster sauce and bring to a boil.
Add the noodles and toss for 3 to 4 minutes, until they soak up the liquid.
Mix the chicken and vegetables back in and serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.name: Lumpia Shanghai
steps: Grate and chop the vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Mix the pork, vegetables, egg, soy sauce, salt and pepper. Wash your hands.
Lay a wrapper like a diamond and put a thin log of filling across the bottom corner.
Roll halfway, fold in the sides, then roll up tightly. Seal the tip with a dab of water.
Cut each roll in half, if you like.
An adult heats 1 inch of oil in a deep pan to 350°F (175°C).
Fry a few at a time for 4 to 5 minutes, turning, until deep golden and the filling is cooked through. An adult should do the frying.
Drain on paper towels and serve with sweet chili sauce.

recipes.name: Cornish pasties
ingredients: 1 cup (225 g) cold butter, in cubes
12 oz (340 g) beef skirt or chuck steak, cut in small pieces
1 teaspoon salt and 1/2 teaspoon pepper, for the filling
steps: Mix the flour and salt, rub in the butter until it looks like crumbs, and stir in enough ice water to make a dough. Chill for 30 minutes.
Dice the beef and vegetables small. Ask an adult to help.
Mix the filling with the salt and pepper.
Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
Roll the dough 1/8 inch thick and cut 6 circles about 8 inches wide using a plate.
Pile filling on half of each, fold over, and crimp the edge tightly.
Brush with egg and cut a small slit on top.
Bake for 20 minutes, then turn the oven to 350°F (175°C) and bake for 35 to 40 minutes more, until golden.

recipes.name: Welsh rarebit
steps: Heat the broiler to high with the rack in the top third. Ask an adult to help.
Melt the butter in a pot over medium heat, stir in the flour and cook for 1 minute.
Whisk in the milk and cook for 2 minutes, until thick.
Take off the heat and stir in the mustard, Worcestershire, cheese and egg yolk.
Toast the bread on one side under the broiler.
Spread the cheese mix thickly on the untoasted side.
Broil for 2 to 3 minutes, until bubbly and golden in spots. Watch closely.

recipes.name: Omurice
ingredients: 1 tablespoon (15 g) butter, plus 2 teaspoons for the eggs
4 oz (115 g) boneless chicken thigh, cut small
1/4 cup (35 g) frozen peas and carrots
3 tablespoons ketchup, plus more on top
steps: Chop the onion and chicken. Ask an adult to help.
Melt the butter in a pan over medium heat and cook the onion and chicken for 5 to 6 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through.
Add the peas and carrots, rice, ketchup, salt and pepper and stir for 3 minutes. Shape half the rice into an oval on each plate.
Beat 2 eggs with 1 tablespoon of milk.
Melt 1 teaspoon butter in a nonstick pan over medium heat and pour in the eggs.
Stir quickly for 20 seconds, then let it set for 30 seconds into a soft omelette.
Slide it over the rice to cover it. Repeat for the second plate.
Draw a ketchup line or picture on top.

recipes.name: Bibim guksu spicy cold noodles
steps: Mix the gochujang, sugar, vinegar, soy sauce, sesame oil and sesame seeds.
Cut the cucumber into thin strips. Ask an adult to help.
Boil the noodles for 2 to 3 minutes, or as the package says.
Drain and rinse under cold water, rubbing them until cold and no longer sticky.
Toss the noodles with the sauce.
Top with cucumber, kimchi and half an egg each.

recipes.name: Japchae
ingredients: 8 oz (225 g) Korean sweet potato glass noodles (dangmyeon)
6 oz (170 g) beef sirloin, cut in thin strips
steps: Slice the beef and vegetables thinly. Ask an adult to help.
Mix the beef with 1 tablespoon soy sauce, 1 teaspoon sugar, 1 teaspoon sesame oil and the garlic.
Boil the noodles for 6 to 7 minutes, until chewy and clear. Drain, rinse, and cut a few times with scissors.
Toss the noodles with the rest of the soy sauce, sugar and sesame oil.
Heat the vegetable oil in a big pan over medium-high heat and cook the onion and carrot for 3 minutes. Add the mushrooms for 2 minutes. Lift out.
Cook the beef for 2 to 3 minutes, until no pink is left.
Wilt the spinach in the pan for 1 minute.
Toss everything with the noodles over low heat for 2 minutes and sprinkle with sesame seeds.

recipes.name: Spanish tortilla
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) Yukon gold potatoes, peeled and thinly sliced
steps: Thinly slice the potatoes and onion. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a 10 inch nonstick pan over medium-low heat.
Add the potatoes, onion and 1 teaspoon salt and cook gently for 20 minutes, turning now and then, until soft but not browned.
Drain the potatoes in a strainer over a bowl, keeping 2 tablespoons of the oil.
Beat the eggs with the rest of the salt, stir in the potatoes and let sit for 5 minutes.
Heat the saved oil in the pan over medium heat, pour in the mix and smooth it out.
Cook for 6 to 8 minutes, until the edges are set and the bottom is golden.
An adult should flip it: set a plate on top, turn the pan over, then slide it back in.
Cook for 3 to 4 minutes more. Rest for 10 minutes and cut into wedges.

recipes.name: Chicken lettuce wraps
ingredients: 1 can (8 oz / 225 g) water chestnuts, drained and chopped
steps: Chop the garlic, water chestnuts and green onions. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pan over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for 6 to 8 minutes, breaking it up, until no pink is left and 165°F (74°C).
Add the garlic and ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the water chestnuts, hoisin, soy sauce, vinegar and sesame oil and cook for 2 minutes.
Stir in the green onions.
Spoon into lettuce leaves and eat like tacos.

recipes.name: Arepa reina pepiada
steps: Mix the masarepa, salt and warm water into a soft dough. Rest for 5 minutes.
Shape 8 balls and flatten each into a disk 1/2 inch thick.
Cook in an oiled pan over medium heat for 6 to 8 minutes per side, until crusty.
Mash the avocados with the mayonnaise, lime juice, cilantro and salt.
Fold in the chicken.
Split each arepa open with a knife like a pocket and stuff with the filling. Ask an adult to help.

recipes.name: Hiyashi chuka cold ramen
ingredients: 2 servings fresh ramen noodles (or instant noodles, seasoning thrown away)
2 large eggs, beaten with a pinch of sugar
4 slices ham, cut in thin strips
steps: Stir the soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, sesame oil and water until the sugar dissolves. Chill.
Cook the eggs as a thin omelette in an oiled pan over medium-low heat for 1 to 2 minutes per side, then cut into thin strips.
Cut the ham, cucumber and tomato. Ask an adult to help.
Boil the noodles as the package says, then rinse under cold water until cold. Drain well.
Put the noodles on plates and arrange the egg, ham, cucumber and tomato in rows on top.
Pour the cold sauce over and sprinkle with sesame seeds.

recipes.name: Shrimp po boy
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) medium shrimp, peeled and deveined
1/2 cup (115 g) mayonnaise mixed with 1 tablespoon hot sauce
Shredded lettuce, sliced tomato and pickles
steps: Soak the shrimp in the buttermilk for 10 minutes.
Mix the cornmeal, flour and Cajun seasoning in a bowl.
An adult heats 1 inch of oil in a deep pan to 350°F (175°C).
Lift the shrimp from the milk, toss them in the cornmeal mix, and shake off the extra.
Fry in batches for 2 to 3 minutes, until golden and the shrimp are opaque inside. An adult should do the frying.
Drain on paper towels.
Spread the rolls with spicy mayo and fill with lettuce, tomato, pickles and shrimp.

recipes.name: Halal cart chicken and rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) boneless skinless chicken thighs
1 1/2 cups (285 g) long grain rice, cooked with 1/2 teaspoon turmeric
1 tablespoon vinegar, 1 teaspoon sugar and 1/4 teaspoon pepper, for the white sauce
Shredded lettuce, tomato wedges and warm pita
steps: Mix the oil, lemon juice, garlic, spices and salt and coat the chicken. Marinate for at least 30 minutes in the fridge.
Whisk the mayonnaise, yogurt, vinegar, sugar and pepper for the white sauce.
Cook the chicken in a big pan over medium-high heat for 5 to 6 minutes per side, until 165°F (74°C) inside.
Rest for 5 minutes and chop into small pieces. Ask an adult to help.
Fill plates with yellow rice, chicken, lettuce and tomato.
Pour lots of white sauce over the top and serve with pita.

recipes.name: Smashed chickpea salad sandwich
ingredients: 1 can (15 oz / 425 g) chickpeas, drained and rinsed
steps: Chop the celery and pickles. Ask an adult to help.
Mash the chickpeas with a fork until mostly broken up.
Mix in the mayonnaise, mustard, lemon juice, celery, pickles, salt and pepper.
Spread on bread with lettuce and tomato.

recipes.name: Minestrone soup
ingredients: 6 cups (1.4 liters) vegetable or chicken broth
1 can (15 oz / 425 g) cannellini or kidney beans, drained
3/4 cup (85 g) small pasta like ditalini
2 cups (60 g) spinach or chopped kale
steps: Chop the vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pot over medium heat and cook the onion, carrots and celery for 6 to 8 minutes, until soft.
Add the garlic and zucchini and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, broth and seasoning and bring to a boil.
Turn the heat down and simmer for 15 minutes.
Add the beans and pasta and simmer for 9 to 10 minutes, until the pasta is tender.
Stir in the spinach for 1 minute, add salt to taste, and serve with parmesan.

recipes.name: French onion soup
ingredients: 4 large yellow onions (about 3 lb / 1.4 kg), thinly sliced
1 teaspoon fresh thyme or 1/2 teaspoon dried
1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar or Worcestershire sauce
2 cups (200 g) grated Gruyere or Swiss cheese
steps: Slice the onions thinly. Ask an adult to help.
Melt the butter in a big pot over medium heat and add the onions, salt and sugar.
Cook for 45 to 60 minutes, stirring every few minutes, until the onions are deep brown and jammy. Turn the heat down if they start to burn.
Stir in the flour for 1 minute.
Add the broth, thyme, bay leaf and vinegar and simmer for 20 minutes. Take out the bay leaf.
Heat the broiler. Ladle the soup into oven-safe bowls on a baking sheet.
Float 2 toasts on each bowl and cover with cheese.
Broil for 2 to 3 minutes, until bubbly and browned. An adult should move the hot bowls.

recipes.name: Split pea soup with ham
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) dried green split peas, rinsed
8 cups (2 liters) chicken broth or water
1 meaty ham bone or 2 cups (300 g) diced ham
steps: Chop the vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pot over medium heat and cook the onion, carrots and celery for 6 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the split peas, broth, ham bone, bay leaf and thyme and bring to a boil.
Turn the heat to low, cover partly and simmer for 1 hour to 1 hour 15 minutes, stirring now and then, until the peas break down.
Take out the ham bone and bay leaf. Pull the meat off the bone, chop it and stir it back in.
Season with salt and pepper. Add water if it's too thick.

recipes.name: Hearty lentil soup
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups (300 g) brown or green lentils, rinsed
steps: Chop the vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pot over medium heat and cook the onion, carrots and celery for 7 minutes.
Add the garlic, cumin and paprika and cook for 1 minute.
Add the lentils, tomatoes and broth and bring to a boil.
Turn the heat down and simmer for 30 to 35 minutes, until the lentils are tender.
Stir in the spinach, lemon juice and salt. Cook for 1 minute more.

recipes.name: Black bean soup
ingredients: 3 cans (15 oz / 425 g each) black beans, with their liquid
4 cups (960 ml) vegetable or chicken broth
Sour cream, avocado and cilantro to serve
steps: Chop the onion, pepper and garlic. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pot over medium heat and cook the onion and pepper for 6 minutes.
Add the garlic, cumin and oregano and cook for 1 minute.
Add the beans with their liquid, broth and salt and bring to a boil.
Simmer for 20 minutes.
Blend about half the soup with a stick blender, leaving some beans whole.
Stir in the lime juice and serve with sour cream, avocado and cilantro.

recipes.name: Butternut squash soup
ingredients: 1 butternut squash (about 3 lb / 1.4 kg), peeled and cubed
4 cups (960 ml) vegetable or chicken broth
1/2 cup (120 ml) cream or coconut milk
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Peel and cube the squash, onion and apple. An adult should do the squash, it's hard to cut.
Toss them with the oil, salt, pepper and cinnamon on a big sheet pan.
Roast for 35 to 40 minutes, until soft and browned at the edges.
Put everything in a big pot with the broth and bring to a simmer.
Blend with a stick blender until smooth.
Stir in the cream and add more salt to taste.

recipes.name: Potato leek soup
ingredients: 3 leeks, white and light green parts, sliced and washed well
2 lb (900 g) Yukon gold potatoes, peeled and cubed
6 cups (1.4 liters) chicken or vegetable broth
1/2 cup (120 ml) heavy cream or milk
steps: Slice the leeks, then swish them in a bowl of water to wash off grit. Ask an adult to help.
Melt the butter in a big pot over medium-low heat and cook the leeks for 8 to 10 minutes, until soft but not brown.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the potatoes, broth, bay leaf and salt and bring to a boil.
Simmer for 20 minutes, until the potatoes are very soft.
Take out the bay leaf and blend until smooth.
Stir in the cream and top with chives. Serve hot, or chilled for vichyssoise.

recipes.name: Loaded baked potato soup
ingredients: 2 1/2 lb (1.1 kg) russet potatoes, peeled and cubed
steps: Chop the bacon, onion and potatoes. Ask an adult to help.
Cook the bacon in a big pot over medium heat for 8 minutes, until crisp. Lift it out and leave 2 tablespoons of fat.
Cook the onion in the fat for 5 minutes.
Stir in the flour for 1 minute, then slowly whisk in the broth and milk.
Add the potatoes, salt and pepper and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes, until tender. Don't let it boil hard.
Mash some of the potatoes in the pot to thicken it.
Stir in 1 cup of the cheese and the sour cream.
Top with bacon, the rest of the cheese and green onions.

recipes.name: Broccoli cheddar soup
ingredients: 2 cups (480 ml) chicken or vegetable broth
steps: Chop the onion and broccoli and grate the carrot. Ask an adult to help.
Melt the butter in a big pot over medium heat and cook the onion for 5 minutes.
Stir in the flour for 1 minute.
Slowly whisk in the milk and broth.
Add the broccoli, carrot, salt, pepper and nutmeg and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes, until the broccoli is tender.
Take the pot off the heat and stir in the cheese a handful at a time until melted.
Blend a little with a stick blender if you like it smoother. Serve in bread bowls for fun.

recipes.name: Cream of mushroom soup
ingredients: 1 teaspoon fresh thyme or 1/2 teaspoon dried
4 cups (960 ml) chicken or vegetable broth
steps: Chop the onion and slice the mushrooms. Ask an adult to help.
Melt the butter in a big pot over medium-high heat and cook the onion for 4 minutes.
Add the mushrooms and cook for 8 to 10 minutes, until their liquid is gone and they brown.
Add the garlic and thyme and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the flour for 1 minute, then slowly add the broth.
Simmer for 15 minutes.
Blend half the soup, or all of it for smooth soup, then stir in the cream, salt and pepper.

recipes.name: New England clam chowder
ingredients: 2 bottles (8 oz / 240 ml each) clam juice
1 1/2 lb (680 g) Yukon gold potatoes, cut in 1/2 inch cubes
3 cans (6.5 oz / 185 g each) chopped clams, with their juice
steps: Chop the bacon, onion, celery and potatoes. Ask an adult to help.
Cook the bacon in a big pot over medium heat for 6 to 8 minutes, until crisp.
Add the onion and celery and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in the flour for 1 minute.
Slowly whisk in the clam juice and milk.
Add the potatoes, bay leaf and thyme and simmer for 15 minutes, until the potatoes are tender.
Add the clams with their juice and the cream and heat for 5 minutes. Don't let it boil.
Season with salt and pepper and serve with oyster crackers.

recipes.name: Corn chowder
ingredients: 3 cups (720 ml) chicken or vegetable broth
1 lb (450 g) potatoes, cut in small cubes
4 cups (600 g) corn kernels, fresh or frozen
steps: Chop the bacon and vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Cook the bacon in a big pot over medium heat for 6 to 8 minutes, until crisp. Lift it out.
Cook the onion and pepper in the fat for 5 minutes.
Stir in the flour for 1 minute, then add the broth.
Add the potatoes and simmer for 12 minutes.
Add the corn, milk, cream, salt and paprika and simmer for 8 minutes, until the potatoes are tender.
Blend about a third of the soup to thicken it and top with the bacon.

recipes.name: Classic vegetable soup
ingredients: 1 cup (120 g) green beans, cut in pieces
steps: Chop the vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pot over medium heat and cook the onion, carrots and celery for 7 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the potatoes, tomatoes, broth, thyme and bay leaf and bring to a boil.
Simmer for 15 minutes.
Add the green beans, corn and peas and simmer for 10 minutes more, until everything is tender.
Take out the bay leaf and season with salt.

recipes.name: Beef and barley soup
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) beef chuck, cut in 3/4 inch cubes
steps: Cut the beef and vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Season the beef with salt and pepper.
Heat the oil in a big pot over medium-high heat and brown the beef in 2 batches for 5 minutes each. Lift it out.
Turn the heat to medium and cook the onion, carrots, celery and mushrooms for 7 minutes.
Add the garlic and tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add the beef, broth, thyme and bay leaves and bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer on low for 45 minutes.
Add the barley and simmer for 40 to 45 minutes more, until the beef and barley are tender. Take out the bay leaves.

recipes.name: Chicken tortilla soup
ingredients: 1 can (14.5 oz / 410 g) fire-roasted diced tomatoes
1 1/2 lb (680 g) boneless skinless chicken breasts
1 can (15 oz / 425 g) black beans, drained
Tortilla chips, avocado, shredded cheese, sour cream and cilantro
steps: Chop the onion, jalapeno and garlic. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pot over medium heat and cook the onion and jalapeno for 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, chili powder and cumin and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, broth and whole chicken breasts and bring to a boil.
Simmer for 15 to 20 minutes, until the chicken is 165°F (74°C) inside.
Lift out the chicken, shred it with two forks and put it back.
Add the beans, corn and salt and simmer for 5 minutes. Stir in the juice of the lime.
Serve with crushed chips, avocado, cheese, sour cream and cilantro.

recipes.name: Pozole rojo
ingredients: 2 1/2 lb (1.1 kg) boneless pork shoulder, cut in 2 inch chunks
2 cans (25 oz / 700 g each) white hominy, drained and rinsed
Shredded cabbage, sliced radishes, chopped onion, lime wedges and tostadas to serve
steps: Put the pork, onion halves, 4 garlic cloves, bay leaves, salt and water in a big pot and bring to a boil. Skim off the foam.
Cover partly and simmer for 1 hour 30 minutes, until the pork is very tender.
Meanwhile, pull the stems and seeds out of the chilies. Ask an adult to help.
Soak the chilies in 2 cups of hot water for 20 minutes, until soft.
Blend the chilies, 1 1/2 cups of their soaking water, the rest of the garlic, oregano and cumin until very smooth.
Pour the chili sauce through a strainer into the pot. Take out the onion and bay leaves.
Add the hominy and simmer for 30 minutes. Shred the pork a little with a spoon and add salt to taste.
Serve with cabbage, radishes, onion, lime and tostadas on the side.

recipes.name: Sopa de fideo
ingredients: 7 oz (200 g) fideo noodles or thin spaghetti broken into 1 inch pieces
2 tomatoes or 1 can (14.5 oz / 410 g) diced tomatoes
Lime wedges and crumbled queso fresco to serve
steps: Blend the tomatoes, onion and garlic with 1 cup of the broth until smooth.
Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat.
Add the noodles and stir for 3 to 4 minutes, until golden brown. Watch closely so they don't burn.
Carefully pour in the tomato mix. It will sizzle and splatter, so ask an adult to help.
Add the rest of the broth, salt and cilantro and bring to a boil.
Simmer for 8 to 10 minutes, until the noodles are tender.
Serve with lime and queso fresco.

recipes.name: Albondigas meatball soup
ingredients: 1/3 cup (65 g) uncooked long grain rice
1 teaspoon salt, plus more to taste
steps: Mix the beef, rice, egg, mint, salt and cumin. Roll into 1 inch balls and wash your hands.
Chop the vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pot over medium heat and cook the onion for 5 minutes. Add the garlic for 1 minute.
Blend the tomatoes until smooth and add them with the broth. Bring to a boil.
Gently drop in the meatballs, carrots and potato.
Simmer for 25 minutes, until the rice in the meatballs is tender.
Add the zucchini and simmer for 8 minutes more. Add salt to taste.

recipes.name: Caldo de pollo
ingredients: 3 lb (1.4 kg) bone-in chicken pieces like thighs and drumsticks
2 ears of corn, each cut in 3 pieces
Lime wedges, cilantro, chopped onion and warm tortillas to serve
steps: Put the chicken, water, onion, garlic and salt in a big pot and bring to a boil. Skim off the foam.
Turn the heat to low and simmer for 30 minutes.
Cut the vegetables into big chunks. Ask an adult to help.
Add the carrots, potatoes and corn and simmer for 15 minutes.
Add the zucchini and cabbage and simmer for 10 minutes more, until all the vegetables are tender and the chicken is 165°F (74°C).
Taste and add more salt if needed.
Serve in big bowls with lime, cilantro, onion and tortillas.

recipes.name: Tomato spinach tortellini soup
ingredients: 4 cups (960 ml) chicken or vegetable broth
steps: Chop the onion and garlic. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat and cook the onion for 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and seasoning and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and broth and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the tortellini and simmer for 6 to 8 minutes, until tender.
Stir in the spinach and cream until the spinach wilts.
Season with salt and pepper and serve with parmesan.

recipes.name: Italian wedding soup
ingredients: 8 oz (225 g) ground beef or a mix of beef and pork
1/4 cup (25 g) grated parmesan, plus more to serve
3/4 cup (120 g) acini di pepe or orzo pasta
4 cups (120 g) chopped spinach or escarole
steps: Mix the meat, breadcrumbs, parmesan, egg, garlic and salt and roll into 3/4 inch meatballs. Wash your hands.
Chop the onion and carrots. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pot over medium heat and cook the onion and carrots for 6 minutes.
Add the broth and bring to a boil.
Gently add the meatballs and the pasta.
Simmer for 10 to 12 minutes, until the pasta is tender and the meatballs are cooked through.
Stir in the spinach for 1 to 2 minutes, until wilted. Serve with parmesan.

recipes.name: Pasta e fagioli
ingredients: 8 oz (225 g) ground beef or Italian sausage (optional)
2 cans (15 oz / 425 g each) cannellini or kidney beans, drained
steps: Chop the vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Cook the meat in the oil in a big pot over medium heat for 6 minutes, breaking it up, until browned. Drain the fat.
Add the onion, carrots and celery and cook for 6 minutes.
Add the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, broth, seasoning and beans and bring to a boil.
Simmer for 15 minutes.
Add the pasta and simmer for 9 to 10 minutes, until tender. Add salt and serve with parmesan.

recipes.name: Ribollita Tuscan bread soup
ingredients: 3 tablespoons olive oil, plus more to serve
2 cans (15 oz / 425 g each) cannellini beans, drained
1 bunch lacinato kale, stems removed, chopped
4 thick slices stale crusty bread, torn
steps: Chop the vegetables and kale. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pot over medium heat and cook the onion, carrots and celery for 10 minutes.
Add the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, beans, broth, kale and salt and bring to a boil.
Simmer for 25 minutes.
Stir in the torn bread and simmer for 10 minutes, until the bread breaks down and the soup is thick.
Drizzle with olive oil and top with parmesan.

recipes.name: Zuppa Toscana
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) Italian sausage, casings removed
1 1/2 lb (680 g) russet potatoes, cut in half and thinly sliced
steps: Chop the bacon, onion and garlic and slice the potatoes. Ask an adult to help.
Cook the sausage and bacon in a big pot over medium heat for 8 to 10 minutes, until browned. Drain off most of the fat.
Add the onion and cook for 5 minutes, then the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the broth, water, potatoes and chili flakes and bring to a boil.
Simmer for 15 minutes, until the potatoes are tender.
Stir in the kale and cream and simmer for 3 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper.

recipes.name: Egg drop soup
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cornstarch mixed with 3 tablespoons water
steps: Bring the broth, ginger, soy sauce, turmeric and pepper to a boil in a pot.
Stir in the cornstarch mix and simmer for 1 minute, until a little thick.
Turn the heat to low so the soup barely bubbles.
Stir the soup in a circle and slowly drizzle in the eggs in a thin stream.
Wait 10 seconds, then gently stir to make silky ribbons.
Turn off the heat and stir in the sesame oil. Top with green onions.

recipes.name: Hot and sour soup
ingredients: 4 oz (115 g) firm tofu, cut in thin strips
3 tablespoons rice vinegar or Chinese black vinegar
1/2 teaspoon white pepper, or more for extra heat
3 tablespoons cornstarch mixed with 1/4 cup (60 ml) water
steps: Slice the mushrooms, tofu and green onions. Ask an adult to help.
Bring the broth to a boil and add the mushrooms and bamboo shoots. Simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the tofu, soy sauce, vinegar, sugar and white pepper.
Stir in the cornstarch mix and simmer for 1 to 2 minutes, until thick.
Turn the heat to low and drizzle in the eggs while stirring slowly.
Stir in the sesame oil and top with green onions. Taste and add more vinegar or pepper if you like.

recipes.name: Wonton soup
ingredients: 1 tablespoon soy sauce, for the broth
steps: Chop the shrimp and green onion. Ask an adult to help.
Mix the pork, shrimp, green onion, ginger, soy sauce, sesame oil and salt. Wash your hands after.
Put 1 teaspoon of filling in the middle of a wrapper and wet the edges.
Fold into a triangle, press out the air, then bring the two bottom corners together and pinch.
Bring the broth and soy sauce to a simmer in a pot.
Boil the wontons in a separate big pot of water for 4 to 5 minutes, until they float and the filling is cooked through.
Add the bok choy to the broth for 2 minutes.
Lift the wontons into bowls and ladle the broth and bok choy over them. Top with green onions.

recipes.name: Chinese chicken and sweet corn soup
ingredients: 8 oz (225 g) boneless chicken breast, finely chopped
2 tablespoons cornstarch mixed with 3 tablespoons water
steps: Chop the chicken finely. Ask an adult to help, and wash your hands after.
Bring the broth, creamed corn and ginger to a boil in a pot.
Add the chicken and simmer for 5 minutes, until 165°F (74°C) and no pink is left.
Stir in the soy sauce, pepper and cornstarch mix and simmer for 1 minute, until thick.
Turn the heat to low and drizzle in the eggs while stirring slowly.
Stir in the sesame oil and top with green onion.

recipes.name: Miso soup
ingredients: 2 teaspoons dashi powder, or homemade dashi
3 tablespoons white or yellow miso paste
7 oz (200 g) silken or soft tofu, cut in small cubes
steps: Soak the wakame in a bowl of water for 5 minutes, then drain.
Bring the water and dashi powder to a simmer in a pot.
Cut the tofu and green onions. Ask an adult to help.
Put the miso in a ladle, dip it in the broth and stir with chopsticks until dissolved.
Turn the heat to low and add the tofu and wakame for 1 to 2 minutes, until hot.
Don't let it boil after adding miso. Top with green onions and serve.

recipes.name: Easy shoyu chicken ramen
ingredients: 4 green onions, whites and greens apart
1 lb (450 g) boneless skinless chicken thighs
4 servings fresh or dried ramen noodles
Nori sheets, corn and bamboo shoots to top
steps: Simmer the broth, garlic, ginger, green onion whites, soy sauce and mirin in a big pot for 15 minutes.
Add the chicken and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes, until 165°F (74°C) inside. Lift it out and slice it. Ask an adult to help.
Boil the eggs in another pot for 7 minutes, then cool in ice water and peel. Cut in half.
Strain the broth to take out the garlic and ginger, and stir in the sesame oil.
Cook the noodles as the package says and drain.
Put noodles in each bowl and ladle hot broth over them.
Top with chicken, egg halves, sliced green onion greens, nori, corn and bamboo shoots.

recipes.name: Kake udon noodle soup
ingredients: 2 packs (7 oz / 200 g each) frozen udon noodles
2 slices kamaboko fish cake or a soft boiled egg (optional)
steps: Bring the water, dashi powder, soy sauce, mirin and sugar to a simmer in a pot.
Cook the frozen udon in a separate pot of boiling water for 1 to 2 minutes, until loose and hot. Drain.
Put the noodles in 2 bowls.
Ladle the hot broth over them.
Top with green onions, fish cake or egg, and a pinch of shichimi.

recipes.name: Kimchi jjigae
ingredients: 2 cups (300 g) well-fermented kimchi, chopped, plus 1/4 cup (60 ml) kimchi juice
8 oz (225 g) pork belly or pork shoulder, thinly sliced
3 cups (720 ml) water or anchovy broth
steps: Slice the pork, onion and tofu and chop the kimchi. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a pot over medium-high heat and cook the pork for 3 to 4 minutes, until browned.
Add the kimchi and onion and cook for 4 minutes.
Stir in the gochugaru, gochujang, sugar and soy sauce.
Add the kimchi juice and water and bring to a boil.
Simmer for 15 minutes.
Lay the tofu on top and simmer for 5 minutes more. Add green onions and serve with rice.

recipes.name: Doenjang jjigae
ingredients: 3 cups (720 ml) water or anchovy broth
1 small potato, cut in small cubes
1 small zucchini, cut in small cubes
steps: Cut all the vegetables and tofu. Ask an adult to help.
Bring the water to a boil in a pot and stir in the doenjang and gochujang until dissolved.
Add the potato and onion and simmer for 8 minutes.
Add the zucchini, mushrooms and garlic and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the tofu and simmer for 3 minutes more.
Top with green onion and chili and serve bubbling with rice.

recipes.name: Sundubu jjigae soft tofu stew
ingredients: 4 oz (115 g) pork or a few shrimp and clams
2 cups (480 ml) water or anchovy broth
1 tube (12 oz / 340 g) extra soft tofu
steps: Chop the garlic, zucchini and green onion. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a small pot over medium-low heat and stir in the gochugaru and garlic for 30 seconds. Don't let it burn.
Add the pork and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the water and soy sauce and bring to a boil.
Squeeze or spoon in the soft tofu in big pieces, and add the zucchini and seafood.
Simmer for 5 to 6 minutes, until the meat or seafood is cooked through.
Crack the eggs on top and cook for 1 minute. Top with green onion and serve with rice.

recipes.name: Miyeok guk seaweed soup
ingredients: 6 oz (170 g) beef brisket or sirloin, thinly sliced
2 tablespoons soup soy sauce or regular soy sauce
steps: Soak the seaweed in a big bowl of water for 20 minutes. It grows a lot.
Drain, squeeze out the water and cut into bite-size pieces. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the sesame oil in a pot over medium heat and cook the beef for 2 to 3 minutes.
Add the seaweed and garlic and stir for 2 minutes.
Add the soy sauce and water and bring to a boil.
Simmer for 20 minutes. Add salt to taste and serve with rice. Koreans eat this on birthdays.

recipes.name: Tteokguk rice cake soup
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) sliced oval rice cakes (tteok)
6 oz (170 g) beef brisket or sirloin, thinly sliced
8 cups (2 liters) beef broth or water
2 tablespoons soup soy sauce or regular soy sauce
steps: Soak the rice cakes in cold water for 20 minutes.
Heat the sesame oil in a pot over medium heat and cook the beef and garlic for 3 minutes.
Add the broth and soy sauce and bring to a boil. Simmer for 10 minutes.
Drain the rice cakes and add them. Cook for 4 to 5 minutes, until they float and are soft.
Drizzle in the eggs while stirring gently.
Add salt to taste and top with green onions and seaweed. Koreans eat this on New Year's Day.

recipes.name: Easy beef pho
ingredients: 3 inch piece fresh ginger, cut in half lengthwise
8 oz (225 g) beef sirloin or eye of round, very thinly sliced
Bean sprouts, Thai basil, cilantro, lime wedges, hoisin and sriracha
steps: Have an adult char the onion and ginger cut side down in a dry pan over high heat for 5 minutes, until blackened in spots.
Toast the star anise, cinnamon, cloves and coriander in a dry pot for 1 to 2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the broth, onion and ginger and bring to a boil.
Simmer for 45 minutes, then strain. Stir in the fish sauce and sugar.
Soak or cook the noodles as the package says and drain.
Freeze the beef for 20 minutes so it slices paper thin, then slice it. Ask an adult to help.
Put noodles and raw beef slices in bowls and ladle boiling broth over them. The broth cooks the beef in about 1 minute. If you prefer, cook the beef in the broth for 1 minute first.
Top with sprouts, herbs and lime, and add hoisin and sriracha to taste.

recipes.name: Chicken pho
ingredients: 3 inch piece fresh ginger, cut in half lengthwise
2 lb (900 g) bone-in chicken thighs or breasts
Bean sprouts, Thai basil, cilantro, sliced green onion and lime wedges
steps: Have an adult char the onion and ginger cut side down in a dry pan over high heat for 5 minutes.
Toast the star anise, cinnamon and coriander in a dry pot for 1 to 2 minutes.
Add the broth, water, onion, ginger and chicken and bring to a boil. Skim off the foam.
Simmer for 30 minutes, until the chicken is 165°F (74°C) inside.
Lift out the chicken, shred the meat and throw away the skin and bones.
Strain the broth and stir in the fish sauce and sugar.
Cook the noodles as the package says and divide between bowls with the chicken.
Ladle hot broth over and top with sprouts, herbs, green onion and lime.

recipes.name: Tom yum goong
ingredients: 2 stalks lemongrass, cut in 2 inch pieces and bashed
1 lb (450 g) shrimp, peeled and deveined
1 tablespoon nam prik pao (Thai chili paste), optional
steps: Cut and bash the lemongrass with the back of a knife. Ask an adult to help.
Bring the broth, lemongrass, galangal, lime leaves and chilies to a boil.
Simmer for 10 minutes so the flavors soak in.
Add the mushrooms and simmer for 3 minutes.
Add the shrimp and cook for 2 to 3 minutes, until pink and curled.
Turn off the heat and stir in the fish sauce, chili paste and lime juice. Taste and adjust.
Top with cilantro. Don't eat the lemongrass, galangal or lime leaves.

recipes.name: Tom kha gai coconut chicken soup
ingredients: 2 cans (13.5 oz / 400 ml each) coconut milk
2 stalks lemongrass, cut in 2 inch pieces and bashed
1 lb (450 g) boneless skinless chicken breast, thinly sliced
Cilantro and sliced chilies to serve
steps: Slice the chicken and mushrooms and bash the lemongrass. Ask an adult to help.
Bring the coconut milk, broth, lemongrass, galangal and lime leaves to a gentle simmer.
Simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the chicken and mushrooms and simmer for 6 to 8 minutes, until the chicken is 165°F (74°C).
Turn off the heat and stir in the fish sauce, sugar and lime juice.
Top with cilantro and chilies. Leave the lemongrass, galangal and lime leaves in the bowl.

recipes.name: Khao soi curry noodle soup
ingredients: 3 tablespoons red or yellow curry paste
2 cans (13.5 oz / 400 ml each) coconut milk
1 1/2 lb (680 g) bone-in chicken drumsticks or boneless thighs
Lime wedges, sliced shallots, cilantro and pickled mustard greens
steps: Heat the oil in a big pot over medium heat and stir in the curry paste and curry powder for 1 minute.
Add 1 can of coconut milk and simmer for 3 minutes.
Add the rest of the coconut milk, broth and chicken and bring to a simmer.
Simmer for 25 to 30 minutes, until the chicken is tender and 165°F (74°C).
Stir in the fish sauce and sugar.
Boil 3/4 of the noodles as the package says. An adult can fry the rest in hot oil for 1 minute to make a crispy topping.
Divide the boiled noodles and chicken between bowls and ladle the curry over.
Top with crispy noodles, shallots, cilantro and lime.

recipes.name: Mulligatawny soup
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) boneless skinless chicken thighs
Cooked rice and cilantro to serve
steps: Chop the vegetables and apple. Ask an adult to help.
Melt the butter in a big pot over medium heat and cook the onion, carrots, celery and apple for 7 minutes.
Add the garlic, ginger and curry powder and cook for 1 minute.
Add the lentils, broth and whole chicken thighs and bring to a boil.
Simmer for 20 to 25 minutes, until the chicken is 165°F (74°C) and the lentils are soft.
Lift out the chicken and shred it.
Blend the soup until mostly smooth, then add the chicken, coconut milk, salt and lemon juice.
Heat for 3 minutes and serve over a spoonful of rice with cilantro.

recipes.name: Turkish red lentil soup
ingredients: 7 cups (1.7 liters) vegetable or chicken broth
1 tablespoon butter and 1 teaspoon paprika or chili flakes, for the topping
steps: Chop the vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pot over medium heat and cook the onion and carrot for 6 minutes.
Add the garlic, tomato paste, cumin and paprika and cook for 1 minute.
Add the lentils, broth and salt and bring to a boil.
Simmer for 20 to 25 minutes, until the lentils fall apart.
Blend until smooth.
Melt the butter with the paprika for 30 seconds and drizzle it over each bowl. Squeeze in lemon.

recipes.name: Avgolemono Greek lemon chicken soup
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) boneless skinless chicken breasts
1/2 cup (100 g) long grain rice or orzo
steps: Bring the broth to a boil in a big pot and add the whole chicken breasts.
Simmer for 15 to 20 minutes, until 165°F (74°C) inside. Lift out and shred.
Add the rice to the broth and simmer for 15 minutes, until tender.
Whisk the eggs and lemon juice in a bowl until frothy.
Very slowly whisk 2 cups of hot broth into the eggs, a ladle at a time. This warms the eggs so they don't scramble. Ask an adult to help.
Turn the heat to low and stir the egg mix back into the pot.
Stir for 3 to 4 minutes, until silky and slightly thick. Don't let it boil.
Add the chicken, salt and pepper and top with dill.

recipes.name: Fasolada Greek bean soup
ingredients: 1/3 cup (80 ml) olive oil, plus more to serve
3 cans (15 oz / 425 g each) cannellini or great northern beans, drained
5 cups (1.2 liters) vegetable broth or water
steps: Chop the vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pot over medium heat and cook the onion, carrots and celery for 8 minutes.
Add the garlic and tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, beans, broth, bay leaf, oregano and salt and bring to a boil.
Simmer for 35 to 40 minutes, until thick and the vegetables are very soft.
Mash a few beans against the side of the pot to thicken it.
Serve with parsley, a drizzle of olive oil and lemon.

recipes.name: Gazpacho cold tomato soup
ingredients: 2 lb (900 g) ripe tomatoes, cored and chopped
1 red or green bell pepper, chopped
1 slice stale white bread, crust removed (optional)
1/3 cup (80 ml) extra virgin olive oil
2 tablespoons sherry or red wine vinegar
Diced cucumber, pepper and croutons to top
steps: Chop all the vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Put the tomatoes, cucumber, pepper, onion, garlic and bread in a blender.
Blend for 1 to 2 minutes, until very smooth.
With the blender running, pour in the oil, then the vinegar and salt.
Pour into a jar and chill for at least 2 hours, until very cold.
Stir, taste for salt, and serve cold topped with diced vegetables and croutons.

recipes.name: Jamaican red pea soup
ingredients: 2 cans (15 oz / 425 g each) red kidney beans, with their liquid
8 oz (225 g) smoked turkey or salted beef, chopped (optional)
1 whole scotch bonnet pepper (don't cut it)
1 lb (450 g) potatoes or yams, cubed
1 cup (125 g) flour, 1/4 teaspoon salt and 1/3 cup (80 ml) water, for spinners
steps: Chop the onion, garlic, green onions and potatoes. Ask an adult to help.
Put the beans, meat, water and coconut milk in a big pot and bring to a boil.
Add the onion, garlic, green onions, thyme and whole scotch bonnet. Simmer for 30 minutes.
Mash some of the beans against the side of the pot to thicken the soup.
Add the potatoes and simmer for 15 minutes.
