Mix the flour, salt and water into a stiff dough. Roll pieces between your palms into thin 2 inch logs called spinners.
Drop the spinners into the soup and simmer for 15 minutes more, until cooked through.
Take out the scotch bonnet and thyme stems carefully, add salt to taste, and serve.

recipes.name: West African peanut soup
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) boneless chicken thighs, cut in chunks
2 cups (60 g) chopped spinach or collards
Chopped peanuts and cilantro to serve
steps: Chop the onion, garlic, chicken and sweet potato. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pot over medium heat and cook the onion for 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, ginger and chicken and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, broth and sweet potato and bring to a boil.
Whisk the peanut butter with 1 cup of hot broth from the pot until smooth, then stir it back in.
Add the cayenne and salt and simmer for 20 to 25 minutes, until the sweet potato is soft and the chicken is 165°F (74°C).
Stir in the greens for 2 minutes. Top with peanuts and cilantro.

recipes.name: Harira Moroccan soup
ingredients: 8 oz (225 g) lamb or beef, cut in small cubes (optional)
1/2 cup (100 g) brown or green lentils, rinsed
1/2 cup (15 g) chopped cilantro and parsley
1/4 cup (30 g) broken vermicelli or rice
2 tablespoons flour mixed with 1/2 cup (120 ml) water
Lemon wedges and dates to serve
steps: Chop the meat, onion, celery and herbs. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pot over medium heat and brown the meat for 5 minutes.
Add the onion, celery and spices and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the lentils, chickpeas, tomatoes, water and half the herbs and bring to a boil.
Simmer for 40 minutes, until the lentils and meat are tender.
Add the vermicelli and salt and simmer for 5 minutes.
Slowly stir in the flour and water mix and simmer for 5 minutes, until silky.
Stir in the rest of the herbs and serve with lemon and dates.

recipes.name: Sancocho
ingredients: 2 green plantains, peeled and cut in chunks
1 lb (450 g) yuca, peeled and cut in chunks (frozen works)
2 ears of corn, cut in 3 pieces each
1 lb (450 g) potatoes, cut in chunks
Cooked white rice and avocado to serve
steps: Rub the chicken with lime juice. Wash your hands.
Chop the onion, pepper and garlic and peel and cut the plantains and yuca. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a very big pot over medium heat and cook the onion, pepper, garlic and half the cilantro for 5 minutes.
Add the chicken and cook for 5 minutes, turning.
Add the water and salt and bring to a boil. Simmer for 30 minutes.
Add the plantains, yuca and corn and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add the potatoes and simmer for 20 minutes more, until everything is tender and the chicken is 165°F (74°C).
Stir in the rest of the cilantro and serve with rice and avocado.

recipes.name: Ajiaco Colombian chicken potato soup
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) small yellow potatoes, peeled and sliced
1 lb (450 g) russet potatoes, peeled and sliced
1 lb (450 g) red potatoes, peeled and cut in chunks
3 ears of corn, cut in 3 pieces each
2 tablespoons dried guascas herb (optional, but traditional)
Heavy cream, capers and avocado to serve
steps: Simmer the chicken, broth, onion and garlic in a big pot for 30 minutes, until the chicken is 165°F (74°C). Lift out the chicken and shred it.
Peel and cut the potatoes. Ask an adult to help.
Add all the potatoes and the corn to the broth and simmer for 30 minutes. The yellow and russet potatoes will melt and thicken the soup.
Stir in the guascas and salt and simmer for 10 minutes.
Take out the onion and add the chicken back in.
Serve with a drizzle of cream, a few capers and sliced avocado.

recipes.name: Caldo verde
ingredients: 3 tablespoons olive oil, plus more to serve
2 lb (900 g) russet potatoes, peeled and cubed
7 cups (1.7 liters) water or chicken broth
8 oz (225 g) Portuguese chourico or Spanish chorizo, sliced
1 bunch collard greens or kale, sliced into very thin ribbons
steps: Chop the onion, garlic and potatoes, slice the sausage, and roll the greens up and slice them very thinly. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pot over medium heat and cook the onion for 5 minutes. Add the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the potatoes, water and salt and simmer for 20 minutes, until very soft.
Mash or blend the soup until smooth.
Brown the sausage in a pan for 3 to 4 minutes.
Add the greens to the soup and simmer for 5 minutes, until tender but still bright green.
Add the sausage and serve with a drizzle of olive oil.

recipes.name: Borscht
ingredients: 8 cups (2 liters) beef or vegetable broth
Sour cream and fresh dill to serve
steps: Peel and grate the beets and carrot and chop the onion and potatoes. Ask an adult to help, and wear gloves because beets stain.
Heat the oil in a big pot over medium heat and cook the onion and carrot for 5 minutes.
Add the beets, tomato paste and vinegar and cook for 10 minutes, stirring.
Add the broth, potatoes and bay leaf and bring to a boil.
Simmer for 15 minutes.
Add the cabbage, garlic, salt and sugar and simmer for 15 minutes more, until the cabbage is tender.
Take out the bay leaf and serve with sour cream and dill.

recipes.name: Hungarian goulash soup
ingredients: 2 lb (900 g) beef chuck, cut in 3/4 inch cubes
steps: Cut the beef and vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pot over medium heat and cook the onions for 8 minutes, until golden.
Add the beef and garlic and cook for 5 minutes, until browned on the outside.
Take the pot off the heat and stir in the paprika and caraway. Paprika burns fast.
Add the tomato paste and broth and bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer on low for 1 hour.
Add the carrots, pepper, potatoes and salt and simmer for 30 minutes more, until the beef and potatoes are tender.

recipes.name: Cabbage soup
ingredients: 1 small head green cabbage, chopped (about 8 cups / 600 g)
8 cups (2 liters) vegetable or chicken broth
steps: Chop the vegetables and cabbage. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pot over medium heat and cook the onion, carrots and celery for 7 minutes.
Add the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the cabbage, tomatoes, broth, thyme, paprika, salt and pepper and bring to a boil.
Simmer for 25 minutes, until the cabbage is tender.
Stir in the lemon juice and taste for salt.

recipes.name: Chicken and rice soup
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) boneless skinless chicken breasts
3/4 cup (140 g) long grain white rice
steps: Chop the vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pot over medium heat and cook the onion, carrots and celery for 6 minutes. Add the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the broth, chicken and thyme and bring to a boil.
Simmer for 15 to 20 minutes, until the chicken is 165°F (74°C) inside. Lift it out and shred it.
Add the rice and simmer for 15 minutes, until tender.
Add the chicken, salt, pepper and parsley.

recipes.name: Creamy chicken gnocchi soup
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups (360 ml) half and half or milk
steps: Chop the vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Melt the butter in a big pot over medium heat and cook the onion, carrots and celery for 7 minutes.
Add the garlic for 1 minute, then stir in the flour for 1 minute.
Slowly whisk in the broth and half and half.
Add the chicken, salt and thyme and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the gnocchi and simmer for 3 to 4 minutes, until they float.
Stir in the spinach until wilted.

recipes.name: Taco soup
ingredients: 1 packet (1 oz / 28 g) ranch seasoning mix (optional)
2 cans (14.5 oz / 410 g each) diced tomatoes
1 can (15 oz / 425 g) black beans, drained
1 can (15 oz / 425 g) pinto beans, drained
3 cups (720 ml) beef or chicken broth
Shredded cheese, sour cream, tortilla chips and avocado to serve
steps: Chop the onion. Ask an adult to help.
Cook the beef and onion in a big pot over medium heat for 8 minutes, breaking it up, until browned. Drain the fat.
Stir in the taco and ranch seasonings.
Add the tomatoes, beans, corn and broth and bring to a boil.
Simmer for 20 minutes.
Serve topped with cheese, sour cream, chips and avocado.

recipes.name: Cheeseburger soup
steps: Chop the vegetables and potatoes. Ask an adult to help.
Cook the beef in a big pot over medium heat for 6 to 8 minutes, breaking it up, until browned. Drain it and set it aside.
Melt the butter in the pot and cook the onion, carrot and celery for 5 minutes.
Stir in the flour for 1 minute, then add the broth and potatoes.
Simmer for 15 minutes, until the potatoes are tender.
Add the milk and beef and heat for 5 minutes. Don't let it boil.
Take off the heat and stir in the cheese, ketchup, mustard and salt.

recipes.name: Lasagna soup
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) ground beef or Italian sausage
steps: Chop the onion and garlic. Ask an adult to help.
Cook the meat and onion in a big pot over medium heat for 8 minutes, breaking it up, until browned. Drain the fat.
Add the garlic and tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, broth, seasoning and salt and bring to a boil.
Add the broken noodles and simmer for 12 to 15 minutes, stirring often, until tender.
Mix the ricotta, mozzarella and parmesan in a bowl.
Ladle soup into bowls and top each with a big spoonful of the cheese mix.

recipes.name: Slow cooker vegetable beef soup
ingredients: 2 lb (900 g) beef chuck, cut in 1 inch cubes
1 teaspoon salt, plus more to taste
steps: Cut the beef and vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Season the beef with salt and pepper and brown it in the oil in a pan over medium-high heat for 5 minutes. This step is optional but adds flavor.
Put the beef, onion, carrots, celery, potatoes, tomatoes, broth, Worcestershire, thyme and bay leaves in the slow cooker.
Cover and cook on low for 7 to 8 hours, or on high for 4 to 5 hours, until the beef is tender.
Stir in the green beans and corn and cook for 20 minutes more.
Take out the bay leaves and add salt to taste.

recipes.name: Carrot ginger soup
ingredients: 2 lb (900 g) carrots, peeled and sliced
4 cups (960 ml) vegetable or chicken broth
1/2 cup (120 ml) coconut milk or cream
steps: Chop the onion and slice the carrots. Ask an adult to help.
Melt the butter in a big pot over medium heat and cook the onion for 5 minutes.
Add the carrots, ginger and garlic and cook for 3 minutes.
Add the broth and salt and bring to a boil.
Simmer for 20 to 25 minutes, until the carrots are very soft.
Blend until smooth.
Stir in the coconut milk and lemon juice.

recipes.name: Roasted red pepper tomato soup
ingredients: 4 red bell peppers, cut in big pieces
1 lb (450 g) tomatoes, cut in half
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Ask an adult to help.
Cut the peppers, onion and tomatoes.
Toss them with the garlic, oil and salt on a big sheet pan.
Roast for 30 minutes, until soft and charred at the edges.
Put everything in a pot with the paprika and broth and simmer for 5 minutes.
Blend until smooth, then stir in the cream. Top with basil.

recipes.name: Creamy cauliflower soup
ingredients: 1 large head cauliflower, cut in florets
4 cups (960 ml) vegetable or chicken broth
1/2 cup (50 g) grated cheddar or parmesan (optional)
steps: Chop the onion, garlic, cauliflower and potato. Ask an adult to help.
Melt the butter in a big pot over medium heat and cook the onion for 5 minutes. Add the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the cauliflower, potato, broth and salt and bring to a boil.
Simmer for 20 minutes, until very soft.
Blend until smooth.
Stir in the milk, cheese and nutmeg and heat through.

recipes.name: Matzo ball soup
ingredients: 1/4 cup (60 ml) vegetable oil or schmaltz
1/4 cup (60 ml) seltzer water or chicken broth
steps: Whisk the eggs, oil and seltzer. Stir in the matzo meal and salt.
Cover and chill for 30 minutes, until firm.
Slice the carrots and celery. Ask an adult to help.
Bring a big pot of salted water to a boil.
With wet hands, gently roll the mix into 1 inch balls. Don't pack them tight.
Drop them into the boiling water, cover, and simmer for 30 to 35 minutes, until puffed and cooked through. Don't lift the lid early.
Meanwhile, simmer the broth, carrots and celery for 15 minutes and add the chicken.
Lift the matzo balls into the soup with a slotted spoon and top with dill.

recipes.name: Tuscan white bean soup
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dried rosemary or 1 sprig fresh
3 cans (15 oz / 425 g each) cannellini beans, drained
6 cups (1.4 liters) vegetable or chicken broth
steps: Chop the vegetables and kale. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pot over medium heat and cook the onion, carrots and celery for 8 minutes.
Add the garlic and rosemary for 1 minute.
Add the beans, broth and parmesan rind and bring to a boil.
Simmer for 15 minutes.
Blend about a third of the soup to make it creamy.
Stir in the kale and salt and simmer for 5 minutes. Take out the rind and add the lemon juice.

recipes.name: Tomato egg drop soup
ingredients: 4 cups (960 ml) chicken broth or water
1 tablespoon cornstarch mixed with 2 tablespoons water
steps: Cut the tomatoes into wedges. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat and cook the tomatoes for 3 to 4 minutes, until soft and juicy.
Add the broth, sugar, salt and pepper and simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in the cornstarch mix and simmer for 1 minute.
Turn the heat to low and slowly drizzle in the eggs while stirring.
Add the sesame oil and green onion.

recipes.name: Pork sinigang
ingredients: 2 lb (900 g) pork ribs or pork belly, cut in chunks
1 packet (1.4 oz / 40 g) sinigang tamarind soup mix
2 cups (250 g) green beans, cut in 2 inch pieces
2 cups (60 g) water spinach or regular spinach
steps: Cut the vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Put the pork and water in a big pot and bring to a boil. Skim off the foam.
Add the onion, tomatoes and fish sauce and simmer for 1 hour, until the pork is tender.
Stir in the tamarind mix.
Add the radish and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the green beans, eggplant and chilies and simmer for 5 minutes more.
Add the spinach for 1 minute. Taste and add more fish sauce if needed. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Chicken tinola
ingredients: 2 inch piece ginger, cut in thin strips
1 green papaya or 2 chayote, peeled and cut in wedges
2 cups (60 g) spinach or malunggay leaves
steps: Chop the onion, garlic and ginger and cut the papaya. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pot over medium heat and cook the onion, garlic and ginger for 3 minutes.
Add the chicken and cook for 5 minutes, turning.
Add the fish sauce and cook for 1 minute.
Add the water and bring to a boil. Simmer for 20 minutes.
Add the papaya and simmer for 10 minutes, until tender and the chicken is 165°F (74°C).
Stir in the spinach for 1 minute and season with salt and pepper.

recipes.name: Taiwanese beef noodle soup
ingredients: 2 lb (900 g) beef shank or chuck, cut in 2 inch chunks
steps: Boil the beef in water for 5 minutes, then drain and rinse. This keeps the soup clear.
Heat the oil in a big pot over medium heat and cook the garlic, ginger and green onions for 2 minutes.
Add the chili bean paste and tomato paste and stir for 1 minute.
Add the beef, star anise, cinnamon, soy sauce, sugar and water and bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer on low for 2 hours, until the beef is very tender.
Boil the noodles as the package says, adding the bok choy for the last 1 minute. Drain.
Put noodles and bok choy in bowls and ladle the beef and broth over them. Ask an adult to help with the hot broth.
Top with pickled greens and cilantro.

recipes.name: Curry laksa
ingredients: 1/3 cup (85 g) laksa paste, or red curry paste
12 oz (340 g) boneless chicken thighs, thinly sliced
8 oz (225 g) thick rice noodles or egg noodles
Cilantro, mint, lime wedges and fried tofu puffs (optional)
steps: Slice the chicken. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pot over medium heat and fry the laksa paste for 2 minutes, stirring, until fragrant.
Add the broth, coconut milk, fish sauce and sugar and bring to a simmer.
Add the chicken and simmer for 6 minutes.
Add the shrimp and simmer for 2 to 3 minutes, until pink and the chicken is 165°F (74°C).
Cook the noodles as the package says and divide between bowls with the bean sprouts.
Ladle the soup over and top with eggs, herbs and lime.

recipes.name: Callaloo soup
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) callaloo, dasheen leaves or spinach, chopped
2 cups (280 g) pumpkin or butternut squash, cubed
2 cups (480 ml) vegetable broth or water
1 whole scotch bonnet pepper (don't cut it)
steps: Chop the vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pot over medium heat and cook the onion, garlic, green onions and thyme for 4 minutes.
Add the greens, okra, pumpkin, coconut milk, broth and whole scotch bonnet.
Bring to a boil, then simmer for 25 minutes, until everything is very soft.
Carefully take out the scotch bonnet and thyme stems.
Blend or swizzle until smooth, add salt and serve.

recipes.name: Scotch broth
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) lamb neck or shoulder, cut in chunks
1/2 cup (100 g) dried split peas, rinsed
1 cup (140 g) diced rutabaga (swede) or turnip
steps: Put the lamb and water in a big pot, bring to a boil and skim off the foam.
Add the barley and split peas and simmer for 1 hour.
Dice the vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Add the vegetables, salt and pepper and simmer for 45 minutes more, until the lamb and barley are tender.
Lift out the lamb, pull the meat off any bones, chop it and put it back.
Top with parsley.

recipes.name: Stracciatella Roman egg soup
steps: Bring the broth to a simmer in a pot.
Whisk the eggs, parmesan, semolina, nutmeg and salt in a bowl.
Add the spinach to the broth for 1 minute.
Slowly pour the egg mix into the simmering broth while stirring gently with a fork.
Cook for 1 minute, until the egg sets into little rags.
Serve right away with more parmesan.

recipes.name: Creamy chicken wild rice soup
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) boneless skinless chicken breasts
1 cup (240 ml) heavy cream or half and half
steps: Simmer the wild rice in 3 cups of water for 45 to 50 minutes, until it splits open. Drain.
Chop the vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Melt the butter in a big pot over medium heat and cook the onion, carrots, celery and mushrooms for 8 minutes.
Stir in the flour for 1 minute, then slowly whisk in the broth.
Add the whole chicken breasts and thyme and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes, until the chicken is 165°F (74°C). Lift it out and shred it.
Add the chicken, wild rice, salt and cream and heat for 5 minutes. Don't let it boil.

recipes.name: Tomato rasam
steps: Chop the tomatoes. Ask an adult to help.
Crush the peppercorns, cumin and garlic into a rough paste with a mortar and pestle.
Simmer the tomatoes, tamarind, water, turmeric, salt and half the pepper paste in a pot for 10 minutes.
Add the rest of the paste and simmer for 3 minutes. When it gets frothy, turn off the heat. Don't let it boil hard.
Heat the ghee in a small pan and add the mustard seeds. When they pop, add the curry leaves and asafoetida for 10 seconds.
Pour this over the rasam and add cilantro. Sip it like soup or pour it over rice.

recipes.name: Classic meatloaf
ingredients: 1 cup (60 g) panko or 3/4 cup (75 g) dry breadcrumbs
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Finely chop the onion.
Soak the breadcrumbs in the milk for 5 minutes.
Add the beef, onion, eggs, garlic, Worcestershire, thyme, salt and pepper and mix gently with your hands. Wash your hands after.
Shape into a loaf about 9 by 5 inches on a foil-lined baking sheet.
Mix the ketchup, brown sugar and vinegar and spread half over the loaf.
Bake for 45 minutes, then spread on the rest of the glaze.
Bake for 15 to 20 minutes more, until 160°F (71°C) in the middle.
Rest for 10 minutes before slicing.

recipes.name: Slow cooker pot roast
ingredients: 3 to 4 lb (1.4 to 1.8 kg) beef chuck roast
2 tablespoons cornstarch mixed with 2 tablespoons cold water
steps: Pat the roast dry and season all over with salt and pepper.
Heat the oil in a big pan over medium-high heat and brown the roast for 4 minutes per side. Ask an adult to help, it spatters.
Put the potatoes, carrots, onion and garlic in the slow cooker and set the roast on top.
Whisk the broth, tomato paste, Worcestershire and thyme and pour it over.
Cover and cook on low for 8 to 9 hours, or on high for 5 to 6 hours, until the beef falls apart with a fork.
Lift the beef and vegetables onto a platter.
Pour the liquid into a pot, stir in the cornstarch mix and simmer for 2 minutes to make gravy.

recipes.name: Beef stew
ingredients: 2 lb (900 g) beef chuck, cut in 1 1/2 inch cubes
1 teaspoon salt, plus more to taste
1 1/2 lb (680 g) Yukon gold potatoes, in chunks
steps: Cut the beef and vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Toss the beef with the salt, pepper and flour.
Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a big pot over medium-high heat and brown the beef in 2 batches for 5 minutes each. Lift it out.
Add the rest of the oil and the onion and cook for 5 minutes. Add the garlic and tomato paste for 1 minute.
Add the broth, Worcestershire, bay leaves, thyme and beef and bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer on low for 1 hour 15 minutes.
Add the potatoes and carrots and simmer for 40 to 45 minutes more, until everything is tender.
Stir in the peas for 3 minutes, take out the bay leaves, and add salt to taste.

recipes.name: Chicken pot pie
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Ask an adult to help.
Chop the onion, carrots and celery.
Melt the butter in a big pan over medium heat and cook the vegetables for 8 minutes.
Stir in the flour for 1 minute, then slowly whisk in the broth and milk.
Simmer for 3 to 4 minutes, until thick. Stir in the salt, thyme, pepper, chicken and peas.
Press one crust into a 9 inch deep pie dish and pour in the filling.
Lay the second crust on top, pinch the edges together and cut 4 slits in the top.
Brush with egg and bake for 30 to 35 minutes, until golden and bubbling. Put a sheet pan underneath to catch drips.
Cool for 15 minutes before cutting.

recipes.name: Chicken and dumplings
ingredients: 1/4 cup (30 g) all-purpose flour, for the stew
1 1/2 lb (680 g) boneless skinless chicken thighs
1/2 cup (120 ml) heavy cream or milk
2 cups (250 g) all-purpose flour, for the dumplings
3/4 cup (180 ml) milk, for the dumplings
3 tablespoons (45 g) butter, melted, for the dumplings
steps: Chop the vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Melt the butter in a big pot over medium heat and cook the vegetables for 7 minutes.
Stir in 1/4 cup flour for 1 minute, then slowly whisk in the broth.
Add the whole chicken thighs and thyme and simmer for 20 minutes, until 165°F (74°C). Lift out, shred and put back with the cream.
For the dumplings, mix the flour, baking powder and salt, then stir in the milk and melted butter until just combined.
Drop heaping tablespoons of dough onto the simmering stew.
Cover and simmer for 15 minutes without lifting the lid, until the dumplings are fluffy and cooked through.

recipes.name: Buttermilk fried chicken
ingredients: 3 lb (1.4 kg) bone-in chicken pieces (drumsticks and thighs)
Vegetable or peanut oil for frying
steps: Mix the buttermilk, 1 teaspoon salt and hot sauce and soak the chicken in it in the fridge for at least 1 hour, or overnight.
Mix the flour, the rest of the salt and the spices in a big bowl.
Lift each piece from the buttermilk, press it into the flour on all sides, and set it on a rack for 10 minutes.
An adult heats 1 1/2 inches of oil in a heavy pot to 350°F (175°C). Deep frying is for adults only.
Fry a few pieces at a time for 12 to 15 minutes, turning, until deep golden and 165°F (74°C) inside.
Drain on a rack over a sheet pan.
Let the oil cool completely before anyone moves the pot.

recipes.name: Crispy oven fried chicken
ingredients: 3 lb (1.4 kg) bone-in chicken drumsticks and thighs
1 teaspoon salt, plus 1 teaspoon for the coating
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Soak the chicken in the buttermilk and 1 teaspoon salt for 15 minutes.
Set a wire rack on a foil-lined baking sheet and spray it with oil.
Mix the cornflakes, flour, paprika, garlic powder, pepper and the rest of the salt in a shallow dish.
Press each piece into the coating on all sides and set it on the rack. Wash your hands.
Drizzle the melted butter over the chicken.
Bake for 40 to 45 minutes, until golden and 165°F (74°C) inside.

recipes.name: Baked BBQ chicken drumsticks
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Ask an adult to help.
Line a baking sheet with foil and set a rack on it if you have one.
Toss the drumsticks with the oil, salt, paprika, garlic powder and pepper. Wash your hands.
Lay them on the rack and bake for 30 minutes.
Brush with half the barbecue sauce and bake for 10 minutes.

Turn them, brush with the rest of the sauce, and bake for 5 to 10 minutes more, until sticky and 175°F (79°C) inside. Drumsticks are safe at 165°F (74°C) but get more tender when cooked a little higher.

recipes.name: Crispy baked chicken thighs
ingredients: 8 bone-in, skin-on chicken thighs (about 3 lb / 1.4 kg)
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Ask an adult to help.
Pat the chicken very dry with paper towels so the skin gets crisp.
Rub with oil and sprinkle all over with the salt and spices. Wash your hands.
Lay skin side up on a foil-lined baking sheet with space between pieces.
Bake for 35 to 45 minutes, until the skin is crisp and the meat is 175°F (79°C) near the bone. That's above the safe 165°F (74°C) and makes thighs tender.
Rest for 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.name: Honey garlic chicken
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) boneless skinless chicken thighs
Sesame seeds, green onion and cooked rice to serve
steps: Cut the chicken into bite-size pieces and chop the garlic. Ask an adult to help.
Toss the chicken with salt, pepper and cornstarch.
Heat the oil in a big pan over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for 6 to 8 minutes, turning, until golden and 165°F (74°C).
Turn the heat to medium and add the garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the honey, soy sauce, vinegar and water.
Simmer for 2 to 3 minutes, stirring, until the sauce is sticky and coats the chicken.
Top with sesame seeds and green onion and serve with rice.

recipes.name: Lemon pepper chicken
ingredients: 4 thin boneless skinless chicken breast cutlets (about 1 1/2 lb / 680 g)
steps: Season the chicken with the salt, pepper and lemon zest, then dust with flour. Wash your hands.
Heat the oil in a big pan over medium-high heat.
Cook the chicken for 4 to 5 minutes per side, until golden and 165°F (74°C). Move to a plate.
Turn the heat to medium and melt the butter. Add the garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the broth and lemon juice and simmer for 2 minutes, scraping the pan.
Put the chicken back and spoon the sauce over it.

recipes.name: Shepherd's pie
ingredients: 2 1/2 lb (1.1 kg) russet potatoes, peeled and cut in chunks
1 1/2 lb (680 g) ground lamb or beef (beef makes it a cottage pie)
steps: Boil the potatoes in salted water for 15 to 20 minutes, until soft. Drain and mash with the butter, milk and 1/2 teaspoon salt.
Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Chop the onion and carrots.
Heat the oil in a big pan over medium heat and cook the onion and carrots for 6 minutes.
Add the meat and cook for 7 to 8 minutes, breaking it up, until browned. Drain extra fat.
Stir in the tomato paste and flour for 1 minute, then add the broth, Worcestershire, thyme and the rest of the salt.
Simmer for 8 minutes, until thick. Stir in the peas.
Spread the filling in a 9 by 13 inch dish, spoon the mash on top and rough it up with a fork.
Bake for 25 minutes, until golden and bubbling.

recipes.name: Sloppy joes
steps: Chop the onion, pepper and garlic. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pan over medium heat and cook the onion and pepper for 5 minutes.
Add the beef and garlic and cook for 7 to 8 minutes, breaking it up, until browned. Drain the fat.
Stir in the ketchup, water, brown sugar, Worcestershire, mustard, chili powder and salt.
Simmer for 10 minutes, until thick.
Spoon onto toasted buns.

recipes.name: French dip sandwiches
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) thinly sliced deli roast beef
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Simmer the broth, Worcestershire, soy sauce, garlic powder and thyme for 5 minutes. This is the au jus.
Slice the onion and cook it in the butter over medium heat for 8 to 10 minutes, until soft and golden.
Dip the roast beef into the hot au jus for 30 seconds to warm it.
Pile the beef and onions into the rolls and top with cheese.
Bake open on a baking sheet for 5 minutes, until the cheese melts and the bread is toasty.
Close the sandwiches and serve with cups of au jus for dipping.

recipes.name: Slow cooker pulled pork
ingredients: 4 lb (1.8 kg) boneless pork shoulder (pork butt)
1/2 cup (120 ml) apple cider vinegar or apple juice
steps: Mix the brown sugar, paprika, salt and spices and rub it all over the pork. Wash your hands.
Put the onion in the slow cooker, set the pork on top and pour the vinegar around it.
Cover and cook on low for 8 to 10 hours, until the pork pulls apart easily and is about 200°F (93°C) inside.
Lift the pork onto a board and shred it with two forks. Throw away any big fat pieces.
Spoon off the fat from the liquid in the cooker.
Put the pork back with 1/2 cup of the liquid and the barbecue sauce and stir.
Serve on buns with coleslaw.

recipes.name: Oven baked BBQ ribs
ingredients: 2 racks baby back pork ribs (about 4 lb / 1.8 kg)
steps: Heat the oven to 275°F (135°C). Ask an adult to help.
Pull the thin papery skin off the bone side of each rack with a paper towel. An adult can loosen it with a butter knife.
Mix the brown sugar, paprika, salt and spices and rub it all over the ribs. Wash your hands.
Wrap each rack tightly in foil and set them on a baking sheet, meat side up.
Bake for 2 hours 30 minutes, until the meat is tender and pulls back from the bones.
Carefully open the foil (hot steam!) and brush the ribs with barbecue sauce.
Turn the oven to 425°F (220°C) and bake uncovered for 10 to 15 minutes, until sticky.
Rest for 5 minutes and cut between the bones.

recipes.name: Pan seared pork chops
ingredients: 4 bone-in or boneless pork chops, about 1 inch thick
steps: Take the chops out of the fridge 20 minutes early and pat them dry.
Season both sides with salt, pepper, garlic powder and paprika. Wash your hands.
Heat the oil in a heavy pan over medium-high heat. Ask an adult to help, it spatters.
Cook the chops for 4 to 5 minutes, until deep golden underneath.
Flip, add the butter, garlic and thyme, and cook for 3 to 5 minutes, spooning the butter over the chops, until 145°F (63°C) inside.
Rest for 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.name: Smothered pork chops
ingredients: 4 bone-in pork chops, about 3/4 inch thick
1/2 cup (65 g) all-purpose flour, plus 2 tablespoons for the gravy
steps: Season the chops with salt, pepper, garlic powder and paprika, then coat in flour. Wash your hands.
Slice the onion. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pan over medium-high heat and brown the chops for 3 minutes per side. Move them to a plate.
Turn the heat to medium and cook the onion for 5 minutes.
Stir in 2 tablespoons flour for 1 minute, then whisk in the broth and milk.
Put the chops back, cover and simmer on low for 20 to 25 minutes, until tender and at least 145°F (63°C).
Serve with mashed potatoes or rice and plenty of gravy.

recipes.name: Roast turkey breast
ingredients: 1 bone-in turkey breast (5 to 6 lb / 2.3 to 2.7 kg)
1 tablespoon chopped fresh herbs (sage, thyme, rosemary) or 1 teaspoon dried
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Pat the turkey dry.
Mix the butter, garlic, herbs, salt and pepper.
Loosen the skin with your fingers and rub half the butter under it and the rest on top. Wash your hands.
Put the onion and broth in a roasting pan and set the turkey on top, skin side up.
Roast for 1 hour 30 minutes to 1 hour 45 minutes, until 165°F (74°C) in the thickest part. Cover loosely with foil if the skin gets too dark.
Rest for 15 minutes before an adult carves it.

recipes.name: Honey glazed ham
ingredients: 1 fully cooked spiral sliced ham (8 to 10 lb / 3.6 to 4.5 kg)
steps: Heat the oven to 325°F (165°C). Ask an adult to help.
Put the ham cut side down in a roasting pan and pour the water in the bottom.
Cover tightly with foil and bake for 1 hour 30 minutes, about 12 minutes per pound, until 120°F (49°C) inside.
Simmer the brown sugar, honey, mustard, butter and spices in a small pot for 2 minutes to make the glaze.
Uncover the ham, turn the oven to 400°F (200°C), and brush on half the glaze.
Bake for 10 minutes, brush on the rest, and bake for 10 minutes more, until sticky and 140°F (60°C) inside.
Rest for 10 minutes before serving.

recipes.name: Pan seared steak
ingredients: 2 steaks like ribeye, strip or sirloin, about 1 inch thick
steps: Take the steaks out of the fridge 30 minutes early, pat dry, and season well with salt and pepper.
Heat a heavy cast iron pan over high heat for 3 minutes, then add the oil. Ask an adult to help, it smokes and spatters.
Lay the steaks in the pan away from you and cook for 3 to 4 minutes without moving them.
Flip and cook for 2 minutes.
Turn the heat to medium, add the butter, garlic and thyme, and spoon the butter over the steaks for 1 to 2 minutes.
Check with a thermometer: 130°F (54°C) for medium rare, 140°F (60°C) for medium, 145°F (63°C) to be fully safe by USDA rules.
Rest for 5 minutes, then slice across the grain.

recipes.name: Chicken fried steak with gravy
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups (190 g) all-purpose flour, plus 3 tablespoons for gravy
1 teaspoon pepper, plus more for gravy
1/2 cup (120 ml) milk, plus 2 cups (480 ml) for gravy
steps: Mix the flour, salt, pepper, garlic powder and paprika in a shallow dish.
Whisk the eggs and 1/2 cup milk in another dish.
Coat each steak in flour, then egg, then flour again, pressing it on. Wash your hands.
An adult heats 1/2 inch of oil in a big heavy pan over medium-high heat.
Fry the steaks for 3 to 4 minutes per side, until golden and cooked through. An adult should do the frying.
Drain on a rack and pour off all but 3 tablespoons of oil.
Whisk 3 tablespoons flour into the oil for 1 minute, then slowly whisk in 2 cups milk and simmer for 3 to 4 minutes, until thick. Add salt and lots of pepper.
Pour the gravy over the steaks.

recipes.name: Fish and chips
ingredients: 2 lb (900 g) russet potatoes, cut in thick fries
1 1/2 lb (680 g) cod or haddock fillets, cut in 4 pieces
1 cup (125 g) all-purpose flour, plus more for dusting
Lemon wedges, tartar sauce and malt vinegar to serve
steps: Cut the potatoes into thick fries and soak in cold water for 20 minutes. Dry them very well. Ask an adult to help.
An adult heats 2 inches of oil in a heavy pot to 325°F (165°C). Deep frying is for adults only.
Fry the potatoes in batches for 5 to 6 minutes, until soft but pale. Drain.
Heat the oil to 375°F (190°C).
Whisk the flour, cornstarch, baking powder, salt and sparkling water into a smooth batter.
Pat the fish dry, dust with flour, dip in batter and lower it gently into the oil away from you.
Fry for 4 to 6 minutes, until golden and the fish flakes and is 145°F (63°C). Drain on a rack.
Fry the potatoes again for 2 to 3 minutes, until crisp. Salt and serve with lemon and tartar sauce.

recipes.name: Lemon butter baked cod
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Pat the fish dry and lay it in a baking dish.
Mix the butter, garlic, juice of half the lemon, salt and pepper and pour it over the fish.
Mix the panko with the paprika and sprinkle it on top.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, until the fish flakes easily and is 145°F (63°C).
Top with parsley and serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.name: Garlic butter shrimp
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) large shrimp, peeled and deveined
steps: Chop the garlic. Ask an adult to help.
Pat the shrimp dry and season with salt and pepper.
Heat the oil and 1 tablespoon butter in a big pan over medium-high heat.
Cook the shrimp in one layer for 1 to 2 minutes per side, until pink. Move to a plate.
Turn the heat to medium, add the rest of the butter, garlic and chili flakes and cook for 1 minute.
Add the shrimp back with the lemon juice and parsley and toss.
Serve over rice, pasta or with bread.

recipes.name: Shrimp and grits
ingredients: 4 cups (960 ml) water or chicken broth
1 cup (160 g) quick or old-fashioned grits
1 lb (450 g) shrimp, peeled and deveined
steps: Bring the water and salt to a boil and slowly whisk in the grits.
Cook on low, stirring often, for 5 to 7 minutes for quick grits or 20 to 25 minutes for old-fashioned. Stir in the cheese and butter.
Chop the bacon, garlic and green onions. Ask an adult to help.
Cook the bacon in a pan over medium heat for 6 to 8 minutes, until crisp.
Toss the shrimp with Cajun seasoning and add to the bacon pan with the garlic.
Cook for 2 to 3 minutes, stirring, until the shrimp are pink.
Stir in the green onions and lemon juice and spoon over the grits.

recipes.name: Chicken and sausage jambalaya
ingredients: 12 oz (340 g) andouille or smoked sausage, sliced
1 lb (450 g) boneless chicken thighs, cut in bite-size pieces
1 1/2 cups (285 g) long grain white rice
steps: Slice and chop everything. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pot over medium-high heat and brown the sausage for 4 minutes. Lift it out.
Brown the chicken with 1 teaspoon of Cajun seasoning for 5 minutes. Lift it out.
Cook the onion, pepper and celery for 6 minutes. Add the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, rice, broth, the rest of the seasoning, sausage and chicken and bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer on low for 20 minutes without stirring.
Lay the shrimp on top, cover, and cook for 5 to 7 minutes, until the rice is tender, the shrimp are pink and the chicken is 165°F (74°C).
Fluff and top with green onions.

recipes.name: Chicken and sausage gumbo
ingredients: 2 lb (900 g) boneless chicken thighs, cut in pieces
steps: Chop the vegetables and cut the meat. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big heavy pot over medium heat and whisk in the flour to make a roux.
Stir it constantly for 25 to 35 minutes, until it's the color of milk chocolate. Don't walk away, it burns easily and hot roux can burn skin, so an adult should help.
Add the onion, pepper and celery and cook for 5 minutes. Add the garlic for 1 minute.
Slowly whisk in the broth.
Add the chicken, sausage, Cajun seasoning, bay leaves and okra and bring to a boil.
Simmer for 1 hour, stirring now and then, skimming off fat from the top.
Take out the bay leaves, stir in the green onions and serve over rice.

recipes.name: Red beans and rice
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) dried red kidney beans, soaked overnight and drained
12 oz (340 g) smoked andouille sausage, sliced
8 cups (2 liters) water or chicken broth
Cooked white rice and green onions to serve
steps: Chop the vegetables and slice the sausage. Ask an adult to help.
Brown the sausage in the oil in a big pot over medium heat for 5 minutes.
Add the onion, pepper and celery and cook for 6 minutes. Add the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the beans, seasoning, bay leaves, thyme and water and bring to a boil. Boil hard for 10 minutes.
Turn the heat to low, cover partly and simmer for 1 hour 30 minutes to 2 hours, until the beans are very soft.
Mash some beans against the pot to make it creamy and add the salt.
Serve over rice with green onions.

recipes.name: Tater tot casserole
ingredients: 1 can (10.5 oz / 300 g) condensed cream of mushroom soup
2 cups (250 g) frozen green beans or mixed vegetables
1 bag (32 oz / 900 g) frozen tater tots
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Ask an adult to help.
Chop the onion.
Cook the beef and onion in a big pan over medium heat for 8 minutes, breaking it up, until browned. Drain the fat.
Stir in the salt, pepper, soup, milk and vegetables.
Spread it in a 9 by 13 inch baking dish and sprinkle with the cheese.
Line the tater tots in rows over the top.
Bake for 40 to 45 minutes, until the tots are golden and crisp.

recipes.name: Cheesy chicken broccoli rice casserole
ingredients: 1 cup (190 g) uncooked long grain white rice
1 can (10.5 oz / 300 g) condensed cream of chicken soup
1 1/2 lb (680 g) boneless chicken breasts, cut in bite-size pieces
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Ask an adult to help.
Cut the chicken into bite-size pieces and wash your hands.
Mix the rice, broth, soup, milk, garlic powder, onion powder and salt in a 9 by 13 inch baking dish.
Stir in the chicken and 1 cup of the cheese.
Cover tightly with foil and bake for 45 minutes.
Uncover, stir in the broccoli, and sprinkle on the rest of the cheese.
Bake uncovered for 15 to 20 minutes more, until the rice is tender and the chicken is 165°F (74°C).

recipes.name: Tuna noodle casserole
ingredients: 2 cans (5 oz / 140 g each) tuna, drained
1/2 cup (30 g) panko or crushed crackers
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Ask an adult to help.
Boil the noodles for 2 minutes less than the package says. Drain.
Melt the butter in a big pot over medium heat and cook the onion for 4 minutes.
Stir in the flour for 1 minute, then whisk in the milk and broth.
Simmer for 3 to 4 minutes, until thick. Stir in the salt, pepper and 1 cup of the cheese.
Fold in the noodles, tuna and peas.
Spread in a baking dish and top with the rest of the cheese and the panko.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until bubbling and golden.

recipes.name: One pot cheeseburger pasta
steps: Chop the onion. Ask an adult to help.
Cook the beef and onion in a big pot over medium heat for 8 minutes, breaking it up, until browned. Drain the fat.
Stir in the garlic powder, paprika, salt and tomato paste.
Add the broth, milk and macaroni and bring to a boil.
Cover, turn the heat to low and simmer for 10 to 12 minutes, stirring now and then, until the pasta is tender.
Take off the heat and stir in the cheese until melted.

recipes.name: Chili mac
ingredients: 1 can (15 oz / 425 g) kidney beans, drained
steps: Chop the onion and garlic. Ask an adult to help.
Cook the beef and onion in a big pot over medium heat for 8 minutes, breaking it up, until browned. Drain the fat.
Add the garlic, chili powder, cumin and salt and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, beans, broth and macaroni and bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer for 12 to 14 minutes, stirring now and then, until the pasta is tender.
Stir in 1 cup of the cheese, top with the rest, and cover for 2 minutes to melt.

recipes.name: Frito pie
ingredients: 1 can (15 oz / 425 g) pinto beans, drained
1 bag (9 oz / 255 g) corn chips like Fritos
Sour cream, chopped onion and jalapenos to top
steps: Chop the onion. Ask an adult to help.
Cook the beef and half the onion over medium heat for 8 minutes, breaking it up, until browned. Drain the fat.
Stir in the chili powder, cumin, salt, tomato sauce, beans and water.
Simmer for 15 minutes, until thick.
Spoon the chili over bowls of corn chips, or into small chip bags for walking tacos.
Top with cheese, sour cream, the rest of the onion and jalapenos.

recipes.name: Stuffed bell peppers
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) ground beef or turkey
1 1/2 cups (170 g) shredded mozzarella or cheddar
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Ask an adult to help.
Cut the tops off the peppers and pull out the seeds.
Stand them in a baking dish. Trim the bottoms a little if they wobble, without making a hole.
Cook the meat and onion in a pan over medium heat for 8 minutes, until browned. Add the garlic for 1 minute.
Stir in the tomatoes, rice, seasoning, salt, pepper and half the cheese.
Fill the peppers and pour the tomato sauce around them.
Cover with foil and bake for 35 minutes.
Uncover, top with the rest of the cheese, and bake for 10 to 15 minutes more, until the peppers are tender.

recipes.name: Sheet pan sausage and veggies
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) smoked sausage or kielbasa, sliced into coins
1 1/2 lb (680 g) baby potatoes, cut in half
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Ask an adult to help.
Cut the sausage and vegetables.
Toss the potatoes with half the oil and seasonings on a big sheet pan and roast for 15 minutes.
Add the sausage, peppers, onion and broccoli and toss with the rest of the oil and seasonings.
Roast for 18 to 20 minutes more, stirring once, until the potatoes are tender and the sausage is browned.

recipes.name: White chicken chili
ingredients: 2 cans (4 oz / 115 g each) diced green chilies
1 1/2 lb (680 g) boneless skinless chicken breasts
2 cans (15 oz / 425 g each) great northern or cannellini beans, drained
Cilantro, avocado, sour cream and tortilla chips to serve
steps: Chop the onion and garlic. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pot over medium heat and cook the onion for 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, green chilies, cumin and oregano and cook for 1 minute.
Add the broth and whole chicken breasts and bring to a boil.
Simmer for 15 to 20 minutes, until the chicken is 165°F (74°C). Lift out and shred.
Mash 1 cup of the beans and add all the beans, corn, cream cheese and salt.
Stir until the cream cheese melts, then add the chicken and juice of the lime. Simmer for 5 minutes.
Top with cilantro, avocado, sour cream and chips.

recipes.name: Three bean vegetarian chili
ingredients: 1 sweet potato, cut in small cubes
1 can (15 oz / 425 g) black beans, drained
1 can (15 oz / 425 g) kidney beans, drained
1 can (15 oz / 425 g) pinto beans, drained
steps: Chop the vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pot over medium heat and cook the onion and peppers for 6 minutes.
Add the sweet potato, garlic and spices and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, beans and broth and bring to a boil.
Simmer for 25 to 30 minutes, until the sweet potato is tender.
Stir in the corn and salt and simmer for 5 minutes.
Serve with cheese, sour cream, avocado or cornbread.

recipes.name: Black bean burgers
ingredients: 2 cans (15 oz / 425 g each) black beans, drained and patted dry
1/2 cup (50 g) shredded cheddar or 1/4 cup (25 g) parmesan
4 burger buns and your favorite toppings
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Spread the beans on a baking sheet and bake for 15 minutes to dry them out. This stops mushy burgers.
Mash the beans in a bowl, leaving some chunks.
Mix in the breadcrumbs, egg, cheese, onion, garlic, spices and salt.
Shape into 4 patties and chill for 10 minutes.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat and cook the patties for 4 to 5 minutes per side, until crisp and heated through.
Serve on buns with toppings.

recipes.name: Juicy turkey burgers
steps: Mix the turkey, breadcrumbs, onion, garlic, Worcestershire, salt and pepper gently. Wash your hands.
Shape into 4 patties about 3/4 inch thick with a small dent in the middle.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat.
Cook the patties for 5 to 6 minutes per side, until 165°F (74°C) inside. Turkey must be fully cooked.
Add cheese for the last minute and cover the pan to melt it.
Serve on buns with toppings.

recipes.name: Salisbury steak with mushroom gravy
ingredients: 1 tablespoon Worcestershire sauce, plus 1 teaspoon for gravy
steps: Mix the beef, breadcrumbs, egg, ketchup, Worcestershire, salt and pepper. Shape into 4 oval patties. Wash your hands.
Slice the onion and mushrooms. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pan over medium-high heat and brown the patties for 4 minutes per side. Move to a plate.
Melt the butter in the pan and cook the onion and mushrooms for 6 to 8 minutes, until browned.
Stir in the flour for 1 minute, then whisk in the broth and the extra Worcestershire.
Put the patties back, cover and simmer for 10 minutes, until 160°F (71°C) inside and the gravy is thick.

recipes.name: Toad in the hole
steps: Whisk the flour, salt, eggs and milk into a smooth batter and let it rest for 15 minutes.
Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Ask an adult to help.
Put the oil and sausages in a 9 by 13 inch metal baking pan and bake for 10 minutes, until starting to brown.
Have an adult take out the hot pan and quickly pour the batter around the sausages. The oil must be very hot.
Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, until puffed, deep golden and the sausages are 160°F (71°C) inside. Don't open the oven for the first 20 minutes.
Serve right away with onion gravy.

recipes.name: Bangers and mash with onion gravy
ingredients: 2 1/2 lb (1.1 kg) russet potatoes, peeled and cut in chunks
steps: Boil the potatoes in salted water for 15 to 20 minutes, until soft. Drain and mash with 3 tablespoons butter, the milk and salt.
Cook the sausages in the oil in a pan over medium-low heat for 15 to 18 minutes, turning, until browned and 160°F (71°C) inside.
Slice the onions. Ask an adult to help.
Move the sausages to a plate and cook the onions in the pan with the rest of the butter for 10 minutes, until soft and golden.
Stir in the flour for 1 minute, then add the broth and Worcestershire and simmer for 3 minutes.
Serve the sausages on the mash with lots of gravy.

recipes.name: White sandwich bread
ingredients: 2 1/4 teaspoons (1 packet / 7 g) instant or active dry yeast
3 1/2 cups (440 g) bread flour or all-purpose flour
steps: Stir the warm milk, yeast and sugar in a big bowl and let sit for 5 minutes, until foamy.
Add the flour, salt and butter and stir into a shaggy dough.
Knead on a floured counter for 8 to 10 minutes, until smooth and stretchy.
Put it in an oiled bowl, cover and let rise for 1 hour, until doubled.
Press it flat into a rectangle, roll it up tight from the short end and pinch the seam.
Put it seam side down in a greased 9 by 5 inch loaf pan.
Cover and let rise for 45 minutes, until it domes 1 inch over the pan.
Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Bake for 30 to 35 minutes, until golden and hollow sounding when tapped.
Turn out and let cool for 1 hour before slicing.

recipes.name: Honey whole wheat bread
ingredients: 2 1/4 teaspoons (7 g) instant or active dry yeast
1 3/4 cups (220 g) bread flour or all-purpose flour
steps: Stir the water, yeast and honey and let sit for 5 minutes, until foamy.
Stir in the oil, both flours and the salt.
Knead for 10 minutes, until smooth and springy. It will feel a little tacky.
Put it in an oiled bowl, cover and let rise for 1 hour 15 minutes, until doubled.
Shape into a log and put it in a greased 9 by 5 inch loaf pan.
Cover and let rise for 45 minutes.
Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Bake for 35 to 40 minutes, until browned and hollow sounding.
Let cool for 1 hour before slicing.

recipes.name: French baguettes
ingredients: 2 1/4 teaspoons (7 g) instant or active dry yeast
steps: Stir the water, yeast and sugar and let sit for 5 minutes, until foamy.
Add the flour and salt and knead for 8 to 10 minutes, until smooth.
Cover and let rise for 1 hour, until doubled.
Split in half. Press each half into a rectangle and roll it into a 14 inch log, tapering the ends.
Put the logs on a floured baking sheet, cover and let rise for 40 minutes.
Heat the oven to 450°F (230°C). Ask an adult to help.
Put an empty metal pan on the bottom rack.
Have an adult cut 4 slanted slashes on each loaf with a sharp knife.
Put the bread in and have an adult pour 1 cup of hot water into the empty pan to make steam.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until deep golden.
Let cool for 20 minutes.

recipes.name: Rosemary focaccia
ingredients: 2 1/4 teaspoons (7 g) instant or active dry yeast
steps: Stir the water, yeast and sugar and let sit for 5 minutes.
Stir in the flour and salt until no dry flour shows. It will be very sticky. No kneading needed.
Cover and let rise for 1 hour 30 minutes, until bubbly and doubled.
Pour 4 tablespoons of the oil into a 9 by 13 inch pan.
Tip the dough into the pan and gently stretch it toward the corners with oiled hands.
Let rise for 30 minutes.
Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Ask an adult to help.
Drizzle the rest of the oil on top and press your fingertips all over to make deep dimples.
Sprinkle with rosemary and flaky salt.
Bake for 22 to 25 minutes, until golden and crisp at the edges.
Let cool for 10 minutes, then cut into squares.

recipes.name: No-knead crusty bread
ingredients: 3 cups (390 g) all-purpose or bread flour
steps: Stir the flour, yeast, salt and water in a big bowl until a shaggy, sticky dough forms.
Cover and let sit at room temperature for 12 to 18 hours, until bubbly.
Tip onto a floured counter and fold it over itself a few times into a ball.
Set it on parchment, cover and let rest for 1 hour.
Put a covered Dutch oven in the oven and heat to 450°F (230°C) for 30 minutes. An adult should handle the pot.
Lift the dough by the parchment into the hot pot and cover.
Bake for 30 minutes, then take off the lid and bake for 10 to 15 minutes more, until deep brown.
Let cool for 1 hour before slicing.

recipes.name: Cinnamon rolls
ingredients: 2 1/4 teaspoons (7 g) instant or active dry yeast
Filling: 1 cup (220 g) packed brown sugar, 2 1/2 tablespoons ground cinnamon, 1/3 cup (75 g) butter, softened
Icing: 4 oz (115 g) cream cheese, 1/4 cup (55 g) butter, 1 1/2 cups (180 g) powdered sugar, 1/2 teaspoon vanilla
steps: Stir the milk, yeast and sugar and let sit for 5 minutes.
Mix in the melted butter, eggs, flour and salt.
Knead for 6 to 8 minutes, until soft and smooth.
Cover and let rise for 1 hour, until doubled.
Roll the dough into a 16 by 21 inch rectangle.
Spread with the soft butter and sprinkle with the brown sugar and cinnamon.
Roll it up from the long side and cut into 12 rolls with dental floss or a sharp knife.
Put them in a greased 9 by 13 inch pan, cover and let rise for 30 minutes.
Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, until golden.
Beat the icing ingredients and spread on the warm rolls.

recipes.name: Soft pretzels
ingredients: 2 1/4 teaspoons (7 g) instant or active dry yeast
10 cups (2.4 liters) water and 2/3 cup (about 145 g) baking soda for the bath
1 egg yolk beaten with 1 tablespoon water
steps: Stir the warm water, sugar, salt and yeast and let sit for 5 minutes.
Add the flour and butter and knead for 5 minutes, until smooth.
Cover and let rise for 1 hour, until doubled.
Heat the oven to 450°F (230°C). Ask an adult to help.
Have an adult bring the 10 cups water and baking soda to a boil in a big pot.
Split the dough into 8 pieces, roll each into a 24 inch rope and twist into a pretzel shape.
Have an adult dip each pretzel in the boiling water for 30 seconds, then lift it out with a slotted spatula.
Put them on a lined baking sheet, brush with egg wash and sprinkle with coarse salt.
Bake for 12 to 14 minutes, until dark golden brown.
For pretzel bites, cut the ropes into 1 inch pieces and bake for 8 to 10 minutes.

recipes.name: Homemade bagels
ingredients: 2 1/4 teaspoons (7 g) instant or active dry yeast
1 tablespoon honey for the boiling water
Toppings: everything seasoning, sesame seeds or poppy seeds
steps: Stir the water, yeast and sugar and let sit for 5 minutes.
Add the flour and salt and knead for 10 minutes. The dough will be stiff.
Cover and let rise for 1 hour.
Split into 8 balls. Poke your thumb through the middle of each and stretch into a 2 inch hole.
Rest on a lined sheet for 20 minutes.
Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Ask an adult to help.
Have an adult bring a big pot of water and the honey to a boil.
Boil the bagels 2 or 3 at a time for 1 minute per side, then lift them out with a slotted spoon.
Put them back on the sheet and sprinkle with toppings.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until golden brown.

recipes.name: Skillet naan
ingredients: 2 1/4 teaspoons (7 g) instant or active dry yeast
Garlic butter: 3 tablespoons butter, melted, with 1 minced garlic clove and chopped cilantro
steps: Stir the water, yeast and sugar and let sit for 5 minutes.
Stir in the yogurt, oil, flour, salt and baking powder and knead for 5 minutes, until soft.
Cover and let rise for 1 hour.
Split into 8 balls and roll each into an oval about 1/4 inch thick.
Heat a cast iron skillet over medium high heat until very hot. Ask an adult to help.
Cook one naan for 1 to 2 minutes, until bubbles puff up and the bottom has dark spots.
Flip and cook for 1 minute more.
Brush with garlic butter and keep warm under a towel.

recipes.name: Pita bread
ingredients: 2 1/4 teaspoons (7 g) instant or active dry yeast
steps: Stir the water, yeast and sugar and let sit for 5 minutes.
Add the flour, salt and oil and knead for 6 minutes, until smooth.
Cover and let rise for 1 hour.
Put a baking sheet in the oven and heat to 475°F (245°C). Ask an adult to help.
Split into 8 balls and roll each into a 6 inch circle about 1/4 inch thick.
Have an adult put 2 or 3 at a time on the hot sheet.
Bake for 4 to 5 minutes, until puffed like balloons and pale golden.
Wrap in a towel right away so they stay soft.

recipes.name: Challah
ingredients: 2 1/4 teaspoons (7 g) instant or active dry yeast
2 large eggs, plus 1 egg for brushing
steps: Stir the water, yeast and sugar and let sit for 5 minutes.
Whisk in the oil and 2 eggs, then add the flour and salt.
Knead for 8 to 10 minutes, until smooth.
Cover and let rise for 1 hour 30 minutes, until doubled.
Split into 3 pieces and roll each into a 16 inch rope.
Pinch the ends together at the top and braid them, then pinch the bottom and tuck the ends under.
Put on a lined baking sheet, cover and let rise for 45 minutes.
Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Brush with the beaten egg and sprinkle with seeds.
Bake for 30 to 35 minutes, until deep golden.

recipes.name: Homemade burger buns
ingredients: 2 1/4 teaspoons (7 g) instant or active dry yeast
1 large egg, plus 1 egg for brushing
steps: Stir the milk, yeast and sugar and let sit for 5 minutes.
Add 1 egg, the butter, flour and salt and knead for 8 minutes, until soft and smooth.
Cover and let rise for 1 hour.
Split into 8 balls and press each into a 3 1/2 inch disk on a lined sheet. For hot dog buns, shape 6 inch logs.
Cover and let rise for 45 minutes.
Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Ask an adult to help.
Brush with beaten egg and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Bake for 15 to 18 minutes, until golden.

recipes.name: Monkey bread
ingredients: 2 cans (16.3 oz / 462 g each) refrigerated biscuits
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Grease a 12 cup bundt pan.
Mix the sugar and cinnamon in a big zip bag.
Cut each biscuit into 4 pieces with kitchen scissors and shake them in the bag a handful at a time.
Pile the coated pieces into the pan.
Heat the butter and brown sugar in a pot until it boils for 1 minute. Ask an adult to help.
Pour it over the dough.
Bake for 30 to 35 minutes, until golden and cooked through.
Let cool for 10 minutes, then flip onto a plate with oven mitts.

recipes.name: Garlic knots
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) pizza dough, store bought or homemade
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Cut the dough into 12 pieces and roll each into an 8 inch rope.
Tie each rope into a loose knot and put them on a lined baking sheet.
Bake for 15 to 18 minutes, until golden.
Melt the butter with the garlic in a small pan over low heat for 2 minutes.
Toss the hot knots in the garlic butter, then sprinkle with parmesan, parsley and salt.

recipes.name: Soft breadsticks
ingredients: 2 1/4 teaspoons (7 g) instant or active dry yeast
Topping: 3 tablespoons butter, melted, and 1 teaspoon garlic salt
steps: Stir the water, yeast and sugar and let sit for 5 minutes.
Add the butter, salt and flour and knead for 6 minutes.
Cover and let rise for 45 minutes.
Split into 16 pieces and roll each into a 7 inch stick. Put them on lined sheets.
Cover and let rise for 30 minutes.
Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, until golden.
Brush with melted butter and sprinkle with garlic salt.

recipes.name: English muffins
ingredients: 2 1/4 teaspoons (7 g) instant or active dry yeast
steps: Stir the milk, yeast and sugar and let sit for 5 minutes.
Mix in the butter, egg, flour and salt and knead for 5 minutes. It will be soft.
Cover and let rise for 1 hour.
Roll 1/2 inch thick and cut 3 inch circles.
Put them on a cornmeal-dusted tray, sprinkle more cornmeal on top and let rest for 30 minutes.
Heat a griddle or skillet over medium low heat. Ask an adult to help.
Cook for 6 to 8 minutes per side, until golden and cooked through.
Split with a fork and toast.

recipes.name: Hot cross buns
ingredients: 2 1/4 teaspoons (7 g) instant or active dry yeast
Cross paste: 1/2 cup (65 g) flour and 1/3 cup (80 ml) water
2 tablespoons apricot jam, warmed, for glazing
steps: Stir the milk, yeast and sugar and let sit for 5 minutes.
Mix in the butter, egg, flour, salt and spices and knead for 8 minutes.
Knead in the raisins.
Cover and let rise for 1 hour.
Split into 12 balls and put them in a greased 9 by 13 inch pan. Let rise for 45 minutes.
Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Ask an adult to help.
Mix the cross paste and pipe a cross on each bun.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until golden.
Brush the warm buns with the jam.

recipes.name: Cinnamon swirl raisin bread
ingredients: 2 1/4 teaspoons (7 g) instant or active dry yeast
Swirl: 1/3 cup (65 g) sugar mixed with 1 tablespoon cinnamon, and 1 tablespoon milk for brushing
steps: Stir the milk, yeast and sugar and let sit for 5 minutes.
Add the flour, salt and butter and knead for 8 minutes, then knead in the raisins.
Cover and let rise for 1 hour.
Roll into an 8 by 16 inch rectangle, brush with milk and sprinkle with the cinnamon sugar.
Roll it up tight from the short end and put it in a greased 9 by 5 inch loaf pan.
Cover and let rise for 45 minutes.
Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Bake for 35 to 40 minutes, until golden. Cover with foil for the last 10 minutes if it browns fast.
Let cool for 1 hour before slicing.

recipes.name: Japanese milk bread
ingredients: Tangzhong: 3 tablespoons (25 g) bread flour and 1/2 cup (120 ml) milk
1 large egg, plus 1 egg for brushing
steps: Whisk the tangzhong flour and milk in a small pot over low heat for 1 to 2 minutes, until it turns into a thick paste. Let cool.
Mix the flour, sugar, yeast and salt, then add the warm milk, egg and tangzhong.
Knead for 5 minutes, then knead in the butter.
Knead for 10 to 15 minutes more, until very smooth and stretchy. A stand mixer helps.
Cover and let rise for 1 hour, until doubled.
Split into 4 balls, roll each into an oval, roll up and stand them side by side in a greased 9 by 5 inch loaf pan.
Cover and let rise for 45 minutes.
Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Brush with egg and bake for 30 to 35 minutes, until golden.
Let cool for 1 hour. It stays soft for days.

recipes.name: Conchas
ingredients: 2 1/4 teaspoons (7 g) instant or active dry yeast
Topping: 1/2 cup (60 g) powdered sugar, 1/2 cup (65 g) flour, 1/4 cup (55 g) butter, 1 teaspoon vanilla, 1 tablespoon cocoa (optional)
steps: Stir the milk, yeast and sugar and let sit for 5 minutes.
Add the eggs, butter, flour, salt and vanilla and knead for 8 to 10 minutes. It will be soft.
Cover and let rise for 1 hour 30 minutes.
Mix the topping into a soft paste. Stir cocoa into half if you want brown ones.
Split the dough into 12 balls and set them on lined sheets.
Flatten a ball of topping between plastic wrap and lay it on each bun.
Press a shell pattern into the topping with a knife or concha cutter.
Let rise for 1 hour.
Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Bake for 18 to 20 minutes, until the bottoms are golden.

recipes.name: Brazilian cheese bread
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups (150 g) grated parmesan or a mix of parmesan and mozzarella
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Have an adult bring the milk, oil and salt to a boil.
Pour it over the tapioca flour in a bowl and stir until smooth and sticky.
Let cool for 10 minutes.
Beat in the eggs one at a time, then the cheese.
Scoop 1 1/2 tablespoon balls onto a lined baking sheet.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until puffed and golden. They are hollow and chewy inside.

recipes.name: Steamed buns
ingredients: 2/3 cup (150 ml) warm milk or water
steps: Mix the flour, yeast and sugar, then stir in the milk and oil.
Knead for 10 minutes, until very smooth.
Cover and let rise for 1 hour.
Roll into a log and cut into 8 pieces. Put each on a square of parchment.
Let rise in the steamer basket for 20 minutes.
Have an adult set the basket over a pot of boiling water and cover.
Steam for 12 to 15 minutes.
Turn off the heat and wait 5 minutes before lifting the lid so they do not shrink.

recipes.name: Flour tortillas
ingredients: 1/4 cup (50 g) shortening, lard or vegetable oil
steps: Mix the flour, baking powder and salt, then rub in the shortening.
Stir in the hot water and knead for 2 minutes, until smooth.
Split into 8 balls, cover and rest for 30 minutes.
Roll each ball into a thin 8 inch circle.
Heat a dry skillet over medium high heat. Ask an adult to help.
Cook each tortilla for 30 to 60 seconds per side, until bubbly with light brown spots.
Stack them in a towel to keep soft.

recipes.name: Corn tortillas
steps: Mix the masa harina, salt and water into a soft dough like play dough. Add water a spoonful at a time if it cracks.
Cover and rest for 20 minutes.
Roll into 12 balls.
Press each ball between 2 pieces of plastic in a tortilla press or under a heavy pan to about 6 inches.
Heat a dry skillet over medium high heat. Ask an adult to help.
Cook for 1 minute, flip and cook for 1 minute, then flip again for 30 seconds. It may puff.
Keep warm in a towel.

recipes.name: Chocolate babka
ingredients: Filling: 4 oz (115 g) chocolate and 1/2 cup (115 g) butter melted together, 1/2 cup (60 g) powdered sugar, 1/4 cup (20 g) cocoa
Syrup: 1/3 cup (65 g) sugar and 1/3 cup (80 ml) water
steps: Mix the milk, yeast, sugar, eggs, flour and salt, then knead in the butter for 10 minutes, until smooth.
Cover and let rise for 1 hour 30 minutes.
Stir the filling together until smooth.
Roll the dough into a 10 by 15 inch rectangle and spread the filling over it.
Roll up from the long side and chill for 15 minutes.
Cut the log in half lengthwise and twist the two halves together, cut sides up.
Put in a greased 9 by 5 inch loaf pan and let rise for 1 hour.
Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Bake for 35 to 45 minutes, until a skewer comes out without wet dough.
Boil the syrup ingredients for 1 minute and brush over the hot babka.

recipes.name: Chapati
ingredients: 2 cups (240 g) whole wheat atta flour
steps: Mix the flour and salt, then add the oil and water and knead for 5 minutes into a soft dough.
Cover and rest for 20 minutes.
Split into 8 balls and roll each into a thin 7 inch circle, dusting with flour.
Heat a dry skillet over medium high heat. Ask an adult to help.
Cook for 30 to 60 seconds, until bubbles show, then flip.
Cook for 1 minute, pressing gently with a folded towel so it puffs.
Brush with ghee and stack in a towel.

recipes.name: Honey oat bread
ingredients: 1 cup (90 g) rolled oats, plus more for the top
2 1/4 teaspoons (7 g) instant or active dry yeast
steps: Pour the boiling water over the oats, honey and butter. Let sit for 20 minutes, until just warm. Ask an adult to help.
Stir the yeast into the warm water and add it to the oats.
Add the flour and salt and knead for 8 minutes.
Cover and let rise for 1 hour.
Shape into a log, brush the top with water, sprinkle with oats and put it in a greased 9 by 5 inch loaf pan.
Let rise for 45 minutes.
Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Bake for 35 to 40 minutes, until golden.
Let cool for 1 hour before slicing.

recipes.name: Swedish cardamom buns
ingredients: 2 1/4 teaspoons (7 g) instant or active dry yeast
Filling: 1/2 cup (115 g) butter, softened, 1/2 cup (110 g) packed brown sugar, 2 teaspoons cardamom, 1 teaspoon cinnamon
1 egg for brushing and pearl sugar or coarse sugar
steps: Stir the milk, yeast and sugar and let sit for 5 minutes.
Add the butter, cardamom, salt and flour and knead for 8 minutes.
Cover and let rise for 1 hour.
Roll into a 12 by 16 inch rectangle, spread with the filling and fold into thirds like a letter.
Cut into 12 strips. Twist each strip and tie it into a knot.
Put on lined sheets and let rise for 45 minutes.
Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Brush with egg and sprinkle with pearl sugar.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, until golden.

recipes.name: Vanilla layer cake
ingredients: 1 cup (240 ml) milk, at room temperature
1 batch vanilla buttercream or chocolate frosting
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Grease two 9 inch round pans and line the bottoms with parchment paper.
Whisk the flour, baking powder and salt in a bowl.
Beat the butter and sugar for 3 minutes, until light and fluffy.
Beat in the eggs one at a time, then the vanilla.
Mix in a third of the flour mix, then half the milk. Repeat, ending with flour. Mix until just combined.
Split the batter between the pans and smooth the tops.
Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, until a toothpick in the middle comes out clean.
Let cool for 10 minutes in the pans, then turn out onto a wire rack.
Let cool for 1 hour before frosting.

recipes.name: Red velvet cake
ingredients: 1 cup (240 ml) buttermilk, at room temperature
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Grease two 9 inch round pans and line the bottoms with parchment paper.
Whisk the flour, sugar, cocoa, baking soda and salt in a big bowl.
Whisk the oil, buttermilk, eggs, food coloring, vanilla and vinegar in another bowl.
Pour the wet mix into the dry mix and stir until smooth.
Split the batter between the pans.
Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean. For 24 cupcakes, bake for 18 to 20 minutes.
Let cool for 10 minutes in the pans, then turn out onto a rack.
Let cool for 1 hour, then fill and frost with the cream cheese frosting.

recipes.name: Carrot cake
ingredients: 3 cups (300 g) finely grated carrots, about 5 carrots
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Grease a 9 by 13 inch pan.
Grate the carrots on the small holes of a box grater. Keep your fingers away from the blades.
Whisk the flour, baking soda, cinnamon and salt in a bowl.
Whisk the eggs, oil, sugar, brown sugar and vanilla in a big bowl.
Stir in the flour mix, then the carrots and walnuts.
Pour into the pan.
Bake for 35 to 40 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean.
Let cool for 1 hour, then spread the frosting on top.

recipes.name: Lemon drizzle cake
ingredients: Drizzle: 1/2 cup (100 g) sugar and 1/4 cup (60 ml) lemon juice
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Grease a 9 by 5 inch loaf pan and line it with parchment paper.
Beat the butter and sugar until fluffy, then beat in the eggs one at a time and the zest.
Stir in the flour, baking powder and salt, then the milk.
Spread in the pan.
Bake for 45 to 50 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean.
Stir the drizzle sugar and lemon juice together.
Poke holes all over the warm cake with a skewer and spoon the drizzle over it.
Let cool for 30 minutes in the pan. The drizzle sets into a crunchy crust.

recipes.name: Pound cake
steps: Heat the oven to 325°F (165°C). Ask an adult to help.
Grease and flour a 9 by 5 inch loaf pan.
Beat the butter and sugar for 4 minutes, until very light and fluffy.
Beat in the eggs one at a time, then the vanilla.
Stir in the flour, baking powder and salt until just combined.
Spread in the pan.
Bake for 60 to 70 minutes, until golden and a toothpick comes out clean.
Let cool for 15 minutes in the pan, then turn out onto a rack to cool.

recipes.name: Pineapple upside-down cake
ingredients: Topping: 1/4 cup (55 g) butter, melted, 1/2 cup (110 g) packed brown sugar
1/2 cup (120 ml) pineapple juice from the can
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Pour the melted butter into a 9 inch round cake pan and sprinkle the brown sugar over it.
Lay the pineapple rings on top and put a cherry in each hole.
Beat the butter and sugar until fluffy, then beat in the eggs and vanilla.
Stir in the flour, baking powder and salt, then the pineapple juice.
Spread the batter over the pineapple.
Bake for 40 to 45 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean.
Let cool for 10 minutes.
Put a plate on top and flip the pan over with oven mitts. Ask an adult to help.

recipes.name: Tres leches cake
ingredients: 1 can (14 oz / 397 g) sweetened condensed milk
Topping: 1 1/2 cups (360 ml) heavy cream whipped with 3 tablespoons sugar, plus cinnamon
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Grease a 9 by 13 inch pan.
Beat the egg yolks with 3/4 cup of the sugar until pale, then stir in the milk and vanilla.
Stir in the flour, baking powder and salt.
Beat the egg whites in a clean bowl until soft peaks form, then beat in the last 1/4 cup sugar until stiff.
Gently fold the whites into the batter and spread in the pan.
Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, until golden and a toothpick comes out clean. Let cool for 30 minutes.
Whisk the condensed milk, evaporated milk and cream.
Poke holes all over the cake with a fork and slowly pour the milk mix over it.
Chill for 4 hours so it soaks in.
Spread the whipped cream on top and dust with cinnamon.

recipes.name: Strawberry shortcake
ingredients: 1/4 cup (50 g) sugar for the berries
1/2 cup (115 g) cold butter, cut in cubes
3/4 cup (180 ml) cold heavy cream, plus a little for brushing
Whipped cream: 1 cup (240 ml) heavy cream, 2 tablespoons powdered sugar, 1/2 teaspoon vanilla
steps: Stir the strawberries and 1/4 cup sugar and let sit for 20 minutes to get juicy.
Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Ask an adult to help.
Mix the flour, 3 tablespoons sugar, baking powder and salt.
Rub in the cold butter with your fingers until it looks like coarse crumbs.
Stir in the cream until a shaggy dough forms.
Pat it 3/4 inch thick and cut 8 rounds. Put them on a lined sheet and brush with cream.
Bake for 15 to 18 minutes, until golden.
Whip the cream, powdered sugar and vanilla until soft peaks form.
Split the warm shortcakes, fill with strawberries and whipped cream.

recipes.name: Angel food cake
ingredients: 12 large egg whites (about 1 1/2 cups / 360 ml), at room temperature
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Sift the cake flour with 3/4 cup of the sugar twice.
Beat the egg whites, cream of tartar and salt in a very clean bowl until foamy.
Beat in the other 3/4 cup sugar a little at a time until stiff, glossy peaks form. Beat in the vanilla.
Sift the flour mix over the whites a quarter at a time, folding gently each time.
Spoon into an ungreased 10 inch tube pan and run a knife through to pop big bubbles.
Bake for 35 to 40 minutes, until golden and springy.
Turn the pan upside down onto a bottle neck or its feet and let cool for 2 hours.
Run a knife around the edges to release the cake.

recipes.name: Funfetti sprinkle cake
ingredients: 1/2 cup (80 g) rainbow sprinkles, plus more on top
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Grease a 9 by 13 inch pan.
Whisk the flour, baking powder and salt.
Beat the butter and sugar until fluffy, then beat in the egg whites and vanilla.
Mix in the flour mix and milk in turns, starting and ending with flour.
Gently fold in the sprinkles.
Spread in the pan.
Bake for 30 to 35 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean.
Let cool for 1 hour, then frost and add more sprinkles.

recipes.name: Chocolate cupcakes
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Line a 12-cup muffin pan with paper liners.
Whisk the flour, cocoa, sugar, baking soda, baking powder and salt in a big bowl.
Whisk in the egg, milk, oil and vanilla.
Carefully stir in the hot water. The batter will be thin.
Fill each liner 2/3 full.
Bake for 18 to 20 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean.
Let cool for 1 hour, then frost.

recipes.name: Lemon cupcakes
ingredients: Frosting: 1/2 cup (115 g) butter, 2 cups (240 g) powdered sugar, 2 tablespoons lemon juice, 1 teaspoon zest
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Line a 12-cup muffin pan with liners.
Rub the zest into the sugar with your fingers, then beat with the butter until fluffy.
Beat in the eggs and lemon juice.
Mix in the flour, baking powder and salt in turns with the milk.
Fill the liners 2/3 full.
Bake for 18 to 20 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean.
Let cool for 1 hour.
Beat the frosting ingredients until fluffy and pipe or spread on top.

recipes.name: Strawberry cupcakes
ingredients: Frosting: 1/2 cup (115 g) butter, 2 1/2 cups (300 g) powdered sugar, 3 tablespoons of the strawberry puree
steps: Blend the strawberries until smooth.
Simmer the puree in a small pot for 10 to 15 minutes, stirring, until it cooks down to about 1/2 cup. Let cool.
Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Line a muffin pan with 12 liners.
Beat the butter and sugar, then beat in the eggs and vanilla.
Stir in the flour, baking powder and salt, then the milk and 1/3 cup of the puree.
Fill the liners 2/3 full and bake for 18 to 20 minutes.
Let cool for 1 hour.
Beat the frosting ingredients until fluffy and spread on top.

recipes.name: Baked New York cheesecake
ingredients: Crust: 1 1/2 cups (150 g) graham cracker crumbs, 1/4 cup (50 g) sugar, 6 tablespoons (85 g) butter, melted
steps: Heat the oven to 325°F (165°C). Ask an adult to help.
Mix the crust ingredients and press into the bottom of a 9 inch springform pan.
Bake the crust for 10 minutes.
Beat the cream cheese, sugar and flour on low until smooth.
Beat in the sour cream and vanilla.
Beat in the eggs one at a time on low, just until mixed. Too much beating makes cracks.
Pour over the crust.
Bake for 60 to 70 minutes, until the edges are set and the middle still jiggles a little.
Turn off the oven, crack the door and leave the cheesecake inside for 1 hour.
Chill for at least 6 hours before slicing.

recipes.name: Mini cheesecakes
ingredients: Fruit or pie filling to top
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Line a muffin pan with 12 foil or paper liners and put a wafer in each.
Beat the cream cheese, sugar and vanilla until smooth.
Beat in the eggs on low, just until mixed.
Fill each liner 3/4 full.
Bake for 18 to 20 minutes, until the middles are almost set.
Let cool for 30 minutes, then chill for 2 hours.
Top with fruit before serving.

recipes.name: Texas chocolate sheet cake
ingredients: Frosting: 1/2 cup (115 g) butter, 1/4 cup (20 g) cocoa, 6 tablespoons milk, 3 1/2 cups (420 g) powdered sugar, 1 teaspoon vanilla, 1 cup (115 g) chopped pecans
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Grease a 10 by 15 inch rimmed pan.
Whisk the flour, sugar, baking soda and salt in a big bowl.
Heat the butter, water and cocoa in a pot until it boils. Ask an adult to help.
Pour the hot cocoa mix into the flour mix and stir.
Stir in the sour cream, eggs and vanilla.
Pour into the pan and bake for 20 to 22 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean.
For the frosting, heat the butter, cocoa and milk until it bubbles, then take it off the heat.
Whisk in the powdered sugar and vanilla, then the pecans.
Pour the warm frosting over the warm cake and spread. Let cool for 30 minutes.

recipes.name: Black Forest cake
ingredients: 1 can (21 oz / 595 g) cherry pie filling
Cream: 2 1/2 cups (600 ml) heavy cream, 1/3 cup (40 g) powdered sugar, 1 teaspoon vanilla
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Grease two 9 inch round pans and line with parchment paper.
Whisk the flour, cocoa, sugar, baking powder, baking soda and salt.
Beat in the eggs, milk, oil and vanilla for 2 minutes.
Carefully stir in the boiling water. Ask an adult to help.
Pour into the pans and bake for 30 to 35 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean.
Let cool for 10 minutes in the pans, then 1 hour on a rack.
Whip the cream, powdered sugar and vanilla until stiff peaks form.
Put one cake on a plate, spread with cream, then spoon on half the cherry filling.
