Add the second cake, cover the whole cake with cream, then top with the rest of the cherries and chocolate shavings.
Chill for 30 minutes before slicing.

recipes.name: Tiramisu
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups (360 ml) strong coffee or decaf, cooled
steps: Brew the coffee and let it cool. Decaf works and has less caffeine for kids.
Whip the cream until soft peaks form.
Beat the mascarpone, powdered sugar and vanilla until smooth, then fold in the whipped cream.
Dip each ladyfinger in the coffee for 1 second and lay it in an 8 by 8 inch dish.
Spread half the cream over the ladyfingers.
Add another layer of dipped ladyfingers and the rest of the cream.
Cover and chill for 6 hours.
Dust with cocoa through a strainer before serving.

recipes.name: Victoria sponge
ingredients: 1/2 cup (160 g) strawberry or raspberry jam
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Grease two 8 inch round pans and line the bottoms with parchment paper.
Beat the butter and sugar until pale and fluffy.
Beat in the eggs one at a time, then the vanilla.
Fold in the flour and baking powder, then the milk.
Split between the pans and smooth the tops.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until golden and springy.
Let cool for 10 minutes in the pans, then 30 minutes on a rack.
Spread jam on one cake, then whipped cream, and put the other cake on top.
Dust with powdered sugar.

recipes.name: Swiss roll
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Line a 10 by 15 inch rimmed pan with greased parchment paper.
Beat the eggs and sugar for 5 minutes, until thick and pale. Beat in the vanilla.
Sift in the flour, baking powder and salt and fold gently.
Spread in the pan.
Bake for 8 to 10 minutes, until springy.
Dust a clean kitchen towel with powdered sugar and flip the hot cake onto it. Ask an adult to help.
Peel off the paper and roll the cake up in the towel from the short end.
Let cool rolled up for 1 hour.
Unroll, spread with jam and whipped cream, and roll it back up without the towel.

recipes.name: Gingerbread cake
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Grease a 9 by 9 inch pan.
Beat the butter and sugar, then beat in the egg and molasses.
Whisk the flour, baking soda, spices and salt in another bowl.
Stir the flour mix into the molasses mix.
Carefully stir in the hot water until smooth.
Pour into the pan.
Bake for 50 to 60 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean.
Let cool for 20 minutes. Serve with whipped cream.

recipes.name: Apple cake
ingredients: 2 medium apples, peeled and thinly sliced
Topping: 1 tablespoon sugar mixed with 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Grease a 9 inch round or square pan.
Peel, core and slice the apples. Ask an adult to help with the knife.
Beat the butter and sugar, then beat in the eggs and vanilla.
Stir in the flour, baking powder, cinnamon and salt, then the milk.
Spread the batter in the pan and press the apple slices into the top in circles.
Sprinkle with the cinnamon sugar.
Bake for 45 to 50 minutes, until golden and a toothpick comes out clean.
Let cool for 20 minutes before slicing.

recipes.name: Orange olive oil cake
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Grease a 9 inch round pan and line the bottom with parchment paper.
Whisk the eggs, sugar and zest for 2 minutes, until pale.
Whisk in the olive oil, milk and orange juice.
Stir in the flour, baking powder and salt until smooth.
Pour into the pan.
Bake for 40 to 45 minutes, until golden and a toothpick comes out clean.
Let cool for 20 minutes, then dust with powdered sugar.

recipes.name: Hot fudge pudding cake
ingredients: Topping: 1 cup (220 g) packed brown sugar and 1/4 cup (20 g) cocoa
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Stir the flour, sugar, cocoa, baking powder and salt in an ungreased 9 by 9 inch pan.
Stir in the milk, oil and vanilla, then spread it flat.
Sprinkle the brown sugar and cocoa topping evenly over the batter.
Carefully pour the hot water over the top. Do not stir. Ask an adult to help.
Bake for 40 minutes, until the top looks like cake. The sauce forms underneath.
Let cool for 15 minutes, then spoon into bowls with the sauce. Great with ice cream.

recipes.name: Cherry pineapple dump cake
ingredients: 1 can (20 oz / 567 g) crushed pineapple with its juice
1 can (21 oz / 595 g) cherry pie filling
1 box (15.25 oz / 432 g) yellow cake mix, dry
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Spread the pineapple and juice in a 9 by 13 inch pan.
Spoon the cherry pie filling over it.
Sprinkle the dry cake mix evenly on top. Do not stir.
Drizzle the melted butter all over the cake mix so most of it is wet.
Bake for 45 to 50 minutes, until golden and bubbly.
Let cool for 15 minutes. Serve warm with ice cream.

recipes.name: Basbousa
ingredients: Syrup: 1 cup (200 g) sugar, 3/4 cup (180 ml) water, 1 teaspoon lemon juice
steps: Simmer the syrup ingredients for 10 minutes, then let cool. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Grease an 8 by 8 inch pan.
Mix the semolina, coconut, sugar and baking powder.
Stir in the yogurt, melted butter and milk. It will be thick.
Spread it in the pan, cut it into 16 diamonds or squares and press an almond into each.
Bake for 30 to 35 minutes, until golden brown.
Pour the cool syrup over the hot cake right away.
Let rest for 1 hour so it soaks in, then cut along the lines.

recipes.name: Coconut cake
ingredients: 1 cup (240 ml) canned coconut milk, stirred
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Grease a 9 by 13 inch pan.
Beat the butter and sugar until fluffy, then beat in the eggs and vanilla.
Mix in the flour, baking powder and salt in turns with the coconut milk.
Spread in the pan.
Bake for 30 to 35 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean.
Let cool for 1 hour.
Spread the frosting on top and press the shredded coconut all over it.

recipes.name: Marble cake
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cocoa powder mixed with 2 tablespoons milk
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Grease and line a 9 by 5 inch loaf pan.
Beat the butter and sugar, then beat in the eggs and vanilla.
Stir in the flour, baking powder and salt in turns with the milk.
Spoon half the batter into another bowl and stir in the cocoa mix.
Drop spoonfuls of both batters into the pan, then swirl once with a knife.
Bake for 50 to 55 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean.
Let cool for 15 minutes in the pan, then on a rack.

recipes.name: Pavlova
ingredients: 4 large egg whites, at room temperature
2 cups fresh berries and kiwi slices
steps: Heat the oven to 250°F (120°C). Ask an adult to help.
Draw an 8 inch circle on parchment paper and put it upside down on a baking sheet.
Beat the egg whites until soft peaks form.
Add the sugar 1 tablespoon at a time while beating, until stiff and glossy.
Beat in the vinegar, cornstarch and vanilla.
Spread inside the circle, making the edges a little higher than the middle.
Bake for 1 hour 15 minutes, until crisp outside.
Turn off the oven and leave it inside with the door shut for 1 hour.
Just before serving, top with whipped cream and fruit.

recipes.name: Cream puffs
ingredients: Filling: 1 cup (240 ml) heavy cream, 2 tablespoons powdered sugar, 1/2 teaspoon vanilla
Powdered sugar or melted chocolate for the tops
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Bring the water, butter and salt to a boil in a pot. Ask an adult to help.
Dump in the flour and stir hard for 1 minute, until it forms a ball.
Take it off the heat and let cool for 5 minutes.
Beat in the eggs one at a time until the dough is smooth and glossy.
Drop 12 mounds onto a lined baking sheet.
Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, until puffed and deep golden. Do not open the oven early or they collapse.
Poke a small hole in each and let cool for 30 minutes.
Whip the filling until stiff, cut the puffs in half and fill them.
Dust with powdered sugar or dip the tops in melted chocolate.

recipes.name: Churros
ingredients: Coating: 1/2 cup (100 g) sugar mixed with 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon
steps: An adult should do the frying. Hot oil is dangerous.
Bring the water, sugar, salt and 2 tablespoons oil to a boil in a pot.
Take it off the heat, add the flour and stir until it forms a smooth ball.
Let cool for 5 minutes, then spoon it into a piping bag with a big star tip.
Heat 2 inches of oil in a deep pot to 375°F (190°C).
Pipe 5 inch strips into the oil and cut them off with scissors.
Fry for 2 to 3 minutes, turning once, until golden.
Drain on paper towels for 1 minute, then roll in the cinnamon sugar.

recipes.name: Strawberry mochi
ingredients: 1/2 cup (140 g) sweet red bean paste
steps: Wrap each strawberry in about 1 tablespoon of red bean paste, leaving the tip showing.
Whisk the rice flour, sugar and water in a microwave-safe bowl until smooth.
Cover and microwave for 1 minute, then stir with a wet spatula.
Microwave for 1 minute more, stir, then 30 seconds more, until thick and see-through.
Dust the counter with cornstarch and tip the hot dough onto it. It is very hot, so let it cool for 5 minutes.
Cut into 8 pieces with a dusted knife.
Flatten each piece, wrap it around a strawberry and pinch it closed.
Eat the same day.

recipes.name: Strawberry poke cake
ingredients: 1 box (15.25 oz / 432 g) white cake mix, plus the eggs, oil and water on the box
8 oz (225 g) frozen whipped topping, thawed
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Make and bake the cake in a 9 by 13 inch pan following the box. Let cool for 20 minutes.
Poke holes all over the cake with a fork or the handle of a wooden spoon.
Stir the gelatin into the boiling water for 2 minutes, until dissolved. Ask an adult to help.
Stir in the cold water.
Slowly pour the gelatin over the cake so it fills the holes.
Chill for 3 hours.
Spread the whipped topping over the cake and add sliced strawberries.

recipes.name: Chocolate icebox cake
ingredients: 1 package (9 oz / 255 g) thin chocolate wafer cookies
Chocolate shavings or berries to top
steps: Whip the cream, powdered sugar and vanilla until stiff peaks form.
Spread a little cream on a plate.
Spread a spoonful of cream on each wafer and stack them in a long log on its side on the plate.
Cover the whole log with the rest of the cream.
Chill for 6 hours. The wafers soften into cake.
Top with shavings or berries and cut slices at an angle.

recipes.name: Fruit pizza
ingredients: Topping: 8 oz (225 g) cream cheese, softened, 1/2 cup (60 g) powdered sugar, 1 teaspoon vanilla
3 cups sliced fruit like strawberries, kiwi, blueberries and mandarin oranges
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Beat the butter and sugar, then the egg and vanilla. Stir in the flour, baking powder and salt.
Press the dough into a 12 inch round pizza pan.
Bake for 15 to 18 minutes, until light golden. Let cool for 45 minutes.
Beat the cream cheese, powdered sugar and vanilla until smooth.
Spread it over the cookie crust.
Arrange the fruit on top in circles.
Cut into wedges with a pizza cutter.

recipes.name: Cookies and cream cupcakes
ingredients: Frosting: 1/2 cup (115 g) butter, 2 cups (240 g) powdered sugar, 2 tablespoons milk, 5 crushed cookies
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Line a muffin pan with 12 liners and put a whole cookie in the bottom of each.
Crush 5 more cookies into crumbs for the frosting.
Beat the butter and sugar, then beat in the eggs and vanilla.
Mix in the flour, baking powder and salt in turns with the milk.
Fill the liners 2/3 full over the cookies.
Bake for 18 to 20 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean.
Let cool for 1 hour.
Beat the frosting butter, sugar and milk, stir in the crumbs, and frost.

recipes.name: Vanilla buttercream frosting
steps: Beat the butter for 2 minutes, until pale and creamy.
Add the powdered sugar 1 cup at a time on low speed.
Add the milk, vanilla and salt.
Beat on high for 3 minutes, until light and fluffy.
Add more milk to make it softer or more sugar to make it stiffer. This frosts 24 cupcakes or a 2 layer cake.

recipes.name: Chocolate frosting
steps: Beat the butter until creamy.
Sift the powdered sugar and cocoa together so there are no lumps.
Add the sugar mix a little at a time with the milk, beating on low.
Add the vanilla and salt.
Beat on high for 2 minutes, until fluffy.

recipes.name: Cream cheese frosting
steps: Beat the cream cheese and butter until smooth.
Add the powdered sugar a little at a time on low.
Beat in the vanilla and salt until fluffy. Do not overbeat or it gets runny.
Keep anything frosted with it in the fridge.

recipes.name: Whipped cream
steps: Chill the bowl and beaters in the freezer for 10 minutes.
Pour in the cream, powdered sugar and vanilla.
Beat on medium high for 2 to 3 minutes, until soft peaks form.
Stop as soon as it holds its shape. Too much beating turns it into butter.

recipes.name: Royal icing
steps: Use meringue powder instead of raw egg whites so it is safe to eat.
Beat the powdered sugar, meringue powder and 6 tablespoons water on low for 5 minutes, until glossy and stiff.
Add water a teaspoon at a time to thin it for flooding cookies.
Tint with gel coloring.
Keep it covered with a damp towel. It dries hard in about 6 hours.

recipes.name: Powdered sugar glaze
ingredients: 1 1/2 to 2 tablespoons milk or lemon juice
steps: Put the powdered sugar in a bowl.
Stir in the milk a little at a time with the vanilla until smooth and thick but pourable.
Drizzle over cakes, cinnamon rolls or cookies.
Let set for 15 minutes.

recipes.name: Peanut butter cookies
ingredients: 1/2 cup (100 g) sugar, plus 2 tablespoons for rolling
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Whisk the flour, baking soda and salt in a bowl.
Beat the butter, peanut butter, sugar and brown sugar in a big bowl until creamy.
Beat in the egg and vanilla.
Stir in the flour mix until no dry flour shows.
Roll the dough into 1 1/4 inch balls and roll them in the extra sugar.
Put them on a baking sheet 2 inches apart and press each one with a fork to make a criss cross.
Bake for 9 to 11 minutes, until the edges are just golden.
Let cool for 5 minutes on the sheet, then move them to a wire rack.

recipes.name: Oatmeal raisin cookies
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Beat the butter, brown sugar and sugar in a big bowl until creamy.
Beat in the eggs one at a time, then the vanilla.
Whisk the flour, baking soda, cinnamon and salt in another bowl, then stir it into the butter mix.
Stir in the oats and raisins.
Drop rounded tablespoons of dough onto a baking sheet, 2 inches apart.
Bake for 10 to 12 minutes, until the edges are golden and the middles still look a little soft.
Let cool for 5 minutes on the sheet, then move them to a wire rack.

recipes.name: Snickerdoodles
ingredients: For rolling: 3 tablespoons sugar mixed with 1 tablespoon ground cinnamon
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Ask an adult to help.
Whisk the flour, cream of tartar, baking soda and salt in a bowl.
Beat the butter and sugar in a big bowl for 2 minutes, until light and fluffy.
Beat in the eggs and vanilla.
Stir in the flour mix until a soft dough forms.
Roll the dough into 1 1/2 inch balls and roll each ball in the cinnamon sugar.
Put them on a baking sheet 2 inches apart.
Bake for 8 to 10 minutes, until set at the edges and puffed in the middle.
Let cool for 5 minutes on the sheet. They sink and crinkle as they cool.

recipes.name: Double chocolate cookies
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Whisk the flour, cocoa, baking soda and salt in a bowl.
Beat the butter, sugar and brown sugar in a big bowl until creamy.
Beat in the eggs and vanilla.
Stir in the flour mix, then the chocolate chips.
Scoop 2 tablespoon balls onto a baking sheet, 2 inches apart.
Bake for 9 to 11 minutes. They should still look soft in the middle.
Let cool for 5 minutes on the sheet, then move them to a wire rack.

recipes.name: White chocolate macadamia cookies
ingredients: 1 cup (135 g) macadamia nuts, roughly chopped
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Whisk the flour, baking soda and salt in a bowl.
Beat the butter, brown sugar and sugar until creamy.
Beat in the egg, egg yolk and vanilla.
Stir in the flour mix, then the white chocolate chips and nuts.
Scoop 2 tablespoon balls onto a baking sheet, 2 inches apart.
Bake for 10 to 12 minutes, until the edges are light golden.
Let cool for 5 minutes on the sheet, then move them to a wire rack.

recipes.name: Candy-coated chocolate cookies
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Whisk the flour, baking soda and salt in a bowl.
Beat the butter, brown sugar and sugar until creamy, then beat in the eggs and vanilla.
Stir in the flour mix.
Stir in 1 cup of the candies and save the rest.
Scoop 2 tablespoon balls onto a baking sheet, 2 inches apart, and press a few extra candies on top of each.
Bake for 10 to 12 minutes, until the edges are golden.
Let cool for 5 minutes on the sheet, then move them to a wire rack.

recipes.name: Chewy molasses cookies
ingredients: 1 cup (200 g) sugar, plus 1/4 cup (50 g) for rolling
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Ask an adult to help.
Whisk the flour, baking soda, ginger, cinnamon, cloves and salt in a bowl.
Beat the butter and 1 cup of sugar until fluffy.
Beat in the egg and molasses.
Stir in the flour mix.
Roll the dough into 1 inch balls and roll them in the extra sugar.
Put them on a baking sheet 2 inches apart.
Bake for 8 to 10 minutes, until the tops crack. Bake 2 minutes longer for crisp ginger snaps.
Let cool for 5 minutes on the sheet, then move them to a wire rack.

recipes.name: Gingerbread cookies
ingredients: Icing: 1 cup (120 g) powdered sugar mixed with 1 to 2 tablespoons milk
steps: Whisk the flour, spices, baking soda and salt in a bowl.
Beat the butter and brown sugar until fluffy, then beat in the egg, molasses and vanilla.
Stir in the flour mix until a dough forms.
Split the dough in half, flatten each half into a disk and wrap it.
Chill for 1 hour.
Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Roll the dough 1/4 inch thick on a floured counter and cut out shapes.
Put them on a lined baking sheet 1 inch apart.
Bake for 8 to 10 minutes, until the edges are firm.
Let cool for 5 minutes on the sheet, then move them to a wire rack.
Decorate with the icing once they are completely cool.

recipes.name: Scottish shortbread
ingredients: 1/2 cup (100 g) sugar, plus a little for sprinkling
steps: Heat the oven to 325°F (165°C). Ask an adult to help.
Beat the butter, sugar and salt until creamy.
Stir in the flour until it comes together as a soft dough.
Press the dough evenly into an 8 by 8 inch pan.
Prick it all over with a fork and sprinkle with a little sugar.
Bake for 35 to 40 minutes, until pale golden at the edges.
Cut it into 16 bars while still warm. Ask an adult to help.
Let cool for 20 minutes in the pan before lifting out the bars.

recipes.name: Jam thumbprint cookies
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Beat the butter and sugar until creamy, then beat in the egg yolks and vanilla.
Stir in the flour and salt.
Roll the dough into 1 inch balls and put them on a baking sheet 1 inch apart.
Press your thumb into the middle of each ball to make a dent.
Fill each dent with about 1/2 teaspoon of jam.
Bake for 12 to 14 minutes, until the edges are light golden.
Let cool for 5 minutes on the sheet, then move them to a wire rack.

recipes.name: No-bake chocolate oat cookies
steps: Line 2 baking sheets with wax paper.
Put the butter, sugar, milk and cocoa in a pot over medium heat. Ask an adult to help, the mix gets very hot.
Bring it to a rolling boil, then boil for 1 minute without stirring.
Take the pot off the heat and stir in the peanut butter, vanilla and salt until smooth.
Stir in the oats.
Drop spoonfuls onto the wax paper.
Let set for 30 minutes at room temperature.

recipes.name: Monster cookies
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Beat the butter, peanut butter, brown sugar and sugar until creamy.
Beat in the eggs, vanilla, baking soda and salt.
Stir in the oats, chocolate chips and candies. There is no flour in these.
Scoop 2 tablespoon balls onto a baking sheet, 2 inches apart, and flatten them a little.
Bake for 10 to 12 minutes, until the edges are golden.
Let cool for 5 minutes on the sheet, then move them to a wire rack.

recipes.name: Lemon crinkle cookies
ingredients: 1/2 cup (60 g) powdered sugar for rolling
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Beat the butter and sugar until fluffy.
Beat in the egg, lemon zest, lemon juice and vanilla.
Stir in the flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt.
Roll the dough into 1 inch balls and roll them thickly in the powdered sugar.
Put them on a baking sheet 2 inches apart.
Bake for 9 to 11 minutes, until the bottoms are just golden.
Let cool for 5 minutes on the sheet, then move them to a wire rack.

recipes.name: Chocolate crinkle cookies
ingredients: 1/2 cup (60 g) powdered sugar for rolling
steps: Mix the cocoa, sugar and oil in a big bowl.
Beat in the eggs one at a time, then the vanilla.
Stir in the flour, baking powder and salt.
Cover and chill for 4 hours, until firm.
Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Roll the dough into 1 inch balls and roll them thickly in the powdered sugar.
Put them on a lined baking sheet 2 inches apart.
Bake for 10 to 12 minutes, until puffed and cracked.
Let cool for 5 minutes on the sheet, then move them to a wire rack.

recipes.name: Snowball cookies
ingredients: 1/2 cup (60 g) powdered sugar, plus 1 cup (120 g) for rolling
3/4 cup (85 g) pecans or walnuts, finely chopped
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Ask an adult to help.
Beat the butter, 1/2 cup powdered sugar and vanilla until creamy.
Stir in the flour, salt and nuts until a dough forms.
Roll the dough into 1 inch balls and put them on a baking sheet.
Bake for 10 to 12 minutes, until set but not brown.
Let cool for 5 minutes, then roll the warm cookies in powdered sugar.
Let cool completely, then roll them in powdered sugar again.

recipes.name: Oatmeal chocolate chip cookies
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Beat the butter, brown sugar and sugar until creamy.
Beat in the eggs and vanilla.
Stir in the flour, baking soda and salt.
Stir in the oats and chocolate chips.
Drop rounded tablespoons onto a baking sheet, 2 inches apart.
Bake for 10 to 12 minutes, until golden at the edges.
Let cool for 5 minutes on the sheet, then move them to a wire rack.

recipes.name: Peanut butter blossoms
ingredients: 1/3 cup (65 g) sugar, plus 1/4 cup (50 g) for rolling
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Ask an adult to help.
Beat the butter, peanut butter, sugar and brown sugar until fluffy.
Beat in the egg, milk and vanilla.
Stir in the flour, baking soda and salt.
Roll into 1 inch balls, roll them in the extra sugar and put them on a baking sheet.
Bake for 8 to 10 minutes, until light golden.
Right away, press a chocolate kiss into the middle of each cookie. The cookie cracks around it.
Let cool for 1 hour so the chocolate sets.

recipes.name: Funfetti sprinkle cookies
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Beat the butter and sugar until fluffy.
Beat in the egg and vanilla.
Stir in the flour, cornstarch, baking soda and salt.
Gently stir in the sprinkles.
Roll into 1 1/2 inch balls and put them on a baking sheet 2 inches apart.
Bake for 9 to 11 minutes, until the edges are set but the tops are still pale.
Let cool for 5 minutes on the sheet, then move them to a wire rack.

recipes.name: Coconut macaroons
ingredients: 1 can (14 oz / 397 g) sweetened condensed milk
steps: Heat the oven to 325°F (165°C). Ask an adult to help.
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Mix the coconut, condensed milk and vanilla in a big bowl.
Beat the egg whites and salt in a clean bowl until stiff peaks form.
Gently fold the egg whites into the coconut mix.
Scoop 2 tablespoon mounds onto the baking sheet.
Bake for 22 to 25 minutes, until golden on the outside.
Let cool for 30 minutes, then dip the bottoms in melted chocolate if you like.

recipes.name: Meringue cookies
ingredients: 3 large egg whites, at room temperature
steps: Heat the oven to 225°F (110°C). Ask an adult to help.
Line 2 baking sheets with parchment paper.
Beat the egg whites and cream of tartar until foamy.
Add the sugar 1 tablespoon at a time while beating on high.
Beat until stiff, glossy peaks form and the sugar has dissolved. Beat in the vanilla and coloring.
Pipe or spoon small mounds onto the sheets.
Bake for 1 hour 30 minutes, until dry and they lift off the paper easily.
Turn off the oven and leave them inside for 1 hour to dry more.

recipes.name: Almond biscotti
ingredients: 1 cup (140 g) whole almonds, roughly chopped
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder and salt in a big bowl.
Beat the eggs and both extracts in a small bowl, then stir them into the flour mix.
Stir in the almonds. The dough will be sticky.
Shape it into 2 logs about 12 inches long and 2 inches wide on a lined baking sheet.
Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, until firm and light golden.
Let cool for 10 minutes, then cut the logs into 1/2 inch slices with a serrated knife. Ask an adult to help.
Lay the slices cut side down and bake for 10 minutes.
Flip them and bake for 10 minutes more, until dry and crisp.

recipes.name: Anzac biscuits
ingredients: 2 tablespoons golden syrup or light corn syrup
steps: Heat the oven to 325°F (165°C). Ask an adult to help.
Mix the oats, flour, coconut and brown sugar in a big bowl.
Melt the butter and syrup in a small pot over low heat.
Mix the baking soda with the boiling water and stir it into the butter. It will foam. Ask an adult to help.
Pour the butter mix into the dry mix and stir well.
Roll tablespoons of dough into balls, put them on a lined baking sheet and flatten them a little.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, until golden.
Let cool for 10 minutes on the sheet. They crisp up as they cool.

recipes.name: Alfajores
ingredients: 1/3 cup (25 g) shredded coconut for rolling
steps: Whisk the cornstarch, flour, baking powder and salt.
Beat the butter and sugar until creamy, then beat in the yolks, vanilla and lemon zest.
Stir in the dry mix until a soft dough forms. Wrap it and chill for 30 minutes.
Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Roll the dough 1/4 inch thick and cut 2 inch circles.
Bake on a lined sheet for 10 to 12 minutes. They should stay pale.
Let cool for 20 minutes. They are fragile, so handle gently.
Spread dulce de leche on half the cookies and top with the others.
Roll the edges in coconut.

recipes.name: Speculoos spice cookies
ingredients: 1 cup (220 g) packed dark brown sugar
steps: Whisk the flour, spices, baking soda and salt.
Beat the butter and brown sugar until creamy, then beat in the egg.
Stir in the flour mix. Flatten the dough into a disk, wrap it and chill for 1 hour.
Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Roll the dough 1/8 inch thick and cut into rectangles or shapes.
Bake on a lined sheet for 10 to 12 minutes, until browned at the edges.
Let cool on a wire rack. They get crisp as they cool.

recipes.name: Blondies
ingredients: 1/2 cup (85 g) chocolate chips or butterscotch chips
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Line an 8 by 8 inch pan with parchment paper.
Stir the melted butter and brown sugar together.
Stir in the egg and vanilla.
Stir in the flour, baking powder and salt, then the chips.
Spread the batter in the pan.
Bake for 22 to 25 minutes, until golden and just set in the middle.
Let cool for 30 minutes, then cut into squares.

recipes.name: Lemon bars
ingredients: Crust: 1/2 cup (115 g) butter, softened, 1/4 cup (30 g) powdered sugar, 1 cup (125 g) all-purpose flour, pinch of salt
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Line an 8 by 8 inch pan with parchment paper.
Mix the crust ingredients until crumbly and press into the pan.
Bake for 15 to 18 minutes, until light golden.
Whisk the sugar, flour, eggs, lemon juice and zest until smooth.
Pour the lemon mix over the hot crust.
Bake for 18 to 20 minutes, until the filling no longer jiggles.
Let cool for 30 minutes, then chill for 1 hour.
Dust with powdered sugar and cut into squares.

recipes.name: Magic cookie bars
ingredients: 1 can (14 oz / 397 g) sweetened condensed milk
1 cup (115 g) chopped walnuts or pecans
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Mix the crumbs and melted butter and press into a 9 by 13 inch pan.
Pour the condensed milk evenly over the crust.
Sprinkle on the chocolate chips, butterscotch chips, coconut and nuts.
Press everything down gently with a fork.
Bake for 25 minutes, until golden on top.
Let cool completely before cutting into bars.

recipes.name: No-bake peanut butter bars
ingredients: 1 cup (260 g) peanut butter, plus 4 tablespoons for the topping
steps: Line a 9 by 13 inch pan with parchment paper.
Mix the melted butter, crumbs, powdered sugar and 1 cup peanut butter.
Press the mix evenly into the pan.
Microwave the chocolate chips and 4 tablespoons peanut butter for 30 seconds at a time, stirring, until smooth.
Spread the chocolate over the peanut butter layer.
Chill for 1 hour, until firm.
Let sit for 10 minutes, then cut into bars.

recipes.name: Millionaire shortbread
ingredients: Base: 1 cup (125 g) all-purpose flour, 1/4 cup (50 g) sugar, 1/2 cup (115 g) butter, softened
Caramel: 1/2 cup (115 g) butter, 1/2 cup (110 g) packed brown sugar, 1 can (14 oz / 397 g) sweetened condensed milk
Topping: 7 oz (200 g) milk chocolate, chopped
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Line an 8 by 8 inch pan with parchment paper.
Rub the base ingredients together, press into the pan and prick with a fork.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until light golden. Let cool.
Put the caramel ingredients in a pot over medium heat. Ask an adult to help, hot caramel burns.
Stir all the time for 8 to 10 minutes, until thick and golden.
Pour the caramel over the base and chill for 1 hour.
Melt the chocolate in the microwave for 30 seconds at a time, stirring each time, and spread it over the caramel.
Chill for 1 hour, then cut into squares with a hot knife.

recipes.name: Nanaimo bars
ingredients: Base: 1/2 cup (115 g) butter, 1/4 cup (50 g) sugar, 5 tablespoons cocoa powder, 1 egg, beaten
Middle: 1/2 cup (115 g) butter, softened, 3 tablespoons milk, 2 tablespoons custard powder, 2 cups (240 g) powdered sugar
Top: 4 oz (115 g) semisweet chocolate and 2 tablespoons butter
steps: Put the base butter, sugar and cocoa in a heatproof bowl over a pot of simmering water. Ask an adult to help.
Stir until melted, then whisk in the egg and cook for 2 to 3 minutes, stirring, until thick.
Stir in the crumbs, coconut and walnuts, and press into a lined 8 by 8 inch pan. Chill for 30 minutes.
Beat the middle layer ingredients until smooth and spread over the base. Chill for 30 minutes.
Melt the chocolate and butter together and spread over the top.
Chill for 1 hour, then cut with a hot knife.

recipes.name: Oatmeal jam bars
ingredients: 1 cup (320 g) raspberry or strawberry jam
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Line an 8 by 8 inch pan with parchment paper.
Mix the flour, oats, brown sugar, baking soda and salt, then stir in the melted butter.
Press 2/3 of the mix into the pan.
Spread the jam over it, leaving a small border.
Sprinkle the rest of the crumbs on top.
Bake for 30 to 35 minutes, until golden.
Let cool completely before cutting.

recipes.name: S'mores bars
ingredients: 3 milk chocolate bars (1.55 oz / 44 g each)
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Beat the butter, sugar and brown sugar, then beat in the egg and vanilla.
Stir in the flour, crumbs, baking powder and salt.
Press half the dough into a lined 8 by 8 inch pan.
Lay the chocolate bars on top, then spread on the marshmallow creme.
Flatten small pieces of the rest of the dough and lay them over the marshmallow.
Bake for 30 to 35 minutes, until golden.
Let cool completely before cutting.

recipes.name: Cream cheese brownies
ingredients: Swirl: 8 oz (225 g) cream cheese, softened, 1/4 cup (50 g) sugar, 1 egg yolk, 1/2 teaspoon vanilla
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Line an 8 by 8 inch pan with parchment paper.
Microwave the butter and chocolate for 30 seconds at a time, stirring, until smooth.
Stir in the sugar, then the eggs and vanilla, then the flour and salt.
Beat the swirl ingredients until smooth.
Spread most of the brownie batter in the pan, drop spoonfuls of the swirl on top, then the rest of the batter.
Drag a knife through to make swirls.
Bake for 30 to 35 minutes, until the swirl is set.
Let cool for 1 hour, then chill before cutting.

recipes.name: Edible cookie dough
steps: Raw flour can carry germs, so heat it first. Microwave the flour in a bowl for 30 seconds at a time, stirring, until it reaches 165°F (74°C) on a thermometer, about 90 seconds total.
Let the flour cool for 10 minutes.
Beat the butter and brown sugar until creamy.
Stir in the milk, vanilla and salt.
Stir in the flour, then the chocolate chips.
Eat with a spoon, or roll into balls and chill for 30 minutes. There is no egg, so it is safe to eat.

recipes.name: Pumpkin bars
ingredients: Frosting: 8 oz (225 g) cream cheese, 1/2 cup (115 g) butter, 2 cups (240 g) powdered sugar, 1 teaspoon vanilla
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Grease a 10 by 15 inch rimmed pan.
Beat the eggs, sugar, oil and pumpkin.
Stir in the flour, baking powder, baking soda, cinnamon and salt.
Spread in the pan.
Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean.
Let cool for 1 hour.
Beat the frosting ingredients until smooth, spread over the cake and cut into bars.

recipes.name: Skillet chocolate chip cookie
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Grease a 10 inch oven-safe skillet.
Stir the melted butter, brown sugar and sugar, then stir in the egg and vanilla.
Stir in the flour, baking soda and salt, then the chocolate chips.
Press the dough evenly into the skillet.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until golden at the edges and soft in the middle.
Let cool for 10 minutes. The skillet stays very hot, so use oven mitts. Serve with ice cream.

recipes.name: Chocolate sandwich cookies
ingredients: Filling: 1/4 cup (55 g) butter, 1/4 cup (50 g) shortening, 2 cups (240 g) powdered sugar, 2 teaspoons vanilla
steps: Whisk the flour, cocoa, baking soda and salt.
Beat the butter and sugar, then beat in the egg. Stir in the dry mix.
Wrap the dough and chill for 30 minutes.
Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Roll the dough 1/8 inch thick and cut 2 inch circles.
Bake on a lined sheet for 8 to 10 minutes.
Let cool completely.
Beat the filling ingredients until smooth.
Spread filling on half the cookies and press the others on top.

recipes.name: Pecan sandies
steps: Beat the butter, powdered sugar, brown sugar and vanilla until creamy.
Stir in the flour, salt and pecans.
Shape the dough into a 2 inch wide log, wrap it and chill for 1 hour.
Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Slice the log into 1/4 inch rounds and put them on a baking sheet.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, until golden at the edges.
Let cool on a wire rack.

recipes.name: Brownie cookies
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Microwave the chocolate and butter for 30 seconds at a time, stirring, until smooth. Let cool for 5 minutes.
Beat the eggs and sugar for 3 minutes, until pale and thick.
Beat in the chocolate and vanilla.
Stir in the flour, cocoa, baking powder and salt, then the chips.
Let the batter rest for 10 minutes so it thickens.
Scoop 2 tablespoon mounds onto a lined sheet, 2 inches apart.
Bake for 10 to 12 minutes, until shiny and cracked on top.
Let cool for 10 minutes on the sheet.

recipes.name: Black and white cookies
aliases: new york black and white cookies
ingredients: Icing: 3 cups (360 g) powdered sugar, 3 to 4 tablespoons milk, 1 tablespoon light corn syrup, 3 tablespoons cocoa powder
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Beat the butter and sugar, then beat in the egg, vanilla and lemon zest.
Stir in half the flour, baking soda and salt, then the buttermilk, then the rest of the flour.
Scoop 1/4 cup mounds onto lined sheets, 3 inches apart.
Bake for 13 to 15 minutes, until the edges are golden. Let cool completely.
Mix the powdered sugar, milk and corn syrup into a thick, smooth icing.
Spread white icing over the flat bottom side of half of each cookie.
Stir the cocoa into the rest of the icing, adding a little milk, and spread it on the other halves.
Let set for 30 minutes.

recipes.name: Chinese almond cookies
ingredients: 1 large egg, plus 1 yolk for brushing
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Whisk the flour, almond flour, baking soda and salt.
Beat the butter and sugar, then beat in the egg and almond extract.
Stir in the dry mix.
Roll 1 inch balls, put them on a lined sheet and flatten each one a little.
Press an almond into each and brush with the beaten yolk.
Bake for 13 to 15 minutes, until golden.
Let cool on a wire rack.

recipes.name: Chocolate cutout cookies
steps: Whisk the flour, cocoa, baking powder and salt.
Beat the butter and sugar, then beat in the egg and vanilla.
Stir in the flour mix, split into 2 disks, wrap and chill for 1 hour.
Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Roll 1/4 inch thick on a lightly floured counter and cut shapes.
Bake on a lined sheet for 8 to 10 minutes, until the tops look dry.
Let cool for 5 minutes on the sheet, then decorate once cool.

recipes.name: Frosted sugar cookie bars
ingredients: Frosting: 1/2 cup (115 g) butter, 3 cups (360 g) powdered sugar, 3 tablespoons milk, 1 teaspoon vanilla, food coloring
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Ask an adult to help.
Grease a 10 by 15 inch rimmed pan.
Beat the butter and sugar, then beat in the eggs, sour cream and vanilla.
Stir in the flour, baking powder and salt.
Spread the dough evenly in the pan.
Bake for 15 to 20 minutes, until the edges are just golden.
Let cool for 1 hour.
Beat the frosting ingredients, spread on top and add sprinkles. Cut into bars.

recipes.name: Florentine lace cookies
ingredients: 3 oz (85 g) chocolate, melted, for drizzling
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Melt the butter, brown sugar, corn syrup and cream in a pot over medium heat, stirring, until it just boils. Ask an adult to help.
Take it off the heat and stir in the flour, oats, vanilla and salt.
Drop level teaspoons onto parchment-lined sheets, 3 inches apart. They spread a lot.
Bake for 8 to 10 minutes, until bubbly and golden brown.
Let cool for 5 minutes on the sheet, until firm enough to move.
Drizzle with melted chocolate.

recipes.name: No-churn vanilla ice cream
ingredients: 1 can (14 oz / 397 g) sweetened condensed milk, cold
steps: Whisk the condensed milk, vanilla and salt in a big bowl.
Whip the cream in another bowl until stiff peaks form, about 3 minutes.
Fold a third of the cream into the condensed milk, then gently fold in the rest.
Spread into a 9 by 5 inch loaf pan and cover.
Freeze for 6 hours, until firm.
Let sit for 5 minutes before scooping.

recipes.name: No-churn chocolate ice cream
ingredients: 1 can (14 oz / 397 g) sweetened condensed milk
1/2 cup (45 g) unsweetened cocoa powder, sifted
steps: Whisk the condensed milk, cocoa, vanilla and salt until smooth.
Whip the cream until stiff peaks form.
Fold the cream into the chocolate mix in 3 parts, then fold in the chips.
Spread into a 9 by 5 inch loaf pan and cover.
Freeze for 6 hours, until firm.

recipes.name: Mint chocolate chip ice cream
ingredients: 1 can (14 oz / 397 g) sweetened condensed milk
3/4 cup (130 g) mini chocolate chips or chopped chocolate
steps: Whisk the condensed milk, peppermint and food coloring. Taste and add a little more peppermint if you like.
Whip the cream until stiff peaks form.
Fold the cream into the condensed milk, then fold in the chocolate.
Spread into a loaf pan, cover and freeze for 6 hours.

recipes.name: No-churn strawberry ice cream
ingredients: 1 can (14 oz / 397 g) sweetened condensed milk
steps: Mash the strawberries with the sugar and lemon juice until mostly smooth with small chunks.
Whisk the condensed milk and vanilla, then stir in the strawberries.
Whip the cream until stiff peaks form.
Gently fold the cream into the strawberry mix.
Spread into a loaf pan, cover and freeze for 6 hours.

recipes.name: Banana nice cream
ingredients: 4 ripe bananas, peeled, sliced and frozen
Optional: 2 tablespoons cocoa powder or peanut butter
steps: Freeze the banana slices in a bag for at least 4 hours beforehand.
Put the frozen bananas and 2 tablespoons milk in a food processor or strong blender.
Blend for 2 to 3 minutes, scraping down the sides, until smooth like soft serve.
Add the cocoa or peanut butter and blend again.
Eat right away, or freeze for 1 hour for scoopable ice cream.

recipes.name: Fruit popsicles
ingredients: 3 cups (450 g) strawberries or mango chunks
1/2 cup (120 ml) water or apple juice
steps: Blend everything until smooth. Taste and add more sugar if needed.
Pour into 8 popsicle molds.
Freeze for 1 hour, then push in the sticks.
Freeze for 5 hours more, until solid.
Run the molds under warm water for 10 seconds to get them out.

recipes.name: Frozen yogurt bark
ingredients: 2 tablespoons mini chocolate chips or granola
steps: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Stir the yogurt, honey and vanilla.
Spread it on the paper about 1/4 inch thick.
Scatter the berries and chocolate chips on top and press them in.
Freeze for 3 hours, until firm.
Break into pieces and eat right away. Keep the rest in the freezer.

recipes.name: Orange creamsicle pops
steps: Whisk the yogurt, milk, sugar and vanilla.
Pour a little orange juice into each mold, then a little yogurt mix. Keep layering.
Swirl once with a skewer.
Freeze for 1 hour, then push in the sticks.
Freeze for 5 hours more, until solid.

recipes.name: Chocolate fudge pops
steps: Whisk the sugar, cocoa, cornstarch and salt in a pot, then whisk in the milk.
Cook over medium heat, stirring, until it bubbles and thickens. Ask an adult to help.
Boil for 1 minute, then stir in the chocolate and vanilla.
Let cool for 30 minutes.
Pour into 8 molds, add the sticks and freeze for 6 hours.

recipes.name: Lemon sorbet
ingredients: 1 cup (240 ml) water for the syrup
steps: Heat the sugar and 1 cup water in a pot, stirring, for 3 minutes, until the sugar dissolves. Ask an adult to help.
Let cool for 20 minutes.
Stir in the lemon juice, zest and cold water.
Pour into a metal 9 by 13 inch pan and freeze.
Every 30 minutes, scrape and stir with a fork. Do this for 3 to 4 hours, until smooth and frozen.
Or churn it in an ice cream maker following its directions.

recipes.name: Blender mango sorbet
ingredients: 1/4 cup (60 ml) honey or maple syrup
1/4 to 1/2 cup (60 to 120 ml) cold water
steps: Put the mango, honey and lime juice in a food processor or strong blender.
Add 1/4 cup water and blend, scraping the sides, until smooth. Add more water a little at a time if it is stuck.
Eat right away like soft serve, or freeze for 2 hours to scoop.

recipes.name: Watermelon granita
steps: Blend the watermelon, sugar and lime juice until smooth.
Pour into a 9 by 13 inch pan and freeze for 1 hour.
Scrape with a fork to break up the ice crystals.
Freeze and scrape every 30 minutes for 2 to 3 hours, until fluffy and icy.
Scoop into cups.

recipes.name: Ice cream sandwiches
ingredients: 16 soft chocolate chip cookies, homemade or store bought
1/2 cup (85 g) mini chocolate chips or sprinkles
steps: Let the ice cream sit out for 10 minutes to soften a little.
Put a big scoop on the flat side of a cookie.
Press a second cookie on top until the ice cream reaches the edges.
Roll the edges in mini chips or sprinkles.
Wrap each one in plastic wrap and freeze for 1 hour, until firm.

recipes.name: Ice cream sundae
ingredients: 1/2 cup (120 ml) hot fudge or caramel sauce, warmed
steps: Put 2 scoops of ice cream in each bowl or glass.
Spoon the warm sauce over the ice cream.
Add a swirl of whipped cream.
Sprinkle with nuts or sprinkles.
Top each with a cherry.

recipes.name: Banana split
ingredients: 1 scoop each vanilla, chocolate and strawberry ice cream
2 tablespoons pineapple topping or crushed pineapple
Whipped cream, chopped nuts and a cherry
steps: Peel the banana and cut it in half lengthwise with a butter knife.
Put the halves along the sides of a long dish.
Put the 3 scoops of ice cream in a row between them.
Spoon chocolate syrup over the chocolate scoop, strawberry over the vanilla and pineapple over the strawberry.
Add whipped cream, nuts and a cherry on top.

recipes.name: Frozen chocolate bananas
ingredients: Toppings: sprinkles, chopped peanuts, crushed cookies
steps: Peel the bananas, cut them in half across and push a stick into each cut end.
Lay them on a parchment-lined tray and freeze for 1 hour.
Microwave the chocolate and coconut oil for 30 seconds at a time, stirring, until smooth.
Dip or spoon chocolate over each banana and roll in toppings right away.
Freeze for 30 minutes, until the chocolate is hard.

recipes.name: Ice cream cake
aliases: cookies and cream ice cream cake
ingredients: 1 1/2 quarts (1.4 liters) vanilla ice cream, softened
1/2 cup (120 ml) hot fudge sauce, room temperature
1 1/2 quarts (1.4 liters) chocolate ice cream, softened
steps: Mix the cookie crumbs and butter, saving 1/2 cup of crumbs, and press the rest into a 9 inch springform pan.
Freeze for 15 minutes.
Spread the vanilla ice cream over the crust.
Drizzle with hot fudge and sprinkle with the saved crumbs.
Freeze for 1 hour.
Spread the chocolate ice cream on top and freeze for 1 hour.
Spread the whipped topping over the top and add sprinkles.
Freeze for 4 hours, until firm. Let sit for 10 minutes before slicing.

recipes.name: Kulfi
ingredients: 1 can (14 oz / 397 g) sweetened condensed milk
steps: Blend the evaporated milk, condensed milk, cream, cardamom and saffron for 1 minute.
Stir in most of the pistachios.
Pour into 8 small cups or popsicle molds and sprinkle with the rest of the pistachios.
Cover with foil and push in a stick if you like.
Freeze for 8 hours, until solid.
Dip the cups in warm water for 10 seconds to unmold.

recipes.name: Berry frozen yogurt
ingredients: 4 cups (560 g) frozen strawberries or mixed berries
steps: Put everything in a food processor.
Blend for 2 to 3 minutes, scraping down the sides, until creamy.
Eat right away, or freeze for 1 hour for a firmer scoop.

recipes.name: Snow cones with homemade syrup
ingredients: 1 packet (about 0.15 oz / 4 g) unsweetened drink mix, any flavor
steps: Heat the sugar and water in a pot for 2 to 3 minutes, stirring, until the sugar dissolves. Ask an adult to help.
Take it off the heat and stir in the drink mix.
Let the syrup cool for 15 minutes.
Crush the ice in a blender or shaved ice machine until fluffy like snow.
Pack into cups and pour 2 to 3 tablespoons of syrup over each.

recipes.name: Ice cream in a bag
ingredients: 1 cup (240 ml) half and half or whole milk
1/2 cup (about 140 g) rock salt or coarse salt
1 quart zip bag and 1 gallon zip bag
steps: Pour the half and half, sugar and vanilla into the small bag. Squeeze out the air and seal it tight.
Put the ice and salt in the big bag.
Put the small bag inside the big bag and seal it.
Wrap the bag in a towel or wear gloves, it gets very cold.
Shake for 5 to 10 minutes, until the cream turns into soft ice cream. The salt makes the ice colder than freezing.
Wipe the salt off the small bag before opening it, then eat with a spoon.

recipes.name: Easy chocolate fudge
ingredients: 1 can (14 oz / 397 g) sweetened condensed milk
steps: Line an 8 by 8 inch pan with foil or parchment.
Put the chips, condensed milk and butter in a big microwave-safe bowl.
Microwave for 1 minute, stir, then for 30 seconds at a time until smooth.
Stir in the vanilla, salt and nuts.
Spread in the pan.
Chill for 2 hours, until firm, then cut into small squares.

recipes.name: Peanut butter fudge
steps: Line an 8 by 8 inch pan with parchment.
Microwave the butter and peanut butter for 1 minute, stir, then 30 seconds more until melted and smooth.
Stir in the vanilla.
Stir in the powdered sugar a cup at a time until thick and smooth.
Press into the pan.
Chill for 2 hours, then cut into squares.

recipes.name: Soft caramels
ingredients: 1 can (14 oz / 397 g) sweetened condensed milk
steps: An adult should do all the cooking. Hot sugar sticks to skin and burns badly.
Line a 9 by 13 inch pan with buttered parchment.
Melt the butter in a heavy pot, then stir in the brown sugar, corn syrup, condensed milk and salt.
Cook over medium heat, stirring all the time, until it boils.
Clip on a candy thermometer and keep stirring for 12 to 15 minutes, until it reaches 245°F (118°C).
Take it off the heat, stir in the vanilla and pour into the pan.
Let cool for 2 hours, until firm.
Cut into small squares and wrap each in wax paper.

recipes.name: Saltine cracker toffee
ingredients: 1/2 cup (55 g) chopped pecans or sprinkles (optional)
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Line a 10 by 15 inch rimmed pan with foil and lay the crackers on it in one layer.
Melt the butter and brown sugar in a pot, then boil for 3 minutes without stirring. It is very hot.
Pour it over the crackers and spread it out.
Bake for 5 minutes, until bubbly.
Sprinkle the chocolate chips on top and wait 5 minutes, then spread the melted chips.
Add the nuts or sprinkles.
Chill for 1 hour, then break into pieces.

recipes.name: Peanut brittle
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups (220 g) raw or roasted peanuts
steps: An adult should do the cooking. This sugar gets hotter than boiling water.
Butter a baking sheet and set it next to the stove.
Cook the sugar, corn syrup and water in a heavy pot over medium heat, stirring until the sugar dissolves.
Boil without stirring until a candy thermometer reads 240°F (116°C).
Stir in the peanuts and keep cooking, stirring, until it reaches 300°F (149°C) and turns golden.
Take it off the heat and quickly stir in the butter, baking soda, vanilla and salt. It will foam.
Pour onto the sheet right away and spread thin.
Let cool for 30 minutes, then break into pieces.

recipes.name: Chocolate truffles
ingredients: 8 oz (225 g) semisweet chocolate, finely chopped
Coatings: cocoa powder, sprinkles, chopped nuts or coconut
steps: Heat the cream in a small pot until steaming. Ask an adult to help.
Pour it over the chocolate and let sit for 3 minutes.
Stir until smooth, then stir in the butter and vanilla.
Cover and chill for 2 hours, until firm.
Scoop teaspoon size pieces and roll them quickly into balls between your palms.
Roll in the coatings and keep in the fridge.

recipes.name: Brigadeiros
ingredients: 1 can (14 oz / 397 g) sweetened condensed milk
1 tablespoon butter, plus more for your hands
steps: Put the condensed milk, butter, cocoa and salt in a nonstick pot.
Cook over medium low heat, stirring all the time, for 10 to 12 minutes, until it is thick and pulls away from the bottom of the pot. Ask an adult to help.
Pour onto a buttered plate and let cool for 1 hour.
Butter your hands and roll teaspoons of the mix into balls.
Roll each ball in sprinkles and set in a small paper cup.

recipes.name: Rocky road
ingredients: 12 oz (340 g) milk or semisweet chocolate, chopped
1 cup (115 g) chopped peanuts or crushed graham crackers
steps: Line an 8 by 8 inch pan with parchment.
Microwave the chocolate and butter for 30 seconds at a time, stirring, until smooth.
Let cool for 5 minutes so the marshmallows do not melt.
Stir in the marshmallows and nuts.
Spread in the pan.
Chill for 2 hours, then cut into squares.

recipes.name: Peppermint bark
ingredients: 12 oz (340 g) semisweet or dark chocolate, chopped
steps: Line a 9 by 13 inch pan with parchment.
Melt the dark chocolate in the microwave for 30 seconds at a time, stirring each time.
Spread it in the pan and chill for 15 minutes.
Melt the white chocolate the same way and stir in the peppermint extract.
Spread the white chocolate over the dark layer and sprinkle with candy canes.
Chill for 30 minutes, then break into pieces.

recipes.name: Chocolate covered strawberries
ingredients: 2 oz (55 g) white chocolate for drizzling (optional)
steps: Wash the strawberries and dry them completely. Water makes chocolate seize.
Line a tray with parchment paper.
Microwave the chocolate and coconut oil for 30 seconds at a time, stirring, until smooth.
Hold each berry by the stem, dip it in the chocolate and let the extra drip off.
Lay them on the tray.
Drizzle with melted white chocolate.
Chill for 20 minutes, until set.

recipes.name: Homemade marshmallows
ingredients: 3 packets (3/4 oz / 21 g total) unflavored gelatin
Coating: 1/2 cup (60 g) powdered sugar mixed with 1/2 cup (60 g) cornstarch
steps: Grease a 9 by 13 inch pan and dust it with some of the coating.
Sprinkle the gelatin over 1/2 cup cold water in a stand mixer bowl.
An adult should cook the syrup. Heat the sugar, corn syrup, salt and the other 1/2 cup water, stirring until dissolved.
Boil without stirring until a candy thermometer reads 240°F (116°C).
With the mixer on low, slowly pour the hot syrup down the side of the bowl into the gelatin.
Beat on high for 12 minutes, until thick, white and fluffy. Beat in the vanilla.
Spread in the pan and dust the top with coating.
Let set uncovered for 4 hours, then cut into squares and toss in more coating.

recipes.name: Homemade peanut butter cups
steps: Line a 12-cup muffin pan with paper liners.
Microwave the chocolate and coconut oil for 30 seconds at a time, stirring, until smooth.
Spoon 1 tablespoon chocolate into each liner and tilt so it coats the bottom. Chill for 10 minutes.
Mix the peanut butter, powdered sugar, butter and salt.
Put a flat spoonful of peanut butter mix in each cup.
Cover with the rest of the chocolate.
Chill for 30 minutes, until firm.

recipes.name: Coconut ice
ingredients: 1 can (14 oz / 397 g) sweetened condensed milk
2 drops pink or red food coloring
steps: Line an 8 by 8 inch pan with parchment.
Mix the condensed milk and powdered sugar, then stir in the coconut. It will be stiff.
Press half the mix into the pan.
Knead the food coloring into the other half until pink.
Press the pink layer on top.
Chill for 3 hours, until firm, then cut into squares.

recipes.name: Cake pops
ingredients: 1 baked and cooled 9 by 13 inch vanilla or chocolate cake, from a box mix or scratch
steps: Crumble the cake into fine crumbs in a big bowl.
Mix in the frosting until it holds together like dough.
Roll into 1 1/2 inch balls and put them on a lined tray.
Chill for 1 hour.
Melt the candy melts and coconut oil in the microwave for 30 seconds at a time, stirring.
Dip the tip of a stick into the candy, push it halfway into a ball and repeat. Freeze for 15 minutes.
Dip each pop into the candy, tap off the extra and add sprinkles.
Stand them in a foam block or cup to set for 15 minutes.

recipes.name: Caramel apples
ingredients: 1 bag (11 oz / 311 g) caramel candies, unwrapped
Toppings: chopped peanuts, sprinkles, mini chocolate chips
steps: Wash the apples and dry them completely so the caramel sticks.
Push a stick firmly into the top of each apple.
Microwave the caramels and milk for 2 minutes, stirring every 30 seconds, until smooth. It is very hot, so ask an adult to help.
Tilt the bowl and twirl each apple in the caramel.
Let the extra drip off, then roll the bottom in toppings.
Set on buttered parchment and chill for 15 minutes.

recipes.name: Hard candy lollipops
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon candy flavoring oil or 1 teaspoon extract
12 lollipop sticks and a silicone mat or lollipop molds
steps: An adult must do the cooking. This syrup gets hotter than 300°F (149°C) and burns badly.
Lay the sticks on the silicone mat or set them in the molds.
Heat the sugar, corn syrup and water in a small heavy pot, stirring, until the sugar dissolves.
Stop stirring and boil until a candy thermometer reads 300°F (149°C).
Take it off the heat, wait for the bubbles to stop and stir in the flavoring and coloring.
Carefully spoon circles of syrup over the end of each stick.
Let harden for 20 minutes, then wrap in plastic.

recipes.name: Honeycomb candy
ingredients: 1/4 cup (60 ml) light corn syrup or golden syrup
steps: An adult must do the cooking. The syrup and foam are extremely hot.
Line an 8 by 8 inch pan with buttered parchment.
Heat the sugar, corn syrup and water in a big pot, stirring until the sugar dissolves.
Boil without stirring until a candy thermometer reads 300°F (149°C) and it is golden.
Take it off the heat, add the baking soda and whisk for 5 seconds. It foams up a lot.
Pour into the pan right away. Do not spread it.
Let cool for 1 hour, then break into chunks. Dip in chocolate if you like.

recipes.name: Cookies and cream truffles
ingredients: 36 chocolate sandwich cookies (one 14 oz / 400 g package)
12 oz (340 g) semisweet or white chocolate, chopped
steps: Blend the cookies into fine crumbs in a food processor, or crush them in a bag.
Mix in the cream cheese until it looks like dough.
Roll into 1 inch balls and put them on a lined tray.
Chill for 30 minutes.
Melt the chocolate and coconut oil in the microwave for 30 seconds at a time, stirring.
Dip each ball with a fork, tap off the extra and put it back on the tray.
Chill for 1 hour, until firm. Keep in the fridge.

recipes.name: Milk burfi
steps: Grease an 8 by 4 inch loaf pan.
Melt the ghee in a nonstick pan over low heat and stir in the milk.
Stir in the milk powder until smooth, then the sugar. Ask an adult to help.
Cook on low for 5 to 7 minutes, stirring all the time, until it forms a soft dough that pulls away from the pan.
Stir in the cardamom.
Press into the pan and sprinkle with pistachios, pressing them in.
Let set for 1 hour, then cut into squares.

recipes.name: Besan ladoo
steps: Put the besan and ghee in a heavy pan over low heat. Ask an adult to help.
Stir all the time for 15 to 20 minutes, until golden and it smells nutty. Low heat keeps it from burning.
Take it off the heat and let cool for 15 minutes, until warm but safe to touch.
Stir in the powdered sugar, cardamom and nuts.
Squeeze handfuls into 16 tight balls.
Let set for 15 minutes.

recipes.name: Buckeyes
steps: Beat the peanut butter, butter and vanilla, then beat in the powdered sugar until it forms a dough.
Roll into 1 inch balls and put them on a lined tray.
Chill for 30 minutes.
Melt the chocolate and coconut oil in the microwave for 30 seconds at a time, stirring.
Poke a toothpick into each ball and dip it, leaving a circle of peanut butter showing on top.
Chill for 20 minutes, until set. Smooth over the toothpick hole with your finger.

recipes.name: Pecan pralines
steps: An adult should do the cooking. Hot sugar burns badly.
Line 2 baking sheets with parchment.
Cook the sugar, brown sugar, evaporated milk and butter in a heavy pot over medium heat, stirring, until it boils.
Add the pecans and cook, stirring, until a candy thermometer reads 238°F (114°C).
Take it off the heat and stir in the vanilla and salt.
Stir for 2 to 3 minutes, until it thickens and looks creamy.
Quickly drop spoonfuls onto the parchment.
Let set for 30 minutes.

recipes.name: Blueberry muffins
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups (220 g) blueberries, fresh or frozen
1 tablespoon coarse sugar for the tops (optional)
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Line a 12-cup muffin pan with paper liners.
Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder and salt in a big bowl.
Whisk the oil, egg, milk and vanilla in another bowl.
Pour the wet mix into the dry mix and stir until just combined. Lumps are fine.
Gently fold in the blueberries. Use them frozen, do not thaw.
Fill the liners almost full and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
Bake for 18 to 20 minutes, until golden and a toothpick comes out clean.
Let cool for 10 minutes.

recipes.name: Chocolate chip muffins
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Ask an adult to help.
Line a 12-cup muffin pan with liners.
Whisk the flour, sugar, brown sugar, baking powder and salt.
Whisk the butter, eggs, milk and vanilla in another bowl.
Stir the wet into the dry until just combined, then stir in most of the chips.
Fill the liners and sprinkle the rest of the chips on top.
Bake for 18 to 20 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean.
Let cool for 10 minutes.

recipes.name: Double chocolate muffins
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Ask an adult to help.
Line a 12-cup muffin pan with liners.
Whisk the flour, cocoa, sugar, baking powder, baking soda and salt.
Whisk the eggs, milk, oil and vanilla in another bowl.
Stir the wet into the dry until just combined, then stir in the chips.
Fill the liners nearly full.
Bake for 18 to 20 minutes, until a toothpick comes out with only melted chocolate.
Let cool for 10 minutes.

recipes.name: Lemon poppy seed muffins
ingredients: 3/4 cup (180 g) plain yogurt or sour cream
Glaze: 1 cup (120 g) powdered sugar and 2 tablespoons lemon juice
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Ask an adult to help.
Line a 12-cup muffin pan with liners.
Whisk the flour, sugar, poppy seeds, baking powder, baking soda and salt.
Whisk the eggs, yogurt, butter, zest and lemon juice.
Stir the wet into the dry until just combined.
Fill the liners 3/4 full.
Bake for 18 to 20 minutes, until golden.
Let cool for 15 minutes, then drizzle with the glaze.

recipes.name: Pumpkin muffins
ingredients: 2 teaspoons pumpkin pie spice or cinnamon
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Ask an adult to help.
Line a 12-cup muffin pan with liners.
Whisk the flour, baking soda, baking powder, salt and spice.
Whisk the pumpkin, oil, eggs, both sugars and milk.
Stir the wet into the dry until just combined, then the chips.
Fill the liners nearly full.
Bake for 20 to 22 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean.
Let cool for 10 minutes.

recipes.name: Apple cinnamon muffins
ingredients: Crumb top: 1/4 cup (30 g) flour, 1/4 cup (55 g) brown sugar, 2 tablespoons butter, 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Ask an adult to help.
Line a 12-cup muffin pan with liners.
Peel and dice the apple into small cubes. Ask an adult to help with the knife.
Whisk the flour, both sugars, baking powder, cinnamon and salt.
Whisk the eggs, butter and milk, then stir into the dry mix until just combined.
Fold in the apple and fill the liners.
Rub the crumb top together and sprinkle over the muffins.
Bake for 20 to 22 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean.

recipes.name: Raspberry white chocolate muffins
ingredients: 1 cup (125 g) raspberries, fresh or frozen
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Ask an adult to help.
Line a 12-cup muffin pan with liners.
Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder and salt.
Whisk the butter, eggs, milk and vanilla, then stir into the dry mix until just combined.
Gently fold in the raspberries and white chocolate.
Fill the liners nearly full.
Bake for 20 to 22 minutes, until golden.
Let cool for 10 minutes.

recipes.name: Cornbread
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Grease an 8 by 8 inch pan or a 12-cup muffin pan.
Whisk the cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder and salt.
Whisk the milk, butter and egg, then stir into the dry mix until just combined.
Pour into the pan.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until golden and a toothpick comes out clean. Muffins take 15 to 18 minutes.
Let cool for 5 minutes. Serve warm with butter and honey.

recipes.name: Zucchini bread
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups (190 g) grated zucchini, about 1 medium
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Grease a 9 by 5 inch loaf pan.
Grate the zucchini on a box grater, keeping your fingers clear, and squeeze out some of the water in a towel.
Whisk the flour, cinnamon, baking soda, baking powder and salt.
Whisk the eggs, oil, sugars and vanilla, then stir in the zucchini.
Stir in the flour mix until just combined.
Pour into the pan.
Bake for 55 to 60 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean.
Let cool for 15 minutes in the pan, then on a rack.

recipes.name: Pumpkin bread
ingredients: 2 teaspoons pumpkin pie spice or cinnamon
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Grease a 9 by 5 inch loaf pan.
Whisk the flour, baking soda, salt and spice.
Whisk the pumpkin, eggs, oil, water and both sugars.
Stir in the flour mix until just combined.
Pour into the pan.
Bake for 55 to 65 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean.
Let cool for 15 minutes in the pan, then on a rack.

recipes.name: Irish soda bread
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Ask an adult to help.
Whisk the flour, baking soda, salt and sugar in a big bowl. Stir in the raisins.
Pour in the buttermilk and stir with a fork until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead gently on a floured counter for 30 seconds, just until it holds together.
Shape into a round loaf about 2 inches tall and put it on a lined baking sheet.
Cut a deep cross on top with a knife. Ask an adult to help.
Bake for 35 to 40 minutes, until browned and hollow sounding when tapped underneath.
Let cool for 20 minutes.

recipes.name: Buttermilk biscuits
ingredients: 1/2 cup (115 g) very cold butter, cubed
3/4 cup (180 ml) cold buttermilk, plus more if needed
steps: Heat the oven to 450°F (230°C). Ask an adult to help.
Whisk the flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt and sugar.
Rub in the cold butter until the pieces are pea sized.
Stir in the buttermilk until just combined. Add a spoonful more if it is dry.
Pat the dough 1 inch thick, fold it in half, pat it out again and fold again. This makes layers.
Pat 3/4 inch thick and cut straight down with a 2 1/2 inch cutter. Do not twist.
Put them touching on a baking sheet.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, until golden.
Brush with melted butter.

recipes.name: Cheddar garlic drop biscuits
ingredients: Topping: 3 tablespoons butter, melted, 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder, 1 teaspoon chopped parsley
steps: Heat the oven to 450°F (230°C). Ask an adult to help.
Whisk the flour, baking powder, sugar, garlic powder and salt.
Stir in the buttermilk and melted butter until just combined, then the cheese.
Drop 12 big spoonfuls onto a lined baking sheet.
Bake for 10 to 12 minutes, until golden.
Mix the topping and brush it over the hot biscuits.

recipes.name: Cream scones
ingredients: 1/2 cup (120 ml) heavy cream, plus more for brushing
3/4 cup mix-ins like blueberries, chocolate chips or dried cranberries
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder and salt.
Rub in the cold butter until crumbly.
Whisk the cream, egg and vanilla and stir into the flour until just combined. Fold in the mix-ins.
Pat into an 8 inch circle on a lined baking sheet and cut into 8 wedges. Pull them apart a little.
Brush with cream and sprinkle with sugar.
Bake for 18 to 20 minutes, until golden.
Let cool for 10 minutes.

recipes.name: Cheese scones
ingredients: 1 cup (115 g) grated sharp cheddar, plus a little for the tops
2/3 cup (160 ml) milk, plus a little for brushing
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Ask an adult to help.
Whisk the flour, baking powder, salt and mustard powder.
Rub in the butter until it looks like breadcrumbs, then stir in the cheese.
Stir in the milk to make a soft dough.
Pat 1 inch thick and cut 2 1/2 inch rounds.
Put on a lined sheet, brush with milk and sprinkle with cheese.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, until risen and golden.

recipes.name: Sour cream coffee cake
ingredients: Streusel: 3/4 cup (95 g) flour, 1/2 cup (110 g) packed brown sugar, 1 teaspoon cinnamon, 1/3 cup (75 g) butter, melted
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Grease a 9 by 9 inch pan.
Mix the streusel ingredients with a fork until clumpy.
Beat the butter and sugar, then beat in the eggs, vanilla and sour cream.
Stir in the flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt.
Spread half the batter in the pan and sprinkle with half the streusel.
Spread the rest of the batter on top and finish with the rest of the streusel.
Bake for 40 to 45 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean. There is no coffee in it. It is made to eat with coffee.

recipes.name: Strawberry bread
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Grease a 9 by 5 inch loaf pan.
Whisk the flour, baking soda, salt and cinnamon.
Whisk the eggs, oil, sugar and vanilla.
Stir in the flour mix until just combined, then fold in the strawberries.
Pour into the pan.
Bake for 55 to 60 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean.
Let cool for 15 minutes in the pan.

recipes.name: Cranberry orange bread
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups (150 g) fresh or frozen cranberries, roughly chopped
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Grease a 9 by 5 inch loaf pan.
Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, salt and zest.
Whisk the orange juice, egg and butter, then stir into the dry mix until just combined.
Fold in the cranberries and nuts.
Pour into the pan.
Bake for 55 to 60 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean.
Let cool for 15 minutes in the pan.

recipes.name: Baked donuts
ingredients: Topping: powdered sugar glaze with sprinkles, or 1/4 cup melted butter and 1/2 cup cinnamon sugar
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Grease two 6-cavity donut pans.
Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder, salt and nutmeg.
Whisk the milk, eggs, butter and vanilla and stir into the dry mix until smooth.
Spoon the batter into a zip bag, snip a corner and pipe into the pans 2/3 full.
Bake for 10 to 12 minutes, until they spring back when touched.
Let cool for 5 minutes, then turn out.
Dip in glaze and sprinkles, or brush with butter and roll in cinnamon sugar.

recipes.name: Australian damper
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Whisk the flour, baking powder and salt.
Rub in the butter until it looks like breadcrumbs.
Stir in the milk and water until a soft dough forms.
Knead gently and shape into a round about 2 inches tall on a lined baking sheet.
Cut a cross on top with a knife and dust with flour.
Bake for 30 to 35 minutes, until golden and hollow sounding.
Serve warm with butter and golden syrup or jam.

recipes.name: Cinnamon swirl quick bread
ingredients: Swirl: 1/3 cup (65 g) sugar mixed with 2 teaspoons cinnamon
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Grease a 9 by 5 inch loaf pan.
Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder and salt.
Whisk the buttermilk, oil, egg and vanilla and stir into the dry mix until just combined.
Pour half the batter in the pan and sprinkle with half the cinnamon sugar.
Add the rest of the batter and sprinkle with the rest of the cinnamon sugar.
Swirl with a knife.
Bake for 45 to 50 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean.
Let cool for 15 minutes in the pan.

recipes.name: Popovers
ingredients: 1 cup (240 ml) milk, at room temperature
1 tablespoon butter, melted, plus more for the pan
steps: Heat the oven to 450°F (230°C). Ask an adult to help.
Grease a 6-cup popover pan or a 12-cup muffin pan well.
Whisk the flour, salt, milk, eggs and melted butter until smooth.
Fill the cups halfway.
Bake for 20 minutes. Do not open the oven or they fall.
Turn the oven down to 350°F (175°C) and bake for 15 to 20 minutes more, until tall and deep golden.
Poke each one with a knife to let the steam out and serve right away.

recipes.name: All-butter pie crust
ingredients: 1 cup (225 g) very cold butter, cut in small cubes
steps: Whisk the flour, sugar and salt in a big bowl.
Rub the butter into the flour with your fingers or a pastry cutter until the biggest bits are pea sized.
Sprinkle on 6 tablespoons of ice water and stir with a fork.
Squeeze a handful. If it falls apart, add more water a tablespoon at a time.
Split the dough in half, press each half into a flat disk and wrap it.
Chill for 1 hour before rolling. This makes a top and bottom crust for one 9 inch pie.
To bake an empty crust, line it with parchment and dried beans and bake at 425°F (220°C) for 15 minutes, then remove the beans and bake for 10 minutes more. Ask an adult to help.

recipes.name: Graham cracker crust
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups (150 g) graham cracker crumbs, about 10 full sheets
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Crush the crackers in a zip bag with a rolling pin until fine.
Stir the crumbs, sugar and melted butter until it looks like wet sand.
Press firmly into the bottom and sides of a 9 inch pie plate with the bottom of a cup.
Bake for 10 minutes, until fragrant.
Let cool for 15 minutes before filling.

recipes.name: Apple pie
ingredients: 1 batch all-butter pie crust (top and bottom), chilled
6 to 7 medium apples (2 1/2 lb / 1.1 kg), peeled and thinly sliced
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Ask an adult to help.
Peel, core and slice the apples. Ask an adult to help with the knife.
Toss the apples with the sugar, flour, cinnamon, nutmeg and lemon juice.
Roll half the dough into a 12 inch circle and fit it into a 9 inch pie plate.
Pile in the apples and dot with butter.
Roll the other half, lay it on top, trim, and pinch the edges together.
Cut 4 slits in the top and brush with the egg wash.
Bake for 15 minutes, then turn the oven down to 375°F (190°C).
Bake for 40 to 45 minutes more, until golden and the juice bubbles through the slits.
Let cool for 2 hours so the filling sets.

recipes.name: Pumpkin pie
ingredients: 1 unbaked 9 inch pie crust (half batch of all-butter pie crust)
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Ask an adult to help.
Fit the crust into a 9 inch pie plate and crimp the edge.
Whisk the sugar, salt and spices, then whisk in the eggs and pumpkin.
Slowly whisk in the evaporated milk.
Pour into the crust.
Bake for 15 minutes, then turn the oven down to 350°F (175°C).
Bake for 40 to 50 minutes more, until a knife near the middle comes out clean.
Let cool for 2 hours, then chill. Serve with whipped cream.

recipes.name: Pecan pie
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Fit the crust into a 9 inch pie plate.
Whisk the corn syrup, eggs, sugar, brown sugar, butter, vanilla and salt.
Stir in the pecans and pour into the crust.
Bake for 60 to 70 minutes, until the middle is set and only jiggles a little. Cover the edges with foil if they brown too fast.
Let cool for 2 hours before slicing.

recipes.name: Cherry pie
ingredients: 1 batch all-butter pie crust (top and bottom), chilled
5 cups (about 2 lb / 900 g) pitted tart cherries, fresh or thawed frozen and drained
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Stir the cherries, sugar, cornstarch, lemon juice and almond extract.
Roll half the dough and fit it into a 9 inch pie plate. Pour in the filling.
Roll the other half, cut it into strips and weave a lattice on top. Pinch the edges.
Brush with the egg wash and put the pie on a baking sheet to catch drips.
Bake for 50 to 60 minutes, until golden and the filling bubbles in the middle.
Let cool for 3 hours so the filling sets.

recipes.name: Blueberry pie
ingredients: 1 batch all-butter pie crust (top and bottom), chilled
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Toss the blueberries with the sugar, cornstarch, lemon juice, zest and salt.
Fit half the dough into a 9 inch pie plate and fill with the berries.
Cover with the top crust or a lattice and pinch the edges. Cut slits if using a full top.
Brush with egg wash and set on a baking sheet.
Bake for 20 minutes, then turn the oven down to 375°F (190°C).
Bake for 40 to 45 minutes more, until the juice bubbles thickly.
Let cool for 3 hours before slicing.

recipes.name: Key lime pie
ingredients: 1 can (14 oz / 397 g) sweetened condensed milk
1/2 cup (120 ml) key lime or regular lime juice
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Whisk the condensed milk and egg yolks until smooth.
Whisk in the lime juice and zest. It thickens as you stir.
Pour into the cooled crust.
Bake for 15 minutes, until set at the edges.
Let cool for 30 minutes, then chill for 3 hours.
Top with whipped cream.

recipes.name: Chocolate cream pie
ingredients: Crust: 1 1/2 cups (150 g) chocolate cookie crumbs and 5 tablespoons (70 g) butter, melted
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Press the crust mix into a 9 inch pie plate and bake for 8 minutes. Let cool.
Whisk the sugar, cornstarch and salt in a pot, then whisk in the milk and yolks.
Cook over medium heat, stirring all the time, until it thickens and bubbles. Ask an adult to help.
Boil for 1 minute while stirring.
Take it off the heat and stir in the chocolate, butter and vanilla until smooth.
Pour into the crust and press plastic wrap onto the top.
Chill for 4 hours, then top with whipped cream.

recipes.name: Sweet potato pie
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) sweet potatoes, about 2 medium
steps: Peel and cube the sweet potatoes and boil for 15 to 20 minutes, until very soft. Ask an adult to help. Drain.
Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Mash the sweet potatoes with the butter until smooth. You need about 2 cups.
Beat in the sugar, evaporated milk, eggs, vanilla and spices.
Pour into the crust.
Bake for 55 to 60 minutes, until a knife in the middle comes out clean.
Let cool for 2 hours.

recipes.name: Fresh strawberry pie
ingredients: 2 tablespoons strawberry gelatin powder (optional, for color)
steps: Mash 1 cup of the smallest strawberries.
Whisk the sugar and cornstarch in a pot, then stir in the water and mashed berries.
Cook over medium heat, stirring, until it boils and turns thick and clear, about 5 minutes. Ask an adult to help.
Stir in the gelatin and let cool for 15 minutes.
Pile the rest of the strawberries in the crust, pointy side up.
Pour the glaze over them.
Chill for 3 hours. Serve with whipped cream.

recipes.name: Peach cobbler
ingredients: 4 cups (about 1 1/2 lb / 680 g) sliced peaches, fresh or thawed frozen
1/2 cup (100 g) sugar for the peaches
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Put the butter in a 9 by 13 inch dish and put it in the oven for 5 minutes, until melted.
Stir the peaches with 1/2 cup sugar.
Whisk the flour, 1 cup sugar, baking powder and salt, then whisk in the milk.
Pour the batter over the melted butter. Do not stir.
Spoon the peaches and juice over the batter and sprinkle with cinnamon.
Bake for 40 to 45 minutes, until golden. The batter rises up around the fruit.
Let cool for 15 minutes. Serve with vanilla ice cream.

recipes.name: Mixed berry crisp
ingredients: 5 cups (700 g) mixed berries, fresh or frozen
Topping: 3/4 cup (95 g) all-purpose flour, 3/4 cup (70 g) rolled oats, 1/2 cup (110 g) packed brown sugar, 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon, 1/4 teaspoon salt
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Ask an adult to help.
Toss the berries with the sugar, cornstarch and lemon juice and spread in an 8 by 8 inch dish.
Mix the topping dry ingredients, then rub in the butter until clumpy.
Sprinkle the topping over the berries.
Bake for 35 to 40 minutes, until golden and bubbling at the edges.
Let cool for 15 minutes. Serve warm with ice cream.

recipes.name: Apple turnovers
ingredients: 1 box (17.3 oz / 490 g) puff pastry, 2 sheets, thawed
1 teaspoon cornstarch mixed with 1 tablespoon water
steps: Cook the apples, butter, brown sugar and cinnamon in a pan over medium heat for 5 minutes, until soft. Ask an adult to help.
