Stir in the cornstarch mix and cook for 1 minute, until thick. Let cool for 15 minutes.
Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Cut each pastry sheet into 4 squares.
Put a spoonful of apples in the middle of each square.
Fold into triangles and press the edges with a fork.
Brush with egg wash, cut a small slit in each and put on a lined sheet.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until puffed and golden.
Let cool for 10 minutes, then drizzle with glaze.

recipes.name: Rustic fruit galette
ingredients: Dough: 1 1/4 cups (160 g) all-purpose flour, 1 tablespoon sugar, 1/2 teaspoon salt, 1/2 cup (115 g) cold butter, 3 to 4 tablespoons ice water
3 cups sliced fruit like peaches, plums, apples or berries
steps: Mix the flour, sugar and salt, rub in the butter, and stir in just enough ice water to hold together.
Flatten into a disk, wrap and chill for 30 minutes.
Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Roll the dough into a 12 inch circle on parchment and slide it onto a baking sheet.
Toss the fruit with the sugar and cornstarch and pile it in the middle, leaving a 2 inch border.
Fold the border up over the fruit, pleating as you go.
Brush the crust with egg wash and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
Bake for 35 to 40 minutes, until the crust is golden and the fruit bubbles.
Let cool for 20 minutes.

recipes.name: Chocolate pudding
steps: Whisk the sugar, cocoa, cornstarch and salt in a pot.
Slowly whisk in the milk until smooth.
Cook over medium heat, stirring all the time, until it thickens and starts to bubble. Ask an adult to help.
Boil for 1 minute while stirring.
Take it off the heat and stir in the chocolate, butter and vanilla.
Pour into 4 cups and press plastic wrap onto the tops so no skin forms.
Chill for 2 hours.

recipes.name: Vanilla pudding
steps: Whisk the sugar, cornstarch and salt in a pot.
Whisk in the milk and egg yolks until smooth.
Cook over medium heat, stirring all the time, until it thickens and bubbles. Ask an adult to help.
Boil for 1 minute while stirring.
Take it off the heat and stir in the butter and vanilla.
Pour into 4 cups and press plastic wrap onto the tops.
Chill for 2 hours.

recipes.name: Creamy rice pudding
ingredients: 1/2 cup (100 g) short-grain or arborio rice
steps: Put the rice, milk, sugar, salt and cinnamon stick in a heavy pot.
Bring to a gentle simmer over medium heat, stirring. Ask an adult to help.
Turn the heat to low and simmer for 35 to 40 minutes, stirring often so it does not stick, until thick and creamy.
Take out the cinnamon stick and stir in the vanilla and raisins.
Serve warm or chilled with a sprinkle of cinnamon. It thickens more as it cools.

recipes.name: Kheer
steps: Rinse the rice and soak it in water for 20 minutes, then drain.
Bring the milk to a boil in a heavy pot, stirring. Ask an adult to help.
Add the rice and simmer on low for 30 to 35 minutes, stirring often, until the rice is very soft and the milk thickens.
Stir in the sugar, cardamom and saffron and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in the nuts and raisins.
Serve warm or chilled.

recipes.name: Bread pudding
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Grease an 8 by 8 inch dish and spread the bread cubes and raisins in it.
Whisk the milk, eggs, sugar, butter, vanilla and cinnamon.
Pour over the bread and press down so it soaks.
Let soak for 15 minutes.
Bake for 45 to 50 minutes, until puffed and a knife in the middle comes out clean.
Let cool for 10 minutes. Serve warm.

recipes.name: Banana pudding
ingredients: 1 box (11 oz / 311 g) vanilla wafer cookies
1 1/2 cups (360 ml) heavy cream whipped with 2 tablespoons sugar
steps: Whisk the sugar, cornstarch and salt in a pot, then whisk in the milk and yolks.
Cook over medium heat, stirring all the time, until thick and bubbling. Ask an adult to help.
Boil for 1 minute, then stir in the butter and vanilla. Let cool for 30 minutes.
Layer wafers, banana slices and pudding in a 9 by 9 inch dish. Repeat 2 more times.
Spread the whipped cream on top.
Chill for 4 hours so the wafers soften.

recipes.name: Caramel flan
ingredients: 1 can (14 oz / 397 g) sweetened condensed milk
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
An adult should make the caramel. Heat the sugar and water in a pan over medium heat, swirling, for 6 to 8 minutes, until amber. It is extremely hot.
Pour the caramel into a 9 inch round cake pan and tilt to coat the bottom.
Blend or whisk the eggs, condensed milk, evaporated milk and vanilla until smooth.
Pour over the caramel.
Set the pan in a bigger pan and pour in hot water halfway up the sides.
Bake for 50 to 60 minutes, until the edges are set and the middle jiggles a little.
Let cool for 1 hour, then chill for 4 hours.
Run a knife around the edge and flip it onto a plate with a rim.

recipes.name: Creme brulee
steps: Heat the oven to 325°F (165°C). Ask an adult to help.
Heat the cream in a pot until steaming but not boiling.
Whisk the yolks, sugar, vanilla and salt, then slowly whisk in the hot cream.
Pour into six 6 oz ramekins set in a baking dish.
Pour hot water into the dish halfway up the ramekins. Ask an adult to help.
Bake for 35 to 40 minutes, until set at the edges and jiggly in the middle.
Let cool for 30 minutes, then chill for 3 hours.
Sprinkle 1 teaspoon sugar on each and have an adult melt it with a kitchen torch until golden.

recipes.name: Vanilla panna cotta
ingredients: Berries or berry sauce to serve
steps: Sprinkle the gelatin over the cold water and let sit for 5 minutes.
Heat the cream, milk and sugar in a pot until steaming and the sugar dissolves. Do not let it boil. Ask an adult to help.
Take it off the heat and stir in the gelatin until fully melted, then the vanilla.
Pour into 6 small glasses or ramekins.
Chill for 4 hours, until set.
Top with berries.

recipes.name: Easy chocolate mousse
ingredients: 2 cups (480 ml) cold heavy cream, divided
steps: Heat 1/2 cup of the cream until steaming and pour it over the chocolate.
Let sit for 2 minutes, then stir until smooth. Let cool for 15 minutes.
Whip the other 1 1/2 cups of cream with the powdered sugar and vanilla until soft peaks form.
Fold a third of the whipped cream into the chocolate, then fold in the rest until no streaks are left.
Spoon into 6 glasses.
Chill for 2 hours. There are no raw eggs in this one.

recipes.name: Berry trifle
ingredients: 1 box (3.4 oz / 96 g) instant vanilla pudding mix
1 pound cake or angel food cake (about 10 oz / 280 g), cut in cubes
3 cups mixed berries, sliced if big
2 cups (480 ml) heavy cream whipped with 1/4 cup (30 g) powdered sugar
steps: Whisk the pudding mix and milk for 2 minutes and let set for 5 minutes.
Fold 1 cup of the whipped cream into the pudding.
Put a third of the cake in the bottom of a big glass bowl.
Add a layer of pudding, then berries.
Repeat the layers 2 more times.
Spread the rest of the whipped cream on top and add a few berries.
Chill for 2 hours.

recipes.name: Baked apples
ingredients: 4 firm apples like Honeycrisp or Granny Smith
1/2 cup (120 ml) water or apple juice
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Ask an adult to help.
Have an adult cut out the cores with a melon baller or small knife, leaving the bottoms on.
Mix the brown sugar, oats, cinnamon, nuts and butter.
Stuff the mix into the apples.
Stand them in a baking dish and pour the water around them.
Bake for 35 to 45 minutes, until soft when poked with a knife.
Let cool for 10 minutes and spoon the juice over them.

recipes.name: Poached pears
ingredients: 4 cups (950 ml) apple juice or water
steps: Peel the pears and leave the stems on. Slice a little off the bottoms so they stand up.
Put the juice, sugar, cinnamon and lemon peel in a pot that fits the pears and bring to a simmer. Ask an adult to help.
Lower the pears in and simmer for 20 to 25 minutes, turning now and then, until a knife slides in easily.
Lift the pears out onto plates.
Boil the liquid for 10 minutes, until it turns syrupy, then stir in the vanilla.
Spoon the syrup over the pears.

recipes.name: Gulab jamun
ingredients: Syrup: 1 1/2 cups (300 g) sugar, 1 1/2 cups (360 ml) water, 4 cardamom pods crushed, 1 teaspoon rose water (optional)
steps: Simmer the syrup ingredients for 5 minutes, then keep it warm on low. Ask an adult to help.
Mix the milk powder, flour and baking soda, then the ghee.
Add milk a spoonful at a time and gently mix into a soft, sticky dough. Rest for 5 minutes.
Roll into 16 smooth balls with no cracks.
An adult should fry. Heat 2 inches of oil to 300°F (149°C), low heat is important.
Fry the balls for 6 to 8 minutes, turning gently, until deep golden brown all over.
Drop the hot balls into the warm syrup.
Soak for 1 hour. They puff up and soften.

recipes.name: Mango sticky rice
steps: Rinse the rice until the water runs clear, then soak it in water for 4 hours.
Drain and steam the rice in a steamer basket lined with cheesecloth for 20 to 25 minutes, until tender and see-through. Ask an adult to help with the steam.
Heat 1 cup of the coconut milk with the sugar and 1/4 teaspoon salt until the sugar dissolves.
Stir it into the hot rice, cover and let sit for 20 minutes.
Simmer the rest of the coconut milk with the last 1/4 teaspoon salt and the cornstarch for 2 minutes, until a little thick.
Peel and slice the mangoes. Ask an adult to help with the knife.
Serve the rice with mango slices, sauce poured over and sesame seeds on top.

recipes.name: Baklava
ingredients: 3 cups (340 g) finely chopped walnuts or pistachios
Syrup: 1 cup (200 g) sugar, 3/4 cup (180 ml) water, 1/2 cup (170 g) honey, 1 teaspoon vanilla, 1 strip lemon peel
steps: Simmer the syrup ingredients for 10 minutes, then let cool. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Mix the nuts, sugar and cinnamon.
Brush a 9 by 13 inch pan with butter. Layer 8 sheets of phyllo, brushing each with butter. Keep the rest covered with a damp towel.
Sprinkle on a third of the nuts, then layer 6 buttered sheets.
Repeat with another third of nuts and 6 sheets, then the last nuts.
Top with 8 buttered sheets.
Have an adult cut it into 24 diamonds with a sharp knife, all the way to the bottom.
Bake for 45 to 50 minutes, until deep golden.
Pour the cool syrup over the hot baklava and let sit uncovered for 4 hours.

recipes.name: Portuguese custard tarts
ingredients: 1 sheet (about 9 oz / 245 g) puff pastry, thawed
steps: Whisk the yolks, sugar and cornstarch in a pot, then whisk in the milk and cream.
Cook over medium heat for 4 to 5 minutes, stirring all the time, until thick like pudding. Ask an adult to help.
Stir in the vanilla and cinnamon and let cool for 15 minutes.
Heat the oven to 500°F (260°C). Ask an adult to help.
Roll the pastry sheet up tight into a log and cut it into 12 slices.
Press each slice into a cup of a greased muffin pan, pushing it thin up the sides.
Fill each cup 3/4 full with custard.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, until the pastry is golden and the custard has dark spots.
Let cool for 15 minutes before lifting out.

recipes.name: Dirt cups
ingredients: 1 box (3.9 oz / 110 g) instant chocolate pudding mix
steps: Whisk the pudding mix and milk for 2 minutes. Let set for 5 minutes.
Fold in the whipped topping.
Put the cookies in a zip bag and crush them into crumbs with a rolling pin.
Layer crumbs, pudding and more crumbs in 6 clear cups.
Poke 2 gummy worms into each cup so they hang out.
Chill for 1 hour.

recipes.name: Lemon posset
steps: Heat the cream and sugar in a pot over medium heat, stirring, until it boils. Ask an adult to help.
Turn the heat down and simmer for 3 minutes, stirring so it does not boil over.
Take it off the heat and stir in the lemon juice and zest.
Let cool for 10 minutes, then pour into 4 small glasses.
Chill for 3 hours. The lemon makes it set like pudding.

recipes.name: Eton mess
ingredients: 4 meringue nests or 2 cups meringue cookies (about 2 oz / 60 g)
steps: Stir the strawberries with the sugar and let sit for 5 minutes.
Whip the cream and powdered sugar until soft peaks form.
Break the meringues into bite size pieces.
Gently fold the meringue and most of the strawberries into the cream.
Spoon into glasses, top with the rest of the strawberries and eat right away.

recipes.name: Caramelized bananas
ingredients: 2 bananas, cut in half lengthwise and across
steps: Melt the butter in a frying pan over medium heat. Ask an adult to help, the sugar gets very hot.
Stir in the brown sugar and cinnamon and cook for 1 minute, until bubbly.
Stir in the cream.
Lay the bananas in the sauce and cook for 2 to 3 minutes.
Flip them and cook for 1 minute more.
Spoon over ice cream.

recipes.name: Sticky toffee pudding
ingredients: Toffee sauce: 1/2 cup (115 g) butter, 3/4 cup (165 g) packed brown sugar, 2/3 cup (160 ml) heavy cream
steps: Pour the boiling water over the dates and baking soda and soak for 10 minutes. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Grease an 8 by 8 inch pan.
Beat the butter and brown sugar, then beat in the eggs.
Stir in the flour and baking powder, then the dates and their water.
Pour into the pan and bake for 30 to 35 minutes, until springy.
For the sauce, simmer the butter, brown sugar and cream for 3 to 4 minutes, stirring, until glossy.
Poke holes in the warm cake, pour on half the sauce, and serve the rest on the side.

recipes.name: Chocolate ganache tart
ingredients: Crust: 1 1/2 cups (150 g) chocolate cookie crumbs and 5 tablespoons (70 g) butter, melted
8 oz (225 g) semisweet chocolate, finely chopped
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Press the crust mix into a 9 inch tart pan or pie plate.
Bake for 10 minutes and let cool for 20 minutes.
Heat the cream until steaming and pour it over the chocolate in a bowl. Ask an adult to help.
Let sit for 5 minutes, then stir slowly until smooth and shiny. Stir in the butter and salt.
Pour into the crust.
Chill for 2 hours, until firm. Top with berries.

recipes.name: Malva pudding
ingredients: Sauce: 1/2 cup (120 ml) heavy cream, 1/2 cup (115 g) butter, 1/2 cup (100 g) sugar, 1/4 cup (60 ml) hot water
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Grease an 8 by 8 inch dish.
Beat the sugar and egg until pale, then beat in the jam.
Stir in the flour, baking soda and salt.
Stir the butter, vinegar and milk together and mix into the batter.
Pour into the dish and bake for 40 to 45 minutes, until dark golden and springy.
While it bakes, heat the sauce ingredients, stirring, until the butter melts.
Poke holes in the hot pudding and pour the sauce over it.
Let soak for 10 minutes. Serve warm with custard or ice cream.

recipes.name: Cherry clafoutis
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Butter a 9 inch pie dish and spread the cherries in it.
Whisk the eggs and sugar, then whisk in the flour until smooth.
Whisk in the milk, vanilla and salt. It will be thin like crepe batter.
Pour over the cherries.
Bake for 40 to 45 minutes, until puffed, golden and set in the middle.
Let cool for 15 minutes. It sinks as it cools. Dust with powdered sugar.

recipes.name: Chocolate fondue
ingredients: 8 oz (225 g) semisweet or milk chocolate, chopped
Dippers: strawberries, banana chunks, marshmallows, pretzels, pound cake cubes
steps: Heat the cream in a small pot until it just starts to bubble at the edges. Ask an adult to help.
Take it off the heat, add the chocolate and let sit for 2 minutes.
Stir until smooth, then stir in the vanilla and salt.
Pour into a fondue pot or warm bowl.
Dip the fruit and treats with skewers. Rewarm in the microwave for 20 seconds if it thickens.
